desc: You see nothing special

name: The Ringwraith
long: A Ringwraith stands here.
desc:
Dressed in black, it is almost invisible within the shadows. It promises
to be a formidable opponent

desc: It looks vaguely man-shaped

desc: I forget what this one looks like.

desc: A woman with 6 arms and a snake's tail

name: Balor
long: Balor stands here, surrounded by electrical fire
desc: He is very large, and looks rather deadly

name: the Mage Guildmaster
long: Grenetta the Mage Guildmaster is standing here.
desc:
Even though your guildmaster looks old and tired, you can clearly see the
vast amount of knowledge she possesses. She is wearing fine magic clothing,
and you notice that she is surrounded by a blue shimmering aura.

name: the Cleric Guildmaster
long: Paul the Cleric Guildmaster is standing here.
desc:
You are in no doubt that this guildmaster is truly close to your god; he has
a peaceful, loving look. You notice that he is surrounded by a white aura.

name: the Thief Guildmaster
long: Delfin the Rogue Guildmaster is standing here.
desc:
You realize that whenever your guildmaster moves, you fail to notice it -
the way of the true thief. She is dressed in poor clothing, having
the appearance of a beggar.

name: the Warrior Guildmaster
long: Tor the Warrior Guildmaster is standing here.
desc:
This is your master. Big and strong with bulging muscles. Several scars
across his body proves that he was using arms before you were born. He
has a calm look on his face.

name: the Mages Guildmaster

long: An armor golem is standing here, unmoving
desc:
This creature seems to have been made out of many pieces of normal
armor.   You can see that the armor is empty, however

long: A sapling stands here eye to eye with you.
desc: Its roots are rather petite, and small parts of them are above ground.

name: The teenage tree, walking on small roots
long: A tree stands here eyeing you defiantly.
desc: Its roots are fairly small, and small parts of them are above ground.

name: The young adult tree, walking on medium roots
long: A young adult tree stands here looking down on you
desc: Its roots are pretty normal sized, and some of them are above ground.

name: The large adult tree, walking on big roots
long: A large adult tree towers over you
desc: Its roots are large, and much of them are above ground.

name: a huge ancient tree
long: A huge, ancient tree towers above you.
desc:
Its roots are extremely big and large parts of them are above ground.

>
The enormous gray trunk shivers slightly, as if sighing deeply.

name: A little rockman
long: A little rockman stands here, unmoving
desc: He looks like a small (10 pound) rock, that was turned into a creature

long: A small rockman stands here, unmoving

name: A dust devil
long: A dust devil whirls about
desc: It looks vaguely sentient

name: A pony
long: A brave little pony stands here
desc: he nickers in friendship as you look at him

name: A small horse
long: A small horse looks at you nervously
desc: he seems frightened by your presence

name: A large horse
long: A large horse looks at you
desc: he seems to be ignoring you

name: A war horse
long: A large war horse looks at you
desc: he seems ready to attack

name: A flying horse
long: A Pegasus is standing here, flapping her long wings
desc: she seems ready to fly off at a moments notice

name: A nightmare
long: A nightmare is standing here, snorting flames
desc: she seems evil and malicious

name: A firehorse
long: A horse with fiery hooves stands here
desc: he looks like he could run on air!

name: a zombie
long: A rotting zombie stands here vacantly.
desc:
Its eyes show no sign of intelligence, or free will. It is but the animated
flesh of a luckless being.

name: A giant troll
long: A giant troll stands here
desc: It looks really pissed to be in its current predicament.

name: A Gray Team Medic
long: A Gray Team Medic is here, looking for someone to help.
desc: The Gray team medic is a large magical looking man.

name: An Amber Team Medic
long: An Amber Team Medic is here, looking for someone to help.
desc: The Amber team medic is a large magical looking man.

name: The Game Field Guard
long:
A huge figure clad in armor stands here guarding the entrance to the
playing field.
desc: He looks massive, you don't want to mess with him.

name: A shark
long: A large shark swims here.
desc: It's a man-eating shark!

name: King Valkim
long: The Villiam King Valkim sits here on his throne glaring at you.
desc:
Before you sits a large rotund man with an ash grey beard and
a hardened face. He sneers at you as he notices your glance.

name: Queen Rotunda
long: The Villian Queen Rotunda sits here besider her evil husband.
desc:
This big lady peers at you as she notices your glance. You cant
help but chuckle at her largly undersized gown and wonder when
she is going to go on a diet.

name: Prince Everin
long: The valiant prince Everin stands here grinning evilly at you.
desc:
A strong noble warrior stands here dressed in a regal robe
and a glittering crown. He sees you and draws his sword.

name: Agin the Scholar
long: Agin the scholar sits here pondering the mysteries of the universe.
desc:
A small frail balding man sits here surrounded by many books and
quills. He mutters under his breath about equasions he cannot solve
and mysteries that boggle his mind.

sounds.near: Agin the Scholar mumbles, "Why DID the chicken cross the road..hmphf!"

name: The Villian paladin
long: The Villian paladin sits here sharpening his weapons.
desc:
A huge figure stands before you gowned in silver armor. He 
beckons you to come forth to either get blessed or cursed!

name: The Villian Priest
long: The Villian priest is stitting here praying and chanting.
desc:
A small bony man sits here reciting the ancient mantras of the
healing priests of the past. A look of peace leaves his face as
he notices you and he closes his book ready for battle.

name: The Villian Sorcerer
long: The Villian Sorcerer sits here memorizing his deadly spells.
desc:
A frail man dressed in black sits here memorizing evil and no good 
spells. He catches you entering his room and lets out with an angry 
howl. Perhaps he is having a bad day....

name: The Villian Warrior
long: The Villian Warrior stands here with his weapon grinning at you.
desc:
A large well muscled brut dressed in black plate stands here
pointing and lauging at you. He snickers as he compares his 
arms and upper body to you. Sounds like he wants a fight!

name: The Villian Barbarian
long: The Villian Barbarian stands here bending iron bars in half.
desc:
A tall stocky man dressed in black animal furs stands here with
a look of arrogance. He is covered by many scars from past battles
and welcomes your challenge.

name: The Villian Rogue
long: The Villian Rogue hides here in waiting.
desc:
You see a tall think figure of what appears to be of drow origin.
His dark skin and evil grin tells you all you need to know whether
he is up to no good or not.

name: The Villian Druid
long: The Villian Druid stands here making wreaths out of thorns.
desc:
A short stocky little man stands here in a crimson black robe. 
His dark eyes give you warning that you had better leave before
it is too late!

name: The Villian Mage
long: The Villian Mage stands here chanting a nasty spell.
desc:
A frail old man in a grey robe stands here murmuring old
sayings from the past. He is wearing a black felt hat and
holding an old instruction wand. He sees you and shouts 
for the guards.

name: The ferocious Grimtooth
long: The vicious Grimtooth beast pounces from out of the darkness!
desc:
You can barely make out a huge mountain of muscle that sort of 
resembles a lion. The next thing you notice is claws coming from
all directions!

sounds.near: The ferocious Grimtooth roars in rage!
sounds.far: You hear a low growling nearby.

name: A Villian guard
long: A Villian guard is standing here looking alert.
desc:
You see a run of the mill guard dressed in plate armor and
whistling a merry tune to himself.

name: A citizen
long: A Villian citizen stands here gossiping about the weather.
desc:
A plain ole law abiding citizen stands here. Dont mess with em
they say or ya might get a surprize.

name: The human fighter
long: A human fighter stands here.
desc: He would look like a tough fellow, if he weren't in drag.

name: a bugbear
long: A bugbear stands here.
desc:
He is furry, and nasty.  He looks like a mean walking carpet.  You probably
don't want to piss him off.

name: A boring beetle
long: A giant boring beetle stands here.
desc: It has a shiny black carapace

name: A ghoul
long: A ghoul stands here.
desc: It smells awful!  And looks worse!

name: A giant lizard
long: A giant lizard rests here.
desc: It is rather large.  Could probably swallow a small child whole.

name: A wererat
long: A wererat stands here, staring at you intently.
desc:
It is small, but VERY quick.  A combination of rat, and man, standing
about 4'.

name: An ogre
long: An ogre stands here, grinning at you
desc:
He is rather large, and nasty looking.  You are well aware of his huge
muscles.  Pissing him off is not a good idea.

name: A huge spider
long: A huge spider scurries about.
desc:
It looks like this spider would have no problem carrying off small
children.

name: A giant tick
long: A giant tick sits here
desc:
It looks like a nasty bloodsucker.  Get many of them in the same room,
and they will form a government.

sounds.near: The giant tick says "Citizen....where are your PEZ?"
sounds.far: You see a ninja sneak by

name: A giant weasel
long: A giant weasel scurries about.
desc:
It is moving so fast that all you can see is some fur, a tail and at least
4 legs.

name: A black dragon
long: A very young black dragon wanders about here.
desc: It is very small, and looks rather lost

name: A carniverous ape
long: A carniverous ape stands here.
desc: He looks like he wants to peel you, like a banana.

name: A blink dog
long: A blink dog stand here, randomly teleporting
desc: He doesn't stay still long enough to get a good look at him

name: A blue dragon
long: A very young blue dragon.
desc: She looks lost and confused.

name: A dwarven cleric
long: A dwarven cleric stands here
desc:
He looks like someone has been using him for target practice.  Like a swiss 
cheese.......

name: A gargoyle
long: A gargoyle stands here.
desc: He is man-sized, and has leathery bat-like wings.

name: A ghast
long: A ghast is here.
desc: Ugly and smelly beyond description.

name: A werewolf
long: A werewolf stands here
desc: He looks viscious and evil.

name: An owlbear
long: An owlbear stands here.
desc: Looks like a cross between a large owl, and a large bear.

name: A shadow
long: You see a shadow on the ground.
desc: It doesn't look like it belongs to anyone.

name: A poisonous toad
long: A poisonous toad hops about.
desc: It looks fairly large, and the poison (you suspect) can be lethal.

name: An Elven assassin
long: An Elven assassin stands here.
desc: She is dangerous to provoke.

name: A displacer beast
long: A displacer beast stands um... somewhere
desc:
The displacer beast is a large cat-like creature with two large
tentacles.  It magically shifts its image, so it is hard to fight.

name: A white dragon
long: A young adult white dragon slithers about.
desc:
A white, lizard like creature.  Looks fairly competent, and ready to
kill

name: A leucrotta
long: A leucrotta stands here.
desc: A disgusting horse-like beast, with a long, forked tongue

name: A giant lizard
long: A subterranean lizard stands here
desc: Very large.  It could probably swallow a large child.

name: A wereboar
long: A wereboar stands here.
desc: It is a humanoid creature, with great tusks

name: The minotaur
long: A minotaur stands here, snorting.
desc: A large man with the head of a bull.. Not the type you want to mess with.

name: A two-headed snake
long: A snake slithers about here.. It has a head at either end!
desc: It must move about by gripping one head with the other!

name: A rattlesnake
long: A rattlesnake shakes his tail in warning.
desc: It is rather large for a snake... You probably want to go now...

name: A giant spider
long: A giant spider scurries about.
desc: It is about 8 legs across, new measurement... not feet.

name: A carrion crawler
long: A carrion crawler searches for food here.
desc: It is a grotesque beast, with numerous legs, and strange tentacles

loads.roomName: The Study of the High Priest

name: An erinyes
long: An erinyes is here, folding her bat wings.
desc: She looks like a human female...with bat wings...a tail...and horns...

loads.roomName: The Closet of the High Priest

name: The hydra
long: An eight-headed hydra snaps at you.. Eight times!
desc: It is a large, eight headed dragon-like creature.

loads.roomName: The Secret Chamber of the High Priest

name: The jackalwere
long: A jackalwere looks at you.. You feel sleepy
desc: It is a jackal-like creature, that has partially taken the shape of a man.

name: A weretiger
long: A weretiger snarls at you.
desc: A very large tiger/man combination...

name: a manticore
long: A manticore stands here, tail thrashing.
desc: It is like a lion, but with a spiked tail.

name: An ogre magi
long: An ogre magi stands here, feasting on human flesh.
desc: He is large, and vaguely oriental.

loads.roomName: At the Hole in the Wall

name: An otyugh
long: An otyugh squats here, tentacles flailing.
desc: It looks like the word sounds... UGLY.

name: An ettin
long: An ettin stands here, his two heads looking in all directions.
desc: He is about 8 or 9 feet tall.  He stares at you balefully

name: A phase spider
long: A  phase spider scurries about.
desc: It is about 8 legs across, new measurement... not feet.

name: a hill giant
long: A rather large humanoid stands here, picking his teeth
desc:
He is about 10 feet tall, maybe 12.  He carries a spear that is substantially
taller than you are.

name: a troll
long: A green-skinned troll is here.  He smells disgusting.
desc:
He is about 7 feet tall.  He carries no weapons, but his breath is strong
enough to kill trees.

name: A hydra
long: A ten headed hydra is here
desc: He has 10 heads..  The lag alone is enough to make you dizzy.

name: A fire giant
long: A giant red-skinned man stands here
desc: He looks rather mean and nasty.

name: A mindflayer
long: A mindflayer stands here, looking rather peeved
desc: His tentacles twitch, as he stares longingly at your brain

name: A lamia
long: A half-woman/half-horse creature is here
desc: She looks pretty mean

name: A bone devil
long: A humanoid figure, made entirely of bones, stands before you
desc: He looks like an exceptionally viscous skeleton

name: A neo-otyugh
long: A neo-otyugh stands here, tentacles flailing about
desc:
He looks like a big pile of sh......  shaving cream..
yeah.. that's it

name: The vrock
long: The vrock stands here, looking for souls to steal
desc: He looks like a huge vulture-man.  yuck

name: The giant slug
long: A giant slug is crawling here, sliming every flat surface in sight
desc:
He is really big, and rather putrescent.   His body cries out
'escargot, escargot!'

name: a werewolf
long: A furry wolfman is here.  He snarls at you.
desc:
He is 5' tall, because he has horrible posture.  He is a swift, and merciless
fighter.

name: A huge lion
long: The father of all lions roars as he leaps at you!
desc:
This is the biggest lion you've ever seen.  He is a wonder of sleek
muscles and tawny fur and flowing mane.

name: The mother lion
long: The mother lion lays curled protectively around her litter here.
desc:
The mother lion glares back at you, daring you to come any closer
to her precious brood.

name: A lion cub
long: A chubby lion cub wrestles with its brothers and sisters.
desc:
This plump innocent little creature romps with total abandon and
doesn't even notice your gaze.

name: A lion
long: A lion wanders about searching for a place to sleep.

name: A giant leech
long: A giant leech attaches itself to your skin!
desc:
The slimy black flesh of this disgusting creature quivers as it
seeks to feed upon your warm blood.

name: A lamprey
long: A lamprey darts toward you.
desc: This leech-like eel has a round mouth ringed with cruel teeth.

name: A gar
long: A silvery gar skims through the water beside you.
desc: This long-bodied fish has a slim snout full of razor sharp teeth.

name: A barracuda
long: A lightning quick barracuda flashes by.
desc: You see a large fish with a gaping toothy mouth and sinister eyes.

name: A pike
long: A pike swims lazily across your path.
desc: You see a long sleek fish with large round eyes

name: The giant mouse
long: The giant mouse is sleeping here.
desc:
You see what could be an ordinary mouse, except that it is the size
of a large dog.

name: a goblin
long: A goblin stands here.
desc: Actually, now that you think about it, he's pretty tough!

name: the bodyguard
long: A bodyguard stands here.
desc: A big, strong, helpful, trustworthy guard.

long: Silverleaf the druid guildmaster is standing here.
desc:
She is young and vibrant, and, it is rumored, quite an exceptional lover.
She emanates an aura of raw natural power quite unlike anything you have
ever seen before.  Her eyes glitter as she appraises you, and your
worth to the druidical cause

name: the Druid Guildmaster
long: Arromon the druid guildmaster is standing here.
desc:
He is old, and worldly.  He has chosen the simple life now, taking care of
the young aspirant druids, teaching them the basics of the druidic way. 
He smiles gently at you.

name: the Monk Guildmaster
long: Cain the monk guildmaster is standing here.
desc:
He is positively the fastest, and fiercest fighter you have ever seen
in your entire life.   Every movement of his body is a demonstration of just
how fluid and beautiful movement can be.

name: The huge bartender
long:
A huge, ugly bartender is here pouring beer, he grins a demented grin as you
walk in.
desc:
On his left shoulder is a metal armband with the symbol of Chaos engraved
upon it. "What today, member?", he says.

name: the Elven Wizard
long: An Elven Wizard is here, creating fireworks for the festivities.
desc:
The Elven Wizard looks at you in a solemn sort of way.  His gaze seems
penetrate through your innermost being.  He is wearing a silvery cloak
and holding a multi-colored staff.  Although he appears to be older
than the oldest man, he seems to have an inner strength which most mortals
cannot overcome.

name: the Keeper of the Ring
long: The Keeper of the Ring is here, guarding his treasure jealously.
desc:
The Ring Keeper is a rather big but short halfling.  His short stature and
bulbous nose belie his true nature.  An elven sword that glows with a blue
light hangs from his belt, and on his finger you see the One Ring.  Although
usually a halfling of peace, he will fight you to the death if you attempt
to take away that which belongs to him.

name: Farmer Gamgee
long: Farmer Gamgee sniffs the air, wondering if harvest time is near.
desc:
Farmer Gamgee is a short, stout halfling of thirty years.  His skin has
been tanned from working the fields night and day.  He's quite a jolly
chap, always ready to befriend an injured bunny rabbit.

name: a toddler
long: A toddler crawls about, looking for something to chew on.
desc:
The toddler is dressed in nothing but his birthday suit.  He crawls about
for he hasn't learned to walk yet.  He peers up at you and asks "da da?"

name: a nursemaid
long: A nursemaid wanders about, trying to keep track of all the toddlers.
desc:
The nursemaid looks rather tired and worn out.  Taking care of so many
toddlers for too long has evidently taken its toll.  She looks to you and
in her eyes you can see her longing for a better life.

name: a cow
long: A cow is here, chewing her cud.
desc:
The cow looks like it hasn't been milked in quite some time.  Although she
is past her prime, you see that she still has a lot of years left, and that
if provoked, her rear kick can be quite deadly.

sounds.near: A cow moos unhappily
sounds.far: You hear the lowing of a cow

name: a pig
long: A pig wallows in the mud and oinks in contentment.
desc:
The pig appears quite happy to be a pig.  He is oblivious to your presence
and cares only for the care-free life that he leads.  It is enormously fat
and consequently cannot move around very quickly.

sounds.near: A pig grunts happily
sounds.far: You hear grunts and squealing sounds

name: a chicken
long: A chicken sits on her nest.
desc: The chicken is bright and healthy.  She has no weapons but her beak.

name: a bull
long: A bull scratches at the ground and lowers his head.
desc:
The bull is in top condition.  He looks like quite a fighter, nothing to be
reckoned with.  With his horns and his hooves he can attack just about
anything.

name: a horse
long: A horse becomes frightened by your presence.
desc: The horse looks at you and turns away.  You can tell that it is afraid of you.

name: a shiriff
long: A shiriff of the Shire looks for signs of trouble.
desc:
The shiriff is over waist high, quite tall for a halfling.  His eyes are
ever roaming, looking for signs of trouble from riffraff like you.  In
his belt is a thin dagger, and on his body he wears a suit of leather armor.
This is one halfling you don't want to mess with.

Shiriff Post of the Eastern Shire
Shiriff Post of the Lower Shire
Shiriff Post of the Lower Shire

long: A shiriff of the Shire looks for signs of trouble.
desc:
The shiriff is over waist high, quite tall for a halfling.  His eyes are
ever roaming, looking for signs of trouble from riffraff like you.  In
his belt is a thin dagger, and on his body he wears a suit of leather armor.
This is one halfling you don't want to mess with.

loads.roomName: Shiriff Post of the Eastern Shire
Shiriff Post of the Lower Shire

name: the Thain
long: The Thain commands respect from all Shire folk.
desc:
A personable yet serious halfling, the Thain looks at you and yells a
deep 'Hullo'.  He walks about comfortably, secure in the knowledge that
as long as he's in office, the Shire will always remain a safe haven for
Shire folk.

name: the Innkeeper
long: The Innkeeper stands here awaiting your order.
desc:
The Innkeeper is a jolly old halfling who spends his days eavesdropping on
local gossip.  In his younger days, he was quite a seasoned traveler.

name: the Miller
long: The Miller is here, overseeing his busy mill workers.
desc:
The Miller is an impatient young halfling, always trying to command more
respect from his workers than he can get.  He looks like the type of person
who deserves a spanking but never got one.

name: the mill worker
long: The mill worker runs to and fro.
desc:
The mill worker is in fine shape from the hard labor that he does at the
mill.  He doesn't notice your presence, but he looks like he could break you
in two without thinking about it.

name: the elven warrior
long: The elven warrior watches you solemnly.
desc:
The tall elven warrior is light and fair-skinned.  The expression that he wears
on his countenance is solemn and tragic.  He cares not for this world any
longer and wearies of it.

name: the dwarven prince
long: The dwarven prince sits here patiently for the return of his king.
desc:
Grim and cold, the dwarven prince is quite strong and bulky, even for the
dwarves of his land.  His glowing eyes peer out of his bushy face and stare
beyond your gaze.

name: the shopkeeper
long: the shopkeeper smiles and patiently waits for you to buy something.
desc:
The shopkeeper will fight like a madman to protect his store from riffraff
like you.

name: the grocer
long: The grocer offers you the finest breads in all the land.
desc:
The grocer is a large, jovial halfling who knows how to enjoy his pipeweed.
However, he also knows that it's worth protecting and so will do everything
in his power to prevent riffraff like you from stealing it.

name: the blacksmith
long: The blacksmith bids you welcome to his humble store.
desc:
The blacksmith is a lean and mean fighting machine.  His knowledge of weapons
and armor would certainly help him in any fight against riffraff like you.

name: the battle master
long: The battle master offers you the services of his fine trainees.
desc: The battle master is a wizened fighter, with many scars to prove his worth.

name: a halfling youth
long: A halfling youth stands here, waiting for nothing in particular.
desc:
The halfling youth is not yet quite in the prime of his youth.  He's knee
high and you get the sudden urge to step on him.

name: a seasoned adventurer
long: A seasoned adventurer sits here, telling tales of fame and fortune.
desc:
The seasoned adventurer has seen his share of glory days.  Although he is
past his prime, he still looks like he could put up more than his share of
a good fight.

name: a local gossip
long: A local gossip asks you, "Have you heard the latest?"
desc:
The gossip is all talk and no action.  You're transfixed by her ability to
talk so much so quickly.

sounds.near: The gossip is really beginning to annoy you... just like most people do.
sounds.far: You hear some mindless drivel.

name: a halfling beauty
long: A halfling beauty stares dreamily into your eyes.
desc:
She is the most beautiful creature you've seen in quite some time.  As you
stare at her, thoughts of all else vanish.  You get the sudden urge to grovel
at her feet, hoping she'll take you in like a lost puppy.  You wouldn't dare
harm a hair on her precious little head.

name: a trainee
long: A trainee screams a death cry as he delivers the fatal blow to a dummy.
desc:
The trainee smiles smugly, aware of your interest in him.  He's a little
fresh, but his enthusiasm and desire to please more than make up for what
he lacks in skill.

name: a chic urbanite
long: A chic urbanite sits here, enjoying his class status.
desc:
The urbanite seems very much at home in his surroundings.  His clothes are
all of the latest fashions and his manners impeccable.  He offers you some
coins if you'd be so good as to order a drink for him.

name: a country bumpkin
long: A country bumpkin dreams of pipeweed and its many uses.
desc: The country bumpkin snores noisily.

name: the Innkeeper
long: The Innkeeper stands here awaiting your order.
desc:
The Innkeeper is a jolly old halfling who spends his days eavesdropping on
local gossip.  In his younger days, he was quite a seasoned traveler.

name: the receptionist
long: The receptionist sits here, signing forms.
desc: He is a very professional looking type.

loads.roomName: The Inn of the Green Dragon

name: a shiriff
long: A shiriff of the Shire looks for the lost halfling youth.
desc:
The shiriff is over waist high, quite tall for a halfling.
He looks at you, smiles and asks you if you have seen a halfling youth
somewhere outside the shire.

name: A corrupt shiriff
long: A corrupt shiriff stands here, laughing at a crude joke.
desc: He looks for people weaker than himself so he can bully them.

name: A corrupt shiriff
long: A corrupt shiriff is here wondering why good people are so stupid.
desc: He looks like he enjoys the perks being a shiriff provides.

name: A corrupt shiriff
long: A corrupt shiriff wanders about, looking for people to bully.
desc: He has the look of a schoolyard bully.

name: Saruman the Wizard
long: Saruman stands here, enjoying his mastery of the local halflings.
desc: He wears white robes but has no staff as a sign of his fall from grace.

name: A oversized orc
long: An oversized orc stands here acting like the ruffian that he is.
desc: He has blood stains in his clothing from beating children to death.

name: The Innkeeper
long: The innkeeper looks you up and down and asks, 'What do you want?'
desc: He has beer stains on his clothing and looks quite grimy.

name: The Drunk
long: The drunk is here, farting up a storm.
desc: He looks like most drunks, with the added feature of lots of skid marks.

sounds.near: The drunk blows a nasty beer fart.
sounds.far: You smell a powerful stench from nearby.

name: The Drunk
long: The drunk is here, clouding the air with excessive belching.
desc: He has drool running down his chin on to his shirt.

sounds.near: The drunk shocks you with a thunderous belch.
sounds.far: You think you hear a giant bullfrog croaking.

name: The Drunk
long: The drunk lies on the floor, suffering in his chunky pool of yak.
desc: As you glance at him, he smiles at you and choofs on your boots.

sounds.near: The drunk rears back his head and spews chunks across the room.
sounds.far: You hear someone calling for Huey.

name: The brothel girl
long: A brothel girl lies here in a state of undress.
desc: She has quite a few interesting diseases.

name: The Madame
long: The madame watches over her slutpuppies with pride and admiration.
desc: She looks like a cross between a raisin and her young sluts.

name: The halfling youth
long: A bad halfling kid looks for easy marks.
desc: He wears his pants backwards, along with his Bilbo X hat.

name: the black Rook
long: A black rook stands here, prepared for battle.
desc: It reminds of you a stone golem, but quite a bit smaller.

name: the black Knight
long: There is a scraggly knight dressed in black here.
desc: This is most certainly not the Black Knight of legendary fame.

name: the black Bishop
long: There is a bishop dressed in black standing here.
desc: Hmm, maybe it's an arch bishop.  Or an arch arch bishop.

name: the black Queen
long: There is a queen dressed in black standing here.
desc: She looks rather fearsome.

name: the black King
long: The King, Ruler of Darkness, is standing here.
desc:
He is a far cry from the white harried wizened old man you might expect.  It
looks as though he could put up a good fight.

name: the black Bishop
long: There is a bishop dressed in black standing here.
desc: Hmm, maybe it's an arch bishop.  Or an arch arch bishop.

desc: This is most certainly not the Black Knight of legendary fame.

name: the black Rook
long: A black rook stands here, prepared for battle.
desc:
It reminds you of a stone golem, but quite a bit smaller.  He matches the
black marble quite nicely.

name: the black Pawn
long: A statuesque black pawn stands here.
desc:
Though this scrawny fighter is not an impressive sight, he is obedient to his
master.

long: The mini mindflayer is here, looking at you with a... well, some kind of look.
desc:
It's a three foot tall humanoid that seems rather menacing for its size.
In the middle of its head are four tentacles with sharp points.

name: The Curser
long: The Curser is here, muttering incomprehensible obscenities to the air.
desc:
It is short stocky guy dressed in clashing colors, spewing guttural sounds
and interjections continuously.

name: The Cow
long: A hard-eyed cow is here, going about his business.
desc:
He is walking around purposefully, as if searching for something,
occasionally lowering his head, sniffing at the air, then eating
pieces of the ground that are apparently somewhat grassy.  When he
notices your intense scrutiny, he looks at you coldly, until you are
forced to look away.

name: Net Lag
long: Net Lag cuts your link, throws his head back, and cackles with insane glee!
desc:
As you try to peer into his beady eyes, you feel your sense of time slowing,
slowing, slowing....

name: The young sapling, walking on dainty roots
long: A sapling stands here eye to eye with you.
desc: Its roots are rather petite, and small parts of them are above ground.

name: The Jugglernaut
long: A Jugglernaut is here, juggling madly.
desc:
It is kind of large, some 10 yds in length, walking on several hundred 
tiny legs. It is metallic-looking, with large spots of corrosion 
marring its angular skin. On its sides are large signs, written in an 
incomprehensible language. On its top, a small eye cluster swivels back 
and forth continually.  A number of tentacles are juggling a dizzying
blur of objects.

name: The Mutterfly
long: An ugly butterfly-like thing is here, muttering about its problems.
desc: it is ugly, and unfriendly

sounds.near: The mutterfly mutters angrily
sounds.far: You hear angry mutterings from nearby

name: The banana peel
long: There is a magical banana peel here.
desc:
It seems harmless enough, although according to ancient legend, they
cause people to slip and fall.

long: A statuesque white pawn stands here.
desc:
Though this scrawny fighter is not an impressive sight, he is obedient to his
master.

name: The Jabberwocky
long: The Jabberwocky stands here, prepared to maul you.
desc: It is big, and alien in appearance.  Probably not here for a cup of tea.

sounds.near: The jabberwocky burbles.
sounds.far: You hear a burbling sound.

name: A pair of Medics
long: A pair of Medics is here, looking for someone to help.
desc: Not only are they identical twins, but they do everything in perfect unison.

name: The Flame
long: The Flame hovers here before you.
desc:
The Flame flickers almost imperceptibly about you.  You can barely feel the
warmth, so gentle is The Flame.

name: A Delivery Beast
long: An Oil Beast is here, sleeping on the job.
desc:
Well, it looks beastly.  And oily.  It's black, and shiny, and oozes
slime as it goes...hard to be more specific than that.

sounds.near: The Oil Beast snores loudly.
sounds.far: You hear a loud snore from nearby

name: An Oil Beast
long: An Oil Beast is here, working quasi-diligently.
desc:
Well, it looks beastly.  And oily.  It's black, and shiny, and oozes
slime as it goes...hard to be more specific than that.

name: The Delivery Elf
long: An Elf is here, making deliveries for the Market Plaza Bakery.

name: An Elf
long: An Elf is here, working diligently.

name: The Cheshire Cat
long: The Cheshire Cat flashes a grin at you.
desc:
Looks like the obligatory invisible monster for this area.  He has that
confident, artificial smile that means he knows too much about you.

name: The Pigeon
long: A plump pigeon is wandering here, oblivious to your presence.
desc: Dinner on the table....

name: Sisyphus
long: Sisyphus of Corinth stands here, guarding the gate.
desc:
The once tyrannical King of Corinth has been consigned to barring
unqualified characters from entering the Tower.  A Sisyphean task indeed.

name: A shadow guardian
long: A shadow guardian screams a challenge and attacks
desc: It seems to made of nothing more than darkness...

name: A lost adventurer
long: An emaciated adventurer is here looking lost and hopeless
desc: He looks haggard and sickly, no doubt he's been lost here for quite some time.

name: Edgar
long: Edgar the Human Swordpupil
desc:
Edgar says 'pardon me, can you tell me where to buy cups?'

You see before you, one of Shadowdale's finest fighting elite, the mighty 
bunny slayer himself, Edgar the horrible!

name: The golem
long: A huge diamond golem is standing guard here
desc: It looks quite strong

name: A mage
long: A young mage wanders about, oblivious to all
desc:
He seems to be contemplating life, love and the mysteries of the universe,
then again, he may just have a headache.

loads.roomName: Inside the High Tower of Sorcerery

name: Strick the bartender
long: Strick is here levitating drinks to his customers
desc: He looks rather harmless, but then again so does a sleeping dragon.

name: Tatorious
long: Tatorious the wizard is here counting his earnings
desc: Tatorious winks at you mischievously.

name: Ezmerelda
long: Ezmerelda the cook is here stirring a large pot of something

name: The cook's assistant
long: The cook's assistant is here assisting the cook

name: The prisoner
long: A prisoner is chained to the wall here
desc:
Though his clothes are all in rags, you can see that at one time they must
have been fine garments. A metal muzzle has been fitted over the poor 
wretch's mouth, whether to keep him from screaming, or to silence his spell
casting you cannot tell.
He looks quite mad, no doubt he's been mistreated horribly.

name: The Jailer
long: The Jailer is here enjoying a comfortable nap
desc: He looks rather dirty.

name: A broom
long: A straw broom is here leaning against the wall
desc: The broom screams 'Take that you lout!'

name: A pair of disembodied hands
long: A pair of disembodied hands floats in the air here
desc: The hands twitch witch anticipation of strangling someone.

name: A pair of disembodied eyes
long: A pair of disembodied eyes floats here glaring at you
desc: The eyes smolder with hatred.

name: The mage
long: A visiting mage is here snoring away in peaceful slumber
desc: He looks quite sleepy

name: A young apprentice magic user
long: A young apprentice magic user is here doing magical studies
desc: She looks quite intent on her studies

name: A young apprentice
long: A young apprentice is here mumbling words of magic to himself
desc: He looks to be oblivious to all but the spell he is memorizing.

name: A young apprentice
long: A young apprentice is sleeping here
desc: He seems to be dreaming

name: A young apprentice
long: A young apprentice is here teasing a cornered kitten
desc: He looks like a mischievous youth

name: A small kitten
long: A small kitten is here meowing in terror
desc:
The little ball of fur looks very unhappy, singed fur and a few minor burns
mark its mottled coat.

name: A student
long: A student of spells is here looking quite bored
desc: The student yawns.

name: An instructor of magic
long: The instructor screams at your interruption and attacks you
desc: He looks quite angry at your interruption

name: A student of spells
long: A student of spells is here trying to master invisibility
desc: He blinks in and out of existence, trying to master the spell.

name: A spell teacher
long: A spell teacher screams at your interruption and attacks

name: A student of spells
long: A student of spells has fallen asleep at her desk here
desc: She looks to have collapsed from sheer boredom.

name: A wizard
long: An old wizard is here making a speech

name: A young mage
long: A young mage is here learning hand to hand combat

name: The battle mistress
long: The battle mistress is here teaching the fine uses of a dagger
desc:
She looks quite rugged. In fact, she more resembles a warrior than a magic
user.

name: A spell teacher
long: A spell teacher is here relaxing

name: An aged wizard
long: An aged wizard is sleeping here

name: A scribe
long: A scribe is here working on some manuscripts

name: A scribe
long: A scribe is here working diligently on some translations
desc:
She looks quite cute, too bad her only interest seems to be the words of
lore she is translating.

name: The master scribe
long: The master scribe is here looking a little upset
desc:
He seems to be so old, his skin has become nothing but a giant wrinkle.
The master scribe screams 'How dare you interrupt my important work???'

name: The scribe's assistant
long: The scribe's assistant is here folding parchments

name: The Enchanter
long: The Enchanter is here placing a dweomer upon well made sword

name: A dancing sword
long: An well crafted sword lies on the work table here
desc: It looks quite sharp.

name: The Mad Alchemist
long: The Mad Alchemist babbles something un-comprehensible and attacks
desc:
He looks like he's been quaffing too many potions. His eyes dart around
wildly, and he starts to drool.

The Mad Alchemist throws back his head and cackles with insane glee!

name: The master summoner
long: The master summoner is here holding gateways open to other planes

name: The master charmer
long: The master charmer utters the words, 'uuuzzldctz'
desc: The master charmer sizes you up, always looking for a new pet.

name: A wooden golem
long: A wooden golem stands a silent vigil here, guarding the stairs
desc: He looks flammable

name: The master spell binder
long: The master spell binder is here re-charging a blackened wand
desc: The master spell binder snarls at you and attacks.

name: The golem maker
long: The golem maker is here chiseling some stone

name: A granite golem
long: A granite golem stands here waiting to do its master's bidding
desc: It looks like a statue, until you see it shamble towards you.

name: A bronze golem
long: A bronze golem stands here shining in the light
desc: He looks rather dim witted.

name: A flesh golem
long: A flesh golem stands guard here
desc:
It looks to be made of a mix match of different body parts, some don't even
resemble anything human.

name: A cloth golem
long: A cloth golem wanders around here
desc: It looks like a bunch of old rags, quite surprising it can actually walk.

name: An adamantite golem
long: An adamantite golem stands here looking very dangerous
desc:
It seems to be forged of dark metal. It looks both incredibly strong, and
durable, but somewhat un-intelligent.

name: A clay golem
long: A clay golem stands guard here

name: The master of illusions
long: An enormous multi-colored three-headed dragon growls at you
desc:
The image of an ugly dragon flickers slightly, and where the dragon was
now stands a small harmless looking old man.

name: The Necromancer
long: The Necromancer is here raising undead servants
desc:
Attired all in black, the Necromancer is tall and gangly, but still quite
an imposing figure. A dark cowl shrouds most of his face, but two blazing
embers which must serve as eyes can be seen through the shadow.
The Necromancer shrieks some obscenities and orders his minions to attack.

name: An animated skeleton
long: An animated skeleton screams silently and attacks
desc: It seems to feel no pain, and hacks at you ruthlessly

name: An undead giant
long: An undead giant lumbers towards you

name: An ugly witch
long: An ugly witch is here scrying out secrets
desc:
She has no face at all, just blank skin, rather disturbing. From about where
her mouth should be, comes a disgusting giggling sound that makes your skin
crawl with revulsion.

name: The Librarian
long: The Librarian has fallen asleep at his desk here
desc: He looks like a rather peaceful old man.

name: The master's apprentice
long: The master's apprentice leaps to halt your passage
desc:
A powerful wizard in his own right, the apprentice of the master of balance
has given up his station in the mageguild hierarchy in order to serve the
great master in hopes of gleaning secrets one could never hope to uncover
alone.

name: A gray cat
long: A gray cat is lounging lazily here
desc:
The gray cat cocks an ear towards you, sensing your scrutiny, then purrs
contentedly.
It looks rather harmless, until you notice its very large claws.

name: The master of Neutrality
long: The master of Neutrality stands here contemplating the balance of the universe
desc: He looks quite peaceful.

name: A black robed apprentice
long: A black robed apprentice jumps from the shadows and attacks
desc:
She bears a wicked looking scar down the side of her face, though once she
must have been beautiful, now the scar combined with what seems to be a
permanent scowl make her looks quite fearsome.

name: A black cat
long: A black cat with its fur up hisses at you
desc:
It looks both mean and dangerous, petting seems to be completely out of
the question.

name: The master of the black robes
long: The master of the black robes is here plotting vile deeds
desc: The master glares at you.

name: A white robed apprentice
long: A white robed apprentice screams at your desecration of goodness
desc:
He looks like a fanatic.
The apprentice screams 'Thou art unworthy of this honor!'

name: A white cat
long: A white cat is here preening its fur
desc: It seems to be nothing more than a large ball of fluff with claws.

loads.roomName: The chamber of the white light

name: The master of goodness
long: The master of goodness is here frowning at your intrusion
desc: He looks like a self righteous bastard.

loads.roomName: The chamber of the white light

name: A calico cat
long: A large calico cat is here
desc:
It looks incredibly large for a cat, no doubt a giant of its species. 
A beautiful jewel encrusted collar about its neck is its only adornments.

name: The Grand Master
long: The Grand Master of Magic is sitting here
desc:
She looks quite comfortable on her emerald throne. Amazingly young and 
pretty for one of such stature in the mageguild, no doubt she has kept her
youthful appearance through the use of strong magics.
The Grand Master pets her familiar and smiles at you in confidence.

name: A wizard
long: A wandering wizard is here mumbling to himself

name: the human monk
long: A human monk is quietly resting here.
desc:
A closer look reveals that this monk is obviously somewhat skilled though
not quite a master in unarmed combat.

name: the human monk
long: A human monk is sitting here, copying some manuscripts.
desc:
This chap spends almost all of the time that he is not improving his
skills in unarmed combat by copying fading manuscripts and books.

name: the dwarven monk
long: A dwarven monk is quietly resting here.
desc:
A closer look reveals that this monk is obviously somewhat skilled though
not quite a master in unarmed combat.

name: the female monk
long: A human female monk is sitting here praying and humming.
desc:
A quite attractive female, however, from the calluses on her hands and
feet, it would be advisable for you not to try anything on her that might
get her upset.

name: the human monk
long: A human monk is here going about his daily duties.
desc:
From the way that this monk walks and carries himself you can tell that
he is fairly new to being a monk as he seems too much like a normal person
(except for the monk robes he is wearing).

name: the human monk
long: A human monk is sitting here praying and humming.
desc:
You think that this young man is probably fairly new to being a monk as
occasionally he slightly stumbles over a difficult phrase in his prayers.

name: the human monk
long: A human monk is resting here.
desc:
This poor fellow has spent the day training, cleaning, praying, and
eating few small meals. All he really wants to do is just stay here and
rest for a week.

name: the human monk
long: A human monk is here maintaining the library.
desc:
This lucky chap has the easy job for this week as he gets to give his
tired body a rest while he goes through the books - sorting and dusting as
he goes around.

name: the human monk
long: A human monk is here cleaning up the monastery.
desc:
This poor guy gets the unenvied job of cleaning the monastery. Not only
does he have to clean the floors and walls, but he has to pick all of the
loose trash and stuff that the occasional adventurer leaves lying around.

name: the female monk
long: A human female monk is resting here.
desc:
A few human females just get fed up with the troubles that men cause them
so they come to the monastery to find out how to defend themselves. This
one is probably no exception to the majority.

name: the dwarven monk
long: A dwarven monk is here going about his daily duties.
desc:
From the way that this monk walks and acts, you can tell that he is
still fairly new as he grumbles as much as most dwarves when looked at.

name: the dwarven monk
long: A dwarven monk is here snoring loudly.
desc:
This tough little guy is all tuckered out from a full day of being a
monk. Though none could probably sleep through his snores, it would not
be a good idea to wake him and tell him about it.

name: the human monk
long: A human monk is here going about his daily duties.
desc:
From the way that this monk walks and acts, you get the impression that
this guy is quite confident in his abilities to handle any problems that
might come his way.

name: the human monk
long: A human monk is sitting here going over new acquisitions and making notes.
desc:
Though very skilled in the arts of unarmed combat, this quiet fellow
likes to spend a lot of his time taking care of the library and trying to
increase the contents of the library.

name: the human monk
long: A human monk is sitting here praying and humming.
desc:
This monk has some noticeable calluses built up on his hands and feet
and you get the impression that a lot of time went into getting them that
way.

name: Dorek the monk
long: Dorek the human monk is walking around looking big and strong.
desc:
This monk is quite strong looking and if he wasn't a monk, you would
probably find this guy working as a bouncer at a bar.

name: Ron the monk
long: Ron the monk is sitting here drinking some beer and telling army stories.
desc:
This particular fellow has close cropped hair that came from when he was
serving in Shadowdale's Cityguards. He also seems to be able put down a good
amount of beer as he is often draining his mug.

sounds.near:
Ron the monk chuckles over some joke, raises his mug, declares "Compai!",
   drains his mug, and then refills it from a small beer barrel.
sounds.far: You here some muffled laughter nearby (kind of like a party).

name: the Grand Master of Monks
long: You see a human casually chopping up a few logs with.... HIS HANDS!
desc:
He calmly looks you over with a very impassive face. You also realize
that this guy could easily rip you apart with his bare hands from the way
that he can chop those logs. He also carries around a pouch with the money
of the monastery (after all, can you think of a safer place?).

name: The Avatar of Celestian
long: The Avatar of Celestian stands hear waiting to do his masters bidding.
desc:
This large elf glows with a bright light, he is not a normal elf. 
He is the incarnation of Celestian, the Elven god of Stars.

name: The scribe
long: The scribe moves about sorting out messages
desc:
Short, and stocky with brown trim cut hair. He looks like he enjoys
his job.

name: the lion
long: A large lion roars loudly at you before attacking.
desc:
The golden fur from this beast gleams in the dim light. Long thick hair hangs
around his neck.

name: Chief
long: The Village chief stands here proudly looking around.
desc:
The village chief looks back at you strangely. You get the feeling he is
wondering what you are doing in HIS village.

name: Villager
long: The Villager watches you carefully.
desc:
The villager is dressed in a loin cloth and wears a few beads and feathers
in various places on his body. His skin is very dark in contrast to his
almost yellow hair.

loads.roomName: Near the Center of the Village
Near the Center of the Village
Near the Center of the Village

name: the Villager woman
long: The villager lady moves about preparing a meal.
desc:
The villager is dressed in a loin cloth and wears a few beads and feathers
in various places on her body. Her skin is very dark in contrast to her
almost yellow hair.

name: a Witch Doctor
long: The Village Witch Doctor glares at you in anger.
desc:
Dressed in barely anything but feathers and a loin cloth this man seems
to hold a grudge against you for no reason. His body is painted with several
tattoos, some not very pleasant.

name: the Village Princess
long: The Village Princess stands quietly smiling.
desc:
This is the most lovely village woman you have seen. Her long blonde hair
flows down to her waist. Covered in a almost see through bleach white gown
that is pulled tight at the waist with a shiny gold belt.

name: the lizardman
long: A lizardman hisses at your presence
desc:
The lizardman wears a few bits of cloth, mostly made form leather.
He carries a spear made with a stone head that looks nasty.

name: the lizardman shaman
long: A lizardman shaman stands here reciting some mumbo-jumbo.
desc:
The largest and strongest lizardman you have seen yet stands before you.
He is dressed in thick leather hide armor and wears hundreds of feathers 
attached to his body.

name: the master magician
long: the master magician is here contemplating life as we know it
desc:
He wears a simple white robe and belt. A long flowing beard streams
down to his bare feet. He looks like a kindly old man.

name: A plainly tattooed priest
long: A plainly tattooed priest is here looking for ways to improve his skills
desc:
Tattoos adorn this fellow here and there. Mostly snakes, some other
just as evil looking reptiles are used. He wears a simple loin cloth and
a few bits of armor.

name: A fairly tattooed priest
long: A fairly tattooed priest stands hear faithfully doing his job
desc:
His body is covered mostly in tattoos, showing you just barely his
brown skin. His hair has been shaved almost completely off leaving a short
tuff of brown hair atop his head. He wears a loin cloth a seems to have
some well made armor.

name: A wildly tattooed priest
long: A wildly tattooed priest stands here ready to turn you towards his beliefs
desc:
Even though this person is human, you can barely tell it. The
tattoos covering this person cover the entire body leaving no untouched
flesh for anyone to see. It looks as though this one was covered in
snakes.

sounds.near: The high-priest screams to some snake god 'Zimba diga!'
sounds.far: You hear someone shout 'Zimba diga!'

name: A humanoid snake
long: A humanoid snake stands here ready to protect the ways of it's master
desc:
He looks just like a lizard man, except that his eyes pulse with a
deep red inner light. Another difference is his teeth, they protrude
from his lips unlike a lizardman.

name: A guardian snake
long: A guardian snake slithers about here
desc:
This snake looks like it has some intelligence. It's head
sways left to right following your movements carefully. The hide of this
snake looks like stone, you would almost be fooled into believing it
was a statue if it did not move.

name: A large snake
long: A large snake slithers about here freely
desc:
This snake is covered in tan and lighter brown splotches
it's entire length.

name: A sacrificial virgin
long: A sacrificial virgin stands here, leaning upon a wall
desc:
Her wrists are bloody and bruised, but her face looks happy
to be free of her bonds. You think she would look much better if
she where fed for a week or two and given fresh cloths.

name: A flying snake
long: A flying snake swoops about looking for something to eat
desc:
This colorful creature is supported by invisibly swift, gossamer wings,
making it resemble a reptilian humming bird. The fangs at it's mouth
however do not give you the impression it will be as nice though.

name: A jungle giant
long: A large green jungle giant towers above everything here
desc:
Powerful, lanky and very green this giant stands above you. Thinner
than most giants, but it looks as strong as any giant you have seen!

name: A humanoid snake
long: A humanoid snake stands here ready to protect the ways of it's master
desc:
He looks just like a lizard man, except that his eyes pulse with a
deep red inner light. Another difference is his teeth, they protrude
from his lips unlike a lizardman.

name: Bandits Monk 3rd Class
long: A Bandits Monk stands here praying.
desc: He looks like he is at peace with the world.

name: Bandits Monk 2nd Class
long: A Bandits Monk stands here praying.
desc: He looks like he is at peace with the world.

name: Bandits Monk 1st Class
long: A Bandits Monk stands here praying.
desc: He looks like he is at peace with the world.

name: A slave woman
long: A bruised and beaten slave woman stands here
desc:
The priests here have no regard for women other than as
objects of pleasure, she is dirty and looks ill. She looks
at you with pleading eyes.

name: A old village priest
long: A old village priest sits here chanting a prayer
desc:
He appears to be a old man, he wears tattered priestly garb
to show is age. He has a large ring in his nose and wears a large
necklace about his neck.

sounds.near: The priest chants a short prayer.
sounds.far: You hear some chanting somewhere nearby

name: A nasty old hag
long: A nasty looking hag of a women is here
desc:
Greasy hair strings down her face, all the way down to her hands
that seems to have longer fingers than normal people. Long talon like
nails extrude from them... strange woman.

name: The druid
long: There is a Druid of the 1st Circle praying here.
desc: A humanoid-like creature with a brownish looking face.

name: The druid
long: There is a Druid of the 2nd Circle praying here.
desc: A humanoid-like creature with a brownish looking face.

name: The druid
long: There is a Druid of the 3rd Circle praying here.
desc: A humanoid-like creature with a brownish looking face.

name: The druid
long: There is a Druid of the 4th Circle praying here.
desc: A humanoid-like creature with a brownish looking face.

name: The druid
long: There is a Druid of the 5th Circle praying here.
desc: A humanoid-like creature with a brownish looking face.

name: The druid
long: There is a Druid of the 6th Circle praying here.
desc: A humanoid-like creature with a brownish looking face.

name: The druid
long: There is a Druid of the 7th Circle praying here.
desc: A humanoid-like creature with a brownish looking face.

name: The druid
long: There is a Druid of the 8th Circle praying here.
desc: A humanoid-like creature with a brownish looking face.

name: The druid
long: There is a Druid of the 9th Circle praying here.
desc: A humanoid-like creature with a brownish looking face.

name: The high druid
long: The High Druid of the Temple of Bandits is overlooking his Initiates.
desc: A humanoid-like creature with a brownish looking face.

sounds.far: The High Druid says 'Begon! Followers of Law and Chaos'

name: a ghoul
long: A Ghoul is looking for food, which consists of human corpses.
desc: A ghoul with long claws and fangs is staring back at you.

name: a ghast
long: A Ghast is looking for food, which consists of human corpses.
desc: A ghast with long claws and fangs is staring back at you.

name: a ghost
long: A Ghost (minor) floating around here.
desc: A ghost gives you the evil eye.

name: a ghost
long: A Ghost (major) floating around here.
desc: A ghost gives you the evil eye.

name: The high druid
long: The High Druid of the Temple of Bandits is overlooking his Initiates.
desc: A humanoid-like creature with a brownish looking face.

sounds.far: The High Druid says 'Begon! Followers of Law and Chaos'

name: A large farm dog
long: A farm dog stands here, barking at your approach.
desc: This dog is really scruffy looking.  One good way to describe him is mutt.

loads.roomName: End of hallway on the second story of Inn.

name: Farmer
long: A farmer stands here, working his field.
desc: This man is rather weather beaten, and poor.

loads.roomName: Prosperous Farm Cottage and Large Barn

name: The farmer's son
long: The farmer's son stands here helping his father.
desc:
This young man is a smaller version of his father.  He is malnurished, but
happy with life.  He smiles at you when he notices your interest in him.

name: Elmo
long: Elmo sits here getting very drunk.
desc:
This man looks like he can take care of himself with ease.  He glares at
you as you enter the room.

sounds.near: Elmo says, 'There is a moathouse north of the road east of town.'
sounds.far: Loud singing can be heard from the room to the south.

name: Ostler the innkeeper
long: Ostler the innkeeper stands here working the bar.
desc:
This man looks like he was an adventurer, much like yourself, at one time.
Those days are over for him though.  His belly now pours over his belt and his
rosy cheeks shows that he samples his wares quite often.

name: John the leather worker
long: John the leather worker stands here running his shop.
desc:
This mans skin is much like his wares, very leathery.  He has every kind of
leather item that you could think of for sale.

name: Rannos Davl
long: Rannos Davl stands here running the local Trading Post.
desc:
This man is rather shady looking.  Makes you wonder what one so evil looking
is doing in a town that is so good.

name: Greemag grins evilly and
long: Greemag looks at you and sneers evilly.
desc:
Greemag lets out a low growl when he notices you looking at him.  He pulls
out his dagger and stabs it into the table, then looks at you with a very evil
look.

name: A guard
long: A guard stands here, guarding all around him.
desc:
This man looks bored with life.  He stands here, half-asleep.  He does look
like he would not hesitate to kill you if you do cross him.

name: The eldest son
long: The son of the leather worker stands here assisting his father.
desc:
This slim youth is the perfect younger replica of his father.  He stands here
word king on a leather jacket.

name: The man-at-arms
long: A man-at-arms stands guard here.
desc:
This man takes his job seriously.  He watches you solemnly as you enter 
the shop, his eyes following you everywhere.

name: The large war dog
long: A large dog snarls at your approach.
desc:
This dog looks vicious.  I He    She looks like she wouldn't hesitate to rip your
throu at out if you cor  rossed her.  She does not look very friendly.

name: Melubb the moneychanger
long: Melubb the money changer stands here, ready to convert your gems into cash.
desc:
For what his job is, Melubb doesn't seem to be doing so well.  He looks 
like he doesn't have 1000 coins to his name, much less any gems!

name: Jaroo Ashstaff
long: Jaroo Ashstaff stands here, one with nature.
desc:
It is said that this man is in possession of some knowledge that you might
need.  Then again, it could have been a rumor.  
  Jaroo is a druid.  He looks well placed in this wooded area.  The large 
black bear at his side throws off any further doubts to his profession.

sounds.near: Jaroo sy ays, 'At the bottom of the moathouse is a man with key to temple.'
sounds.far: You can see a man in a clearing to the north, becoming one with nature.

name: The stone mason
long: The stone mason is here.
desc:
This man is very strongly built.  Word around town is that he is building
the castle for Burne and Rufus.

name: Burne the magic-user
long: Burne the magic-user stands here studying his spell book.
desc:
This is one of the two heroes of the town.  Him and Rufus defeated a band
of evil thugs working out of the surrounding woods.  Since then, they have
decided to move into town and stay.

name: Rufus the warrior
long: Rufus the warrior stands here looking over the plans to the new castle.
desc:
This man looks none to bright, full of more brawn than brains.  He smiles
at you when you enter and asks you if he could show you around.

name: A foreman
long: A foreman overwatches the workers as they work to build the castle.
desc:
This man looks like he is too arrogant for the good of his workers.  He is
constantly degrading and berating the workers on being to slow.  If he would
only work as hard as he yells, they might have the castle done within the year.

name: A worker
long: A worker is moving stones about.
desc:
This man looks malnourished and over worked.  He hates his boss with a 
passion.  The evil looks he give  s him and muttering makes you almost fear for
the foreman's life.

name: Zert the fighter
long: Zert the fighter is here.
desc:
This man is very drunk, and very aggressive.  He looks like he could 
attack you any minute now.  He says something about everyone being out to
kill him.  You are not very sure what his problem is...besides being toasted.

name: A serving wench
long: A very feminine serving wench is here, ready to take your order.
desc:
This beautiful woman meets your eyes and smiles.  She asks you if you need
anything, meanwhile backhanding a patron that gets too fresh with her.

name: Furnok the thief
long: Furnok sits here shuffling a deck of cards.
desc:
This shady looking individual doesn't seem to like the looks of you and
your kind.  He gives of a glaring look and mumbles about something.

name: The brigand
long: A brigand stands here eyeing you.  He attacks as soon as you notice him.
desc:
This man is ruthless to the end.  He would kill his own mother if he thought
she had enough money to make it worthl while...then again, he might do it just
for fun also.

name: A giant rat
long: A giant rat looks at you with beady little eyes.
desc:
This large rat seems to see you as it's next meal.  It attacks as soon as
it sees you.

name: Green slime
long: Some green slime falls onto you from above.  It's starting to burn into you.
desc: Better get this stuff off of you soon.  If you don't, you are one dead pc.

name: The zombie
long: A zombie lets out an awful noise and moves towards you.
desc:
This long dead person is covered with various lesions, wounds, and various
types of mold and other decomposers.  He is giving off an odor that makes you 
gag forceably.  Who ever made them evidently left orders to attack anyone that
enters the room, because they attack you upon sight of you.

name: Large ogre
long: An ogre sits here, watching what is transpiring around him.
desc:
This fearsome creature is large and brutish looking.  He is not likely to
appreciate your interest in him.

name: A bugbear
long: A bugbear is here.
desc:
This bugbear is supposed to be guarding.  He isn't doing a very good job
at it though.

name: A gnoll
long: A gnoll stands here looking very stupid.
desc:
This creature has a very low brain capacity.  They seem to just want to play
knucklebones and sleep.

name: The giant crayfish
long: The giant crayfish burst forth from the pool.
desc:
This fearsome looking creature looks like it has seen better days.  Big 
gashes in it's sides show that more than once it has been attacked.  You can
hardly be sympathetic though, since it is attacking you now.

name: Laret
long: Laret eyes you and then attacks.
desc:
He is the head of the moathouse.  You can see a large key tucked into his
belt, the key that you have been looking for.

name: Dick Rentsch
long: Dick Rentsch stands here running his hostel.
desc:
Dick is a burly fellow with a scarred, pockmarked visage, one eye covered
by a patch.  When you enter the hostel, he eyes your weapons warily.

name: Wag the barman
long: Wag stands here tending the bar, and occasionally shoving a patron th o the door.
desc:
This man is rather tall and lanky.  He has a greasy look to his appearance.
The stuff he serves looks watered down, but drinkable.

name: Dala the wench
long: Dala the serving wench weaves in and about the tables, dodging patrons.
desc:
This slutty looking female winks at you when she sees you looking at you. ,
at the same time wacking a patron over the head with her tray for his not
paying before touching.

name: A patron
long: A patron sits here wathing the minstrel play.
desc:
This man is most likely a farmer from the looks of him.  He is here enjoying
the music and the company of friends.

name: The patron
long: The patron is here looking over you and your valuables.
desc:
This seedy looking fellow looks like he might just kill you for the fun of
it.  He does not look like the kind of man you would trust with your life.

name: Chon, the smith's son
long: Chon, the smith's son, stands here grinning from ear to ear.
desc:
This young boy looks none to bright.  All he does is stand there grinning
at you and listening to his father.  Makes you wonder if he might have been
kicked in the head by a horse when he was a youth.

name: Otis the smithy
long: Otis, the owner of this smithy and stable, smiles at your approach.
desc:
This man is kind.  He is also well built, muscles bulging from his arms and
legs.  He looks like he could give you a sound thrashing if you crossed him.

name: Mother Screng
long: Mother Screng stands here selling her herbs.
desc:
This old gnarled women is in one word, old.  She is stopped and seems to
walk with a shuffling gait that tells you she is probably arthritic.

name: Hruda
long: Hruda, mother Screng's daughter, is here assisting her.
desc:
This woman isn't much prettier than Mother Screng(which says a lot).  She
is very homely, and very ragged.  She smiles, a nearly toothless grin, at you
when you enter the shop.

name: Skole the proprieter
long: Skole stands here serving drinks to some rough looking individuals.
desc:
This man is rough looking, with scars covering his face and body.  He glares
at you when he notices that you have not bought something yet.

name: The ghast
long: A ghast stands here feasting on some kind of flesh.
desc:
This creature sends a stabbing sense of fear up your spine.  You have heard
that the touch of one of these creatures can paralyze...

name: The human skeleton
long: A skeleton stands at your approach.
desc: This since dead human has nothing of value.

name: A gnoll skeleton
long: A skeleton of a gnoll lies here.
desc: This skeleton is of a long deceased gnoll.  Nothing of value is on the corpse.

name: The ogre leader
long: An ogre leader is here.
desc:
This ogre is larger than your average ogre.  He also looks brighter than 
most, which doesn't actually say that much.

name: The commander
long: The commander of the human troops is here.
desc: This man is ruthless to the hilt.  He leads his men by fear and intimidation.

name: Romag the cleric
long: Romag stands here teaching Hartsch the ways of evilness.
desc:
This cleric is very devoted to his line of worship.  Unfortunantly for our
world, his beliefs are foul and evil.  He stands at 5' 6" with a slim figure.

name: Hartsch the cleric
long: Hartsch the cleric is here.
desc:
This cleric is still rather yound g.  He exhibits the eagerness to learn like
many youths, his eagerness is towards learning how to cause pain and hardship
though.  Not a noble pursuit at all.

name: The Earth Elemental
long: A moun  d of earth is forming up in front of you.
desc:
This creature looks like a large mound of earth that has suddenly reared up
for the attack.

name: The horde of rats collectivly
long: A horde of rats burst forth from the walls.
desc:
There are more rats here than you could ever imagine.  They swarm all over
you, biting you over your whole body.  You hope the end will be soon.  For every
rat that you kill, four more spring from the walls.

sounds.near: The squeaking of all the rats fills this room.
sounds.far: You hear some squeaking sounds from nearby.

name: The turnkey
long: A turnkey stands here, ready to make your life a living hell.
desc:
This man obviously enjoys his work.  When you enter the room, he is in the
process of torturing a young girl with much glee.  He is so engrossed with his
work that him and his assistant don't even notice your entry into the room.

name: A large hydra
long: A large hydra stands here, guarding further progress.
desc: The hydra snaps it's 5 heads in your direction.

name: A large troll
long: An ugly troll is here, and looks like he would like to be left alone.
desc:
This creature is very ugly.  He is tall and this with green skin and black
hair.  He curls his lips back upon seeing you, showing yellow teeth and 
releasing an awful smell.

name: Actorn the cleric
long: Actorn the evil cleric is here.
desc:
This cleric looks more battle ready than most you have seen.  He glares at
your entry a but doesn't attack.  His parentage is all to evident.  He is a cross
breed of a human and an orc.  His ugliness is self-evident.

name: Salamander
long: A statue of a salamander is here.
desc:
This statue looks very life like.  In fact, you notice it moved.  As you 
ponder this, you see one of the other statues leap towards you.  It's a trap!

name: The juggernaut
long: A large statue sits here on wheels.
desc:
This statue doesn't look quite right.  It looks very life like.  It also 
seems to be watching you.  You hope that it isn't alive because you get the 
feeling that it could crush you with those wheels.

name: A gargoyle
long: A statue of a gargoyle is here.
desc:
This statue is very life like.  It seems to watch you as you move about the
room.  If n fact, it looked like it just moved!

name: Canon Belsornig
long: Canon Belsorig stand here at the bar.
desc:
This man is obviously devoted to the element of Water, and the evil that it
might bring upon the earth with his guidance.  He snarls at you when he sees
you and says, 'Prepare to meet your doom!'

name: The owlbear
long: An owlbear is here.
desc:
This is a very bizarre looking creature.  He also looks very hungry.  He 
stands at around 6' and has a sharp beak which he snaps in your direction.
He also has razor sharp claws that look just perfect for deboweling someone.

name: The troll chief
long: The troll chief is sitting here, counting a pile of bones.
desc:
This troll is a lot larger than most.  He also wears a small ring on his
finger.  You wish you could get a little closer to see what the ring is, but
he apparently doesn't even like your presence in the room.

name: The bugbear chieftain
long: The bugbear chieftain stands here, talking to some guards.
desc:
This bugbear is apparently a little brighter than his fellows, which doesn't
say much.  He is talking to some other bugbears, using a morning star to help
make things a little clearer for his guards.

name: Kelno the prefect
long: Kelno the Prefect is sitting at a desk here studying a scroll.
desc:
This individual looks like he is very tired.  He looks up at you wearily
and it takes him a little while to understand that you aren't supposed to be 
there.  He stands when he notices who you are.

name: The otyugh
long: The otyugh is here flailing its arms about.
desc:
This creature is foul.  It sleeps in a pile of feces and other trash.  It
has scultpted the piles into weird shapes and even know is caressing the piles
with it's tentacles.

name: The bugbear leader
long: The bugbear leader stands here talking to his lieutenant.
desc:
This is a bugbear that is living the good life...well, at least the god
life as another bugbear would see it.

name: The bugbear lieutenant
long: A bugbear lieutenant stands here listening to his leaders orders.
desc:
This bugbear is devoted to his leader.  He will follow all the wishes of his
leader to the death, which you feel it will lead to in not too long.

name: The bugbear female
long: This bugbear female stands behind her leader, awaiting his commands.
desc:
This creature is not much more than a slave.  She has to follow the leaders
wishes or face death.  She does live a better life than most bugbears though.

name: The su-monster
long: From out of nowhere, a su-monster falls on you.
desc:
This oddly shaped creature stands at four feet and has six limbs.  Four of
them end in claws and the other two are used to stand with.  It attacks you
immediatly.  It is obviously hungry.

name: Feldrin
long: Feldrin the sharper is here.
desc:
This small weasely man has found the good life...as a thief would see fit
at least.  He lives in a plush apartment and has other people do his dirty
work.  What more could a thief ask for.

name: A bandit
long: A bandit is here looking at your valuables with a drooling mouth.
desc:
This scruffy looking fellow looks like he doesn't have a dime to his name.
He definantly looks like he wouldn't hesitate to kill you for yours though.

name: A minotaur
long: A statue of a minotaur is here.
desc:
The detail on this statue is amazing.  It is so life like.  Wait a minute, 
did the statue just snort?  Humm...maybe you should look a little closer.

name: Black pudding
long: A small pile of some black substance is here.
desc:
This stuff is very strange looking.  There doesn't seem to be any order to
it.  It just kinda creeps along the floor.  It seems...it seems to be creeping
towards you!

name: The umber hulk
long: A umber hulk is here guarding this area.
desc:
This creature is a bizarre creation.  It looks like some mixed breeding
experiment gone wrong.  It looks like an insect, with its large pinchers and
carpace, but it also looks humanoid.  It's lineage must be very disturbed indeed

name: Leucrotta
long: A female is walking through the path of fungus here, trying to save you.
desc:
When the f   is female gets closer, you notice something a little strange about
her.  Her lower body is not that of a human!

name: A jackalwere
long: A jackalwere stands here chewing on a bone.
desc: This creature is a cross of a human and a jackal.  It eyes you hungerly.

name: A jackal
long: A jackal lays here, curled up on the floor.
desc:
This creature looks like a thin dog.  It  's sides are thin, from a lack of 
food.  It looks at you with a look that you can only feel must be hunger for you

name: Lamia
long: A lamis a stands here screaming in rage at you.
desc:
This half-woman half-  beast creature eyes you and then attacks, screaming
in rage.

name: The will-o-wisp
long: A will-o-wisp is here, blinking in and out of sight.
desc:
This creature looks like a ball of energy.  It pulses in various shades of
blue, blinking in and out of visibility at will.

name: The hill giant
long: The hill giant stands here looking stupid.
desc:
This very large, stupid looking creature   stands here eyeing you gravely.
He is armed with a large club.

name: Splot the worg
long: Splot the worg is here with his master, Scorpp.
desc:
This large wolf-like creature is lazily curled up around Scorpp, the
hill giant who is here, feet.  Scorpp says something to him when you enter
the room, and Splot stands to attack.

name: A shadow
long:
A shadow is cast upon the wall here, showing that something besides you is in
the room.
desc: You can barely see this creature.  It is so nearly invisible.

name: A groaning spirit
long: A groaning spirit is here wailing upon you entry into the room.
desc:
This creature is barely visible.  You feel a great need to flee from this
creature.  The wailing it puts out strikes fear right down to your soul.

sounds.near: The groaning spirit wails loudly.
sounds.far: You hear some pitiful whining nearby, a sound filled with anger and sorrow.

name: A roper
long: A roper is here flaying it's arms around.
desc:
This creature looks like an obscene visage of a tree.  A tree with a large
gaping maw and 6 tentacles.

name: A lurker above
long: A luker above is here, almost unseen.
desc: This creature preys by falling on unsuspecting prey and then attacking them.

name: Smigmal Redhand
long: Smigmal Redhand is here.
desc:
This comely women is pretty, but looks very ruthless.  She looks like she
would not hesitate to kill you, and would enjoy it also.

name: Falrinth the mage
long: Falrinth the evil mage is here.
desc:
Falrinth serves the forces of evil very well.  He has even received the
attention of a few minor demoness, hence his familiar Kriitch the quasit.

name: Kriitch the quasit
long: Kriitch the quasit is ever near it's master Falrinth
desc:
This evil being is a gift from a minor demoness to Falrinth for his loyal
following of evil.  Kriitch will help Falrinth in any fight.

name: The violet fungi
long: Some violet colored fungus covers the floor in splotches.
desc:
You have heard rumours of this fungus.  It is said to be able to kill a
human just by the way it causes them to get an infection and die immediatly.
You don't know if the rumours are true, but you are more t than a little fearful.

name: A suit of armor
long: A suit of armor stands here.
desc:
This armor is like any normal armor, except for the gold skull placed upon
the breast plate of it.

name: The yellow mold
long: A yellowish patch covers the floor here.
desc: This section of the floor is covered by some yellowish carpet.

name: The gray ooze
long: Some pillows lie here, strewn about the floor.
desc: These pillows look plush, and almost like they are made of leather.

name: The ochre jelly
long: Some lovely purple pillows lie here.
desc: The pillows look plush and just perfect to sleep on.

name: Barkinar the cleric
long: Barkinar the cleric is here.
desc:
This cleric is very high up in the temple hierarchy.  It is kind of self
evident when you look around this room that he is very successful at what he
does.  You only hope you can be as successful against him.

name: The ogre shaman
long: The ogre shaman is here, talking to an ogre chieftain and his leaders.
desc:
This ogre looks wiser in the ways of killing and maiming than most.  He is
currently talking to the chieftain about better ways to torture little children.

name: Commander Kedrack
long: Commander Hedrack is here, controling most of the forces of the temple.
desc:
