This man is in control of most of the forces of the temple.  He actually 
doesn't have much say in what goes on since the temple was thrown down by the
forces of good.

name: Zuggtmoy
long: An old crone stands here looking at you gravely and with an evil sneer.
desc:
This hunched over old lady looks evil.  She doesn't look like she has a
shred of decency to her.  She also radiates a sense of power.  You are fearful
of her.  You have the urge to run away.  At the same time, you are drawn to one
of such power.

name: The Vampire Lord
long:
A tall dark being stands before you, on his face is a look of sorrow and 
regret that he must kill you now.
desc:
This is the Lord of the Vampires.  He was once a handsome man, who lived
a simple life as a druid.  Once too often however, he indulged in sinful, 
evil acts and at his death, his soul was captured by the Temple's evil and
twisted into this creature.  He looks down at you regretfully, as if he did
not want to kill you.  He nods at you, a small gesture of respect, before
he attacks!

name: A Stirge
long: A greasy bird is flapping about here, its beak a foot long and needle sharp.
desc:
The Stirge notices your presence and swoops to the attack, its long needle
like bead heading straight for your neck!

name: An Air Elemental
long: An Air Elemental is floating around here.
desc:
This is the stuff of raw magic and power forced into being.  The Air
Elemental stands here looking at you with a blank expression.

name: A Cloud Giant
long: A Cloud Giant stands here glaring at you.
desc:
This is a huge individual with light blue skin and eyes that crackle with
energy.  It has a long flowing beard made of a wispy white material.  He 
looks very annoyed with your presence here.

name: The Hieracosphinx
long: The Hieracosphinx rests here.
desc:
Looking like a cross between a lion and a man, the Hieracosphinx turns its
eyes on you.  Growling at your approach, flexes its huge muscles and you
notice it has a set of feathery wings on its back.  You'd best be careful
when dealing with this mighy beast.

name: A Vortex
long: A Vortex of energy swirls here crackling with energy.
desc:
A large black hole in the air swirls before you, crackling with energy.
The Vortex is funnel shaped black cloud.  At its tail is a sharp metal claw
that glows with an unhealthy red light.

name: A Basilisk
long: A small grey lizard scurries about here.
desc:
This little guy reminds you of something you read about a long time ago.
Something about variety of small lizards that could kill you with a single
bite...

name: A Chaggrin Grue
long: A disgusting, scaly blue creature stands here.
desc:
Its definitely not love at first sight when you look at this hideous beast.
The Grue is a small scaly blue creature with long sharp fangs that glisten
with fresh saliva at your approach.

name: A Stone Giant
long: A giant man stands here with granite like skin.
desc:
This is a big, big man who doesn't look at all happy to see you.  His 
skin is a dull grey color and looks as if it were made of stone.  It's 
unlikely that this will be an easy fight.

name: A Xaren
long: A squat ugly thing with four arms, the Xaren stands here motionless.
desc:
The Xaren is a squat ugly thing with four appendages that it must use
as arms.  On the top of it is a huge cavernous mouth with many large, broad
teeth.  It stands here motionless, giving you a blank stare.

name: A Xorn
long: A squat ugly thing with lots of arms and a big mouth in its head stands here.
desc:
The Xorn gives you a baleful look as you stare at it.  While not outright
aggressive, it seems unhappy that you even exist.  It looks like a tree
stump with four "branches" that it uses for arms.  On the top is a giant
cavernous mouth with broad flat teeth.

name: A Cleric
long: A robed cleric stands here with a fanatical look in his eyes.
desc:
This is one of the lesser clerics of the temple.  His main tasks are 
spreading the temple's dogma around the world.  He looks up at you with
religious zeal and steps forward to "enlighten" you.

name: A Cleric
long: A cleric stands here chanting loudly.
desc:
This is another of the temple's unholy clergy.  He is dressed in sooty
black robes and reeks of sulphurous incense.  He glares at you with an
evil look and advances towards you with his hands outstretched.

name: A Cleric
long: A cleric stands here trying to look important and wise.
desc:
This cleric looks at you with an icy glare.  He is wearing nicer robes
than the rest of them and looks to be of some importance.  As he notices
your look, he gives you a warm smile and asks that you come closer.
He sneers at you as he attacks!

name: A Fire Bat
long: A flaming bat-like shape dives at you!
desc:
This creature resembles a bat in every way except that is made completely
from flame!

name: A Fire Elemental
long: A mass of fire stands here watching you.
desc:
The Fire Elemental stands here watching you with two eyes of white hot
fire.  You can feel waves of heat emanating from it and wonder if it would
really be a good idea to go any closer.

name: A Fire Giant
long: A large being made of fire stands here giving you a hot glare.
desc:
This is a big angry red man, giving off waves of heat.  The air around
him is distorted from the fire surrounding him.  He looks at you and spits
a stream of lava on the floor in front of you.

name: A Dragon Turtle
long: A Dragon Turtle is swimming along here.
desc:
This is a gigantic turtle!  Its head is huge and covered with scales and
its eyes have a glint of intelligence to them.  It is swimming along rather
peacefully so it might be a good idea to let it continue to do so.

name: A Water Elemental
long: A snake-like being made from water writhes about here.
desc:
A long snakelike being of water swims around you.  It spawns an appendage
that it reaches out towards you with.  The tendril looks you up and down
before being absorbed back into the thing's body.

name: A Frost Giant
long: A large blue skinned man stands here glaring at you icily.
desc:
This is a big man with a cold heart and a bad attitude.  His skin is 
blue and covered with a light layer of frost.  He stares at you with icy
blue eyes.  He sees you and laughs at your puny presence, the air around
his mouth crystallizing.

name: A Lacedon
long: A rotted ghoul swims towards you.
desc:
This creature looks like a ghoul except that it has been underwater for 
a long time and has been rotting away at a faster pace.  Flaps of green
skin hang loosely from its face and arms.  It sees you and opens its mouth
letting out a soundless cry.

name: A Cleric of Cuthbert
long: A Cleric of Cuthbert stands here looking wise.
desc:
A very wise looking cleric is wandering about here tending the trees and
flowers.  He notices you and smiles.

name: The Jailer
long: The Jailer is standing here, leering at you
desc: He smiles knowingly, and whacks you very hard.

name: Bangfizzle
long: Bangfizzle wanders behind the counter, trying to make new magic items
desc:
She is wearing tattered brown robes, and seems to be having a
conversation with the her beakers.  All the more disturbing
because the beakers occasionally explode with a thunderous roar.

sounds.near: Bangfizzle says 'Oops, guess that those weren't the right chemicals.
sounds.far: You hear an explosion nearby.

name: The Cheeser
long: the Cheeser looks at you calmly, wiping debris from his face with one hand.
desc:
A fat, nice looking Cheeser. But you can see that he has many scars on his
body, probably because he is so close to Bangfizzle.

name: the Pawnbroker
long:
A Pawnbroker stands at the counter, he looks as if he would gladly sell
you your children for one of his items.
desc:
A tall Pawnbroker, who moves two 200 pound bags of stuff around on his
shoulders.

name: the dwarven slave weaponsmith
long: A dwarven slave weaponsmith.
desc: An old tired dwarven weaponsmith, who still has yet to escape.

name: the Armorer
long: A Militia armorer stands here.
desc:
An old but very strong armorer, he has made more armor in his
lifetime than you have ever seen.  Shame it doesn't look very good.

name: the receptionist
long: A buxom receptionist is here, expertly filing her nails.
desc: She seems very good at her job, whatever that entails.

name: The Warren Guard
long: A Warren Guard stands here, grinning evilly.
desc:
As you peer intently at the Warren Guard it sneers at you, revealing
rotting yellow teeth.  The guard is dressed in a motley assortment of
armor, none of which looks like it's doing much good.  Fortunately, for
it, it appears to be very quick, and very strong.  As you approach it
brandishes it's glaive and mumbles something about dinner arriving.

name: Queeklor, God of the Rats
long: Queeklor, God of the Rats has seen you, flee!
desc:
You are lucky if you come up to Queeklor's knees.  From beneath
his snout, rancid breath assaults your nose, its stench unbearable.
Boy, you wish you had a breath mint about now.

sounds.near: Queeklor, God of the Rats, looks at you.
sounds.far: You hear the sound of a enormous rat.

name: the Ratman Templar
long: A wicked big rat stands here, his description fully outfitted in chaos armor.
desc:
The Ratman Templar is outfitted in very ornate brown and yellow chaos 
armor.  Atop his head is a chaos helm, and in his very capable paws, 
is a wicked glaive.

name: the Waitress
long: A Ratwoman Waitress stands here, carefully trying not to smile so much.
desc:
Closer inspection reveals why she is not showing her pearly whites,
er, better make that rotting yellows.  Even so she is more than willing
to sell you a drink.

name: a greasy cook
long: A rotund rat is here, cheerfully cooking some sort of questionable substance.
desc:
The apron that this rat is wearing barely covers his rather large belly.
Occasionally the cook prods the roasted cat with one finger, sticks it 
in his mouth, and smiles happily.

name: the Beggar
long: A Beggar is here, too sick to even ask for a few coins.
desc: He's a beggar and filthy, what did you expect?

name: an urchin
long: A poor urchin lies huddled to the left of you.
desc:
As you look to your left you see the urchin.  She is covered in filth and
may be one of the many offspring that Filthy has abandoned.

name: a waif
long: A poor waif lies huddled to the right of you.
desc:
This waif is extremely frail, probably not worth your effort to beat her
up.

name: a leper
long: A leper and his arm are sitting here.  Both right beside each other.
desc:
Yech. The poor guy's leprosy is in it's advanced stages.  Rumor has
it that it's contagious.  Consider yourself warned.

name: a sneaky thief
long: Just for a moment you thought you saw something hiding in the shadows.
desc: Just as you were about to look at the thief, he ducked.

name: a beefy locksmith
long:
A very large locksmith is here, calmly picking his teeth with a piece
of bent metal.
desc: Locksmith?  Yeah, right.  And your Santa Claus.

name: a massive waiter
long: The Warrior Guild's waiter is here, merrily washing plates.
desc:
Under the waiter's apron there is a definite amount of bulk, all
of it rippling with power.  God only knows why this man works for
a bunch of rats.  He should be out wielding a humongous sword and
killing lots of things.  Hey, wait a minute, maybe that is his axe
sticking out of the wall.  Do you think he would get mad if you 
took it?

name: your guildmaster
long: Just for a moment you thought you saw your guildmaster hiding here.
desc:
Guess what, every time you look at your guildmaster, he ducks.
Sound familiar?

name: your guildmaster
long: Your guildmaster stands here, wearing the robes of a high cleric of Queeklor.
desc: He looks priestly and wear simple white robes.

name: your guildmaster
long: Dressed in perhaps the only full suit of armor, your guildmaster is here.
desc:
Your guildmaster is dressed in the finest suit of Full plate that
you have ever laid eyes on.

name: your guildmaster
long: Your guildmaster is here blipping into and out of existence.
desc:
Damn, can't seem to pin him down long enough to get a good look.
One thing is for sure, though.  He does seem to be having one
hell of a good time though.

name: a little orcish raider
long: With an old pot for a helm, this little orcish raider is ready for some fun.
desc:
This is a little orc, just barely walking.  He is ready to follow in his
father's footsteps and loot and pillage.  He is looking for something or
someone to loot.  Perhaps you would care to oblige him? He is only a 
little kid after all...

name: an orc
long: An orc is hiding here.
desc: This guy definitely does not seem to be friendly.

name: A guardian sentinel
long: A guardian mobile stands here.
desc:
This looks like your everyday guardian.  Somehow someone sometime
decided that the astral plane was way to tough, so someone made
these things so people could track them.  Well now.  That's good
and all, but there is one minor drawback.  You're fairly sure your
pockets are lighter now.

name: The bartender
long: The Bartender intently peers at you, wondering if you are one of those vandals
desc:
This poor bartender has had a hard day.  Maybe you should leave him a
tip.

name: The Rat Knight
long: The Head of the Warren Guard stands before you.
desc: Wow, this guy is big.

name: The rodent activist
long: A rodent activist protests equal rights for rats here.
desc: Looks like your average everyday yo-yo with a cause.

sounds.near: "Equal rights for Rats!", shouts the activist.
sounds.far: You hear a lot of hot air nearby.

name: Biff the Dragon Slayer
long: Biff the Dragon Slayer is sitting here talking of old times.
desc:
This weary adventurer is about 40 years old.  He is renowned for
his adventures in dragon hunting, in specific a nasty old green
one west of town.  Every once in a while he gathers up a bunch of
adventurers to go hunt this cursed down, but the dragon never 
fails to return at a later time.  The rest of the time it looks
as if Biff drinks himself into oblivion.

name: A berbalang with bat-like wings
long: A berbalang flitters across the astral plane looking for lunch.
desc:
This creature has leathery skin and large bat-like wings.  It is
a biped, and its arms end in cruel claws.  It notices you, and you
can see it's large white eyes brighten.  Lunch has arrived.

name: A githyanki soldier
long: An armored form wrapped in rotting bandages glares at you for intruding.
desc:
This sickly man sized creature is swathed from head to foot in bandages.
The bandages resemble that of a mummy's, but this creature's are not
as complete.  Pieces are missing here and there, and beneath you glimpse
flesh.  It's eyes glow with a malevolent reddish glow.  It wears an
ornate suit of banded mail and wields a silvery blade.

name: A githyanki mage
long: A thin form, bathed in an eerie glow and rotting bandages stands here.
desc:
This sickly man sized creature is swathed from head to foot in bandages.
The bandages resemble that of a mummy's, but this creature's are not
as complete.  Pieces are missing here and there, and beneath you glimpse
flesh.  It's eyes glow with a malevolent reddish glow.  It wears a hooded
robe about itself.

name: A githyanki knight
long:
A bandaged form outfitted in ornate plate mail charges you in the name of
some alien god.
desc:
This sickly man sized creature is swathed from head to foot in bandages.
The bandages resemble that of a mummy's, but this creature's are not
as complete.  Pieces are missing here and there, and beneath you glimpse
flesh.  It's eyes glow with a malevolent reddish glow.  It wears
exceptionally well made banded mail and wield a wicked sword.

name: A bandaged form stands here, it's robe masking it's body.
long:
This sickly man sized creature is swathed from head to foot in bandages.
The bandages resemble that of a mummy's, but this creature's are not
desc:
flesh.  It's eyes glow with a malevolent reddish glow.  It wears
a hooded robe which appears to be covering ornate banded mail.  In it's
hand it wields a sharp blade of silvery metal.

name: A githyanki sergeant
long: An armored form wrapped in rotting bandages glares at you for intruding.
desc:
This sickly man sized creature is swathed from head to foot in bandages.
The bandages resemble that of a mummy's, but this creature's are not
as complete.  Pieces are missing here and there, and beneath you glimpse
flesh.  It's eyes glow with a malevolent reddish glow.  It wears ornate
banded mail and wields a large two-handed sword.

name: A githyanki warlock
long: A powerful githyanki stands here preparing a spell to cast at you!
desc:
This sickly man sized creature is swathed from head to foot in bandages.
The bandages resemble that of a mummy's, but this creature's are not
as complete.  Pieces are missing here and there, and beneath you glimpse
flesh.  It's eyes glow with a malevolent reddish glow.  It wears 
hooded robe about it's body.

name: A githyanki knight
long: A powerful bandaged form wearing banded mail charges you!
desc:
This sickly man sized creature is swathed from head to foot in bandages.
The bandages resemble that of a mummy's, but this creature's are not
as complete.  Pieces are missing here and there, and beneath you glimpse
flesh.  It's eyes glow with a malevolent reddish glow.  It wears ornate
banded mail and wields a silver long sword.

name: A githyanki captain
long: A githyanki captain stands here, inspecting his castle's troops.
desc:
This sickly man sized creature is swathed from head to foot in bandages.
The bandages resemble that of a mummy's, but this creature's are not
as complete.  Pieces are missing here and there, and beneath you glimpse
flesh.  It's eyes glow with a malevolent reddish glow.  It wears ornate
banded mail that looks the best you have seen so far.

name: A githyanki master conjurer, one of the most powerful,
long:
This figure glows with an eerie light that seems to be emanating from it's
robe.
desc:
This sickly man sized creature is swathed from head to foot in bandages.
The bandages resemble that of a mummy's, but this creature's are not
as complete.  Pieces are missing here and there, and beneath you glimpse
flesh.  It's eyes glow with a malevolent reddish glow.  It wears a robe
that casts a greenish tint to the room.

name: Yzrgomab the supreme leader of the githyanki
long:
Amazed that you managed to get this far, Yzrgomab, the supreme leader of the
Githyanki, prepares to finish you off.
desc:
Yzrgomab radiates power.  Constant worship of her female demi-lich 
god has wasted her form.  Her bandages hang limply about her, but
her power stems not from herself, but from her god.

name: A red slaadi
long: A vaguely frog-like creature known as a slaadi stands here.
desc:
This creature is bipedal and has wicked looking claws.  It's skin
is red.  Wrapped around its is a loin cloth.

name: An insectoid-like mezzodaemon
long: A mezzodaemon wanders by, performing an errand for some master.
desc:
This deamon has an horny exo-skeleton.  Every once in a while a black
forked tongue will snake out from it's beak and taste the air, reminding
you of a snake.  It's multi-faceted eyes stare at you and a dozen other
places at once.  Unfortunately, this creature seems more interested in you
than the dozen other places.

name: An invisible stalker
long: You are not really sure you see this Invisible Stalker.
desc:
No offense, but do you really expect to see much when looking at
an Invisible Stalker?

loads.roomName: Formless Void of the Astral Plane

name: An astrally projecting senior mindflayer
long:
An astrally projecting senior mindflayer roams the plane looking for something
.
desc: This is a horrifying monster indeed, 6'6" high. Dressed in purple and black,

name: A color pool
long: A milky white color pool can be seen as you approach.
desc:
The Secret Chamber of the High Priest
   Wow!  You have found a secret passage!  And you thought things like
this only happened in computer games!  There is a door to the west,
and a stairway leading downwards.

loads.roomName: Formless Void of the Astral Plane

name: A color pool
long: A turquoise color pool can be seen as you approach.
desc:
You see an old trail at the edge of a large desert. To the west is a large
sand dune that prevents further travel in that direction, featureless desert
is all that is north and south. The trail leads east.

name: A color pool
long: A checkered color pool can be seen as you approach.
desc:
Much to your surprise you are standing on dusty clifftop overlooking
a magnificent ocean.  The sun seems to be frozen just over the horizon,
turning the ocean into a swirling plain of gold and black reflections.
A warm and gentle breeze brushes your face.  You hear the roar of the
waves crashing rhythmically on the rocks below, interspersed with cries
of seagulls floating lazily overhead.
     To the north you can see a large city by the ocean side, far larger
than Shadowdale, perhaps far larger than any city you've seen before.  It
seems to extend infinitely to the north.  From this distance the city
resembles a spectacular field of colorful lights, twinkling before you
in silent majesty.

name: A color pool
long: A gold color pool can be seen as you approach.
desc:
An intersection
  You are at an intersection in the corridor. The obsidian walled halls
lead off in every direction from here, pulsing with the power of their
ancient runes.

name: A color pool
long: A dark gray color pool can be seen as you approach.
desc:
You are in a giant cave, all the walls are shining with a soft golden
light. The cave continues to the south, east and north.

name: A color pool
long: A midnight blue color pool can be seen as you approach.
desc:
To the west, you can see a blue shimmering light.   To the east, you
can see a dark tunnel.  The north and south are blocked by tall
mountains.

name: A color pool
long: A smoky gray color pool can be seen as you approach.
desc:
You stand in the entrance way to the temple which opens up to the
north into a large hallway going east and west. Small statues of spiders line
the entrance way's walls.

name: A color pool
long: A burnt red color pool can be seen as you approach.
desc:
In here you find tools and anvils used to make various weapons
and items. The walls have been stripped clean and only a few incomplete
pieces of armor and weaponry are left.

name: A color pool
long: A granite hued color pool can be seen as you approach.
desc:
Here is an entrance to the mountain.  The door looks very well built,
and you can hear noise coming from within.

name: A color pool
long: A inky black color pool can be seen as you approach.
desc:
You can't see much here but the echo tells you that there's quite a drop
down. You can just make out a huge dark pool out there in the darkness,
mostly because of the trickling of water. The water from the sewer
actually
washes over this ledge and makes it quite slippery. From here it drops,
like a waterfall, into the pool far down.

name: A color pool
long: A grassy green color pool can be seen as you approach.
desc:
You stand in a grassy meadow with annoyingly cute dandelions
growing here and there.  You hear the merry bubbling of a brook
somewhere ahead, and to the north you see a narrow wooden bridge.  The
scents of perpetual spring either delight or disgust you, depending on
whether you go for the trite stuff like this.

name: A color pool
long: A green and yellow color pool can be seen as you approach.
desc:
Over the years, litter and debris has built up in here from the prey of
the crawlers. All sorts of bones, human and otherwise, are heaped and piled
here and there. A large sinkhole in the middle of the cave has acquired some
water from somewhere and you see a strange glow coming from the bottom of the
hole.

name: A color pool
long: A sea green color pool can be seen as you approach.
desc:
You are sailing on a huge ocean that extends in many directions.  Due to
the changing winds you cannot always go the direction you choose.  You
can see several islands along the coast in all directions.  You hope
that your compass is working properly.

name: A color pool
long: A dirty brown color pool can be seen as you approach.
desc:
You are at the main room of the Wild Wereboar Tavern, the place is
a total mess.  You can tell this place is accustomed to many brawls, the many
pieces of furniture spread around the room gave you the hint.  There is a old,
creaky, sagging staircase leading upstairs.

name: A color pool
long: A sticky gray color pool can be seen as you approach.
desc:
Large strands connect at this point.  The node shimmers and
flickers within the ether.  You see many flying creatures--
insects, pegasi, and dragon wormkins--navigate the dangerous
passages of the web.  Exits go in many directions.

name: A color pool
long: A dusty green color pool can be seen as you approach.
desc:
From this height, you can see the Eucalyptus Forest around you as
well as the Aborigine Stronghold to the distant South-West, the Roo Fortress
to the South, and the Eucalyptus River flowing between them towards a Lake.
    It looks like you can make it down the steep Western and Northern 
side from the top but not back up from the bottom.

name: A color pool
long: A murky gray color pool can be seen as you approach.
desc:
This is a twisty underground tunnel with many exits and entrances.
The ground is more or less even, but the passage walls are so similar in
kind that it is impossible to differentiate one passage from another by them.
There are exits leading in all four compass directions. The tunnel floor
has been worn smooth by the passage of many feet.

name: A color pool
long: A gray color pool can be seen as you approach.
desc:
You are now standing on the drawbridge of an ancient castle. Two huge
statues of some strange creature float in mid-air directly above the pit
beneath the drawbridge on which you now stand. You can't see any farther
than the inside of the entrance, for the castle appears to be totally
without light.

name: Zifnab
long: Zifnab wanders behind the counter, talking to himself
desc:
He is wearing brown robes, and seems to be having a conversation with the
floor.  All the more disturbing because the floor occasionally answers.

sounds.near: Zifnab says 'Must remember to buy more bats wings!
sounds.far: You hear someone muttering

name: the Baker
long: The Baker looks at you calmly, wiping flour from his face with one hand.
desc:
A fat, nice looking baker. But you can see that he has many scars on his
body.

name: the Grocer
long: A grocer stands at the counter, with a slightly impatient look on his face.
desc: A tall grocer, who moves two 200 pounds bag of flour around on his shoulders.

name: the Weaponsmith
long: A weaponsmith.
desc: A young weaponsmith, who still has lots to learn.

name: the Armorer
long: An Armorer stands here.
desc:
An old but very strong armorer, he has made more armor in his
lifetime than you have ever seen.

name: Rosetta the receptionist
long: Rosetta is here, expertly filing papers.
desc: She seems very good at her job.

name: the Skipper
long: Skipper the retired Captain stands here, selling boats.
desc: Skipper the Captain has eaten more sharks than you have killed peas.

loads.roomName: The Eastern Edge of the Great Ocean

name: the Sailor
long: A Sailor stands here, waiting to help you.
desc: He looks like a strong, fit sailor.

loads.roomName: The Eastern Edge of the Great Ocean

name: the Guildmaster
long: Jalia the mage guildmaster is standing here.
desc:
Even though your guildmaster looks old and tired, you can clearly see the
vast amount of knowledge she possesses. She is wearing fine magic clothing,
and you notice that she is surrounded by a blue shimmering aura.

name: the Guildmaster
long: Ruban the Cleric guildmaster is standing here.
desc:
You are in no doubt that this guildmaster is truly close to your god; he has
a peaceful, loving look. You notice that he is surrounded by a white aura.

name: the Guildmaster
long: Welp the Rogue guildmaster is standing here.
desc:
You realize that whenever your guildmaster moves, you fail to notice it -
the way of the true thief. She is dressed in poor clothing, having
the appearance of a beggar.

name: the Guildmaster
long: Bart the Warrior guildmaster is standing here.
desc:
This is your master. Big and strong with bulging muscles. Several scars
across his body proves that he was using arms before you were born. He
has a calm look on his face.

name: the Sorcerer
long: A sorcerer is guarding the entrance.
desc:
He is an experienced mage who has specialized in the field of Combat Magic.
He is here to guard the Mage's Guild and his superior knowledge of offensive as
well as defensive spells make him a deadly opponent.

name: the Knight Templar
long: A knight templar is guarding the entrance.
desc:
He is a specially trained warrior belonging to the military order of the Faith.
His duty is to protect the faithful from persecution and infidel attacks and
his religious devotion combined with his superior skill makes him a deadly
opponent.

name: the Assassin
long: An assassin is guarding the entrance.
desc:
He is a thief who has specialized in killing others as effectively as possible,
using all sorts of weapons.  His superior knowledge of how and where to use
them combined with his extraordinary stealth makes him a deadly opponent.

loads.roomName: Entrance Hall to the Guild of Thieves

name: the Knight
long: A knight is guarding the entrance.
desc:
He is an expert warrior who has attained knighthood through countless
chivalrous deeds.  His duty is to protect the Guild of Swordsmen and his
extreme skill combined with his experience in warfare makes him a deadly
opponent.

loads.roomName: Entrance Hall to the Guild of Swordspeople

name: the Paladin Guard
long: A Paladin Guard stands here guarding his guild hall
desc:
He is a specially trained warrior belonging to the military order of the Faith.
His duty is to protect the faithful from persecution and infidel attacks and
his religious devotion combined with his superior skill makes him a deadly
opponent.

name: the Paladin Guard
long: A Paladin Guard stands here guarding his guild hall
desc:
He is a specially trained warrior belonging to the military order of the Faith.
His duty is to protect the faithful from persecution and infidel attacks and
his religious devotion combined with his superior skill makes him a deadly
opponent.

name: the Bartender
long: A Bartender watches you calmly, while he skillfully mixes a drink.
desc: A tired looking Bartender who hates trouble in his bar.

name: the Waiter
long: A waiter is going around from one place to another.
desc: A tired looking waiter.

name: the Waiter
long:
A man who in his young days was a famous sorcerer but now leads a quiet,
peaceful life as a waiter.

name: the Waiter
long: A waiter who seems to have reach contact with God.

name: the Waiter
long: A waiter who knows where all his customers have their money.

name: the Waiter
long: A waiter who easily could kill you, and still carry quite a few firebreathers.

name: Filthy
long: Filthy is standing here, eager to serve you a special drink.
desc:
Filthy looks real, ehm, dirty. He likes to keep his customers happy,
but do not mess with him or else he'll get upset.

name: Elminster
long: A old man stumbles about here mumbling to himself
desc:
He appears to be a harmless old man. He wears some ragged cloths
and carries a small wooden wand that looks useless.

name: the Cityguard
long: A cityguard stands here.
desc: A big, strong, helpful, trustworthy guard.

loads.roomName: Entrance Hall to the Guild of Swordspeople
Entrance Hall to the Guild of Thieves

name: the Janitor
long: A janitor is walking around, cleaning up.
desc: He looks anal retentive.

loads.roomName: Entrance to the Old Skull Inn

name: The black cat
long: A Black cat is here.
desc:
A cute and furry black cat.  It looks so cute you want to take it home with
you and hug it and pet it and feed it and love it and......

name: the Mercenary
long: A Mercenary waiting for a job.
desc: He looks pretty mean.

name: the Drunk
long: A singing, happy Drunk.
desc: A drunk who seems to be too happy, and to carry too much money.

name: the Beggar
long: A beggar is here, asking for a few coins.
desc: The beggar looks like she is fed up with life.

sounds.near: The beggar says 'Pardon me, could you spare a coin?'
sounds.far: You hear someone talking nearby

name: The vampire bat
long: A vampire bat is here.
desc:
A vampire bat hovers here, ready to go for your neck.

WATCH OUT!

OUCH!  That hurt!

name: the Cityguard
long: A cityguard is here, guarding the gate.
desc:
A big, strong, helpful, trustworthy guard. He looks well trained with his
weapon.

Inside the West Gate of Shadowdale

name: The ninja master
long: A ninja master was here just a second ago...
desc: You don't see anything like that.

name: the Guard Royale
long: A Guard Royale stands here, smiling happily.
desc:
He will do anything to protect the royal family, and is also dedicated to the
safety and well being of the citizens of Shadowdale.

name: The Repair Guy
long: A Repair Guy stands here.
desc: You see nothing special...

name: The Super Repair Guy
long: A Super Repair Guy stands here.
desc: He looks very tough...

name: the Cityguard
long: An off duty cityguard is standing here, drinking tea and eating donuts.
desc:
A big, strong, helpful, trustworthy guard. 
He looks well trained, and he looks like he really enjoys his donuts

name: the Loremaster
long: The loremaster is standing here, waiting for pupils
desc: She is looks very wise

name: the hunter
long: The hunter is standing here, looking for pelts
desc: he is old and seasoned

name: the Mime
long: A Mime is here miming.
desc: A Cool looking mime miming away.

name: the archer
long: The archer instructor is standing here, mending a broken bow
desc:
She looks like she knows her work well. She is dressed in dark colored
green garb that clings to her form tightly.

name: the Barbarian Guildmaster
long: Kronan the Barbarian guildmaster is standing here.
desc:
This is a very large man, arms the size of wine casks and wide as a bull.
He carries himself proudly knowing he teaches his tribe well.

name: the Kitten
long: A small loyal Kitten is here.
desc: The Kitten looks like a cute, little, fierce fighter.

name: the Puppy
long: A small loyal Puppy is here.
desc: The Puppy looks like a cute, little, fierce fighter.

name: the Beagle
long: A small, quick, loyal Beagle is here.
desc: The Beagle looks like a fierce fighter.

name: the Rottweiler
long: A large, loyal Rottweiler is here.
desc: The Rottweiler looks like a strong, fierce fighter.

name: the Wolf
long: A large, trained Wolf is here.
desc: The Wolf looks like a strong, fearless fighter.

name: the Maid
long: The Maid is here, waiting to take your order.
desc:
She is very beautiful with golden hair, and deep blue eyes. A good reason
for coming here more often.

name: the Sexton
long: A Sexton is standing here, drinking hot tea.
desc: The Sexton looks like he is relaxing after another grave digging job.

name: the Swan
long: A swan is swimming around in the pond.
desc: The white swan is very elegant.

name: the Duckling
long: A duckling is swimming around in the pond.
desc: The duckling is adorable, it looks most of all like a tiny fur ball.

name: the Sparrow
long: A sparrow is flapping around on the ground.
desc: The sparrow looks like it is enjoying life.

name: the Duck
long: A duck is here, quacking happily.
desc: The duck is quite fat.  It looks like it is enjoying life.

name: the Chief
long: The Chief Guard is looking very upset.
desc: A very angry chief.

name: the Cityguard
long: A cityguard stands here, looking very upset.
desc: A big, strong, angry guard.  He looks very well trained.

name: the Secretary
long: A secretary is sitting at the desk, typing away on the typewriter.
desc:
She looks very busy.

>
The Secretary says 'Sorry, but the Mayor is extremely busy today.'
The Secretary says 'Please sit down and have a seat in the meantime.'

name: the Mayor
long: The Mayor is sitting in his huge chair, snoring loudly.
desc: He looks like an old, overworked and underpaid man.

name: the Town Crier
long: The Town Crier is here, weeping quietly.
desc: He is very good at his job - completely dissolved in tears.

sounds.near: The Town Crier sobs sadly.
sounds.far: You hear a sobbing sound.

name: the cat
long: Papi's favorite cat is resting here, purring gently.
desc:
This is just about the most huggable cat you have ever seen! You notice
that the cat has exceptionally big claws - guess it's nothing to worry
about as long as you leave it alone.

name: A Skeleton
long: A bony skeleton is here.
desc:
The skeleton is man size and has no clothing or armor. The undead monster
is equiped with a single sword.

loads.roomName: A Gravel Road on the Graveyard
A Gravel Road on the Graveyard
A Gravel Road on the Graveyard

name: A Ghoul
long: An ugly ghoul is here.
desc:
The ghoul is man size and is looking at you with hunger. He moves toward 
you hoping to get his fangs locked into your neck.

name: A zombie
long: A normal sized zombie is here.
desc:
The zombie is about the size of a normal sized human. The zombie is
wearing rags for cloths and there are ugly sores found all over his
body. He is equipped with only a sword.

name: A wight
long: An evil wight is here.
desc:
The wight is long dead and looks at you with hateful eyes. He moves toward
you slowly with his weapon drawn.

name: An ogre
long: A Large Ogre is here.
desc:
The ogre is dull brown with dark black hair. He wears a loincloth and carries
a large club.

name: An ogre chieftain
long: An Ogre Chieftain screams at you.
desc: The ogre mage chieftain is tall and has brownish skin and dark-green eyes.

name: A large bugbear
long: A large bugbear rushes toward you.
desc:
The skin of the bugbear is light brown and the hair is dark brown. He is
wearing a skin that has been tanned.

name: The Ghost
long: The ghost flies toward you.
desc:
This ghost is not your friendly Casper variety. He wields nothing but
causes great fear in you instead.

name: A Ghast
long: A Ghast is here
desc:
The insubstantial ghast stands before you. His form is disgusting as this
must have been a particulary ugly warrior.

name: A Hell Hound
long: A Hell Hound growls at you.
desc: The Hell Hound is dark red with sooty black teeth.

name: The Very Evil Lich
long: A Very Evil Lich is here.
desc:
The lich looks as if he comes from skeletal origins. His eyes burn holes 
in your soul. He is dressed in very nice but rotting robes.

name: The Medusa
long: The medusa peers at you.
desc:
The medusa has the face of a hideous human with snakes for hair. The eyes
peer at you with red sockets.

name: The minotaur
long: The minotaur springs to attack.
desc:
The minotaur is a largish brute with horns for decoration in his head.
He wields a large flail.

name: A Spirit Naga
long: A Spirit Naga slithers toward you.
desc:
The Spirit Naga is a largish looking snake colored black with crimson bands.
The head has a very human appearance.

name: A Nightmare
long: A Jet Black Hell Horse is standing here.
desc:
Horselike with a huge head, the Nightmare stands with glowing eyes,
orange nostrils, and red hooves. The coat the jet black and the mane 
and tail are matted and rugged.

name: A Spectre
long: A Spectre is standing here.
desc:
The spectre is a long dead human that is well dressed and peers at 
you with haunting eyes.

name: A large troll
long: A Large Troll steps toward you.
desc: The troll is putred gray with matted black hair. The eyes are dull black.

name: A trembling hunchback
long: A trembling hunchback cowers from you.
desc:
The hunchback has the normal large "hump" on his upper back. He has
very fearful eyes. As he looks at you a sign of hope enters his eyes.
As he takes a closer look the fear returns.

name: A Vampire
long: A Dark Vampire grins at you.
desc: The Vampire is dressed in a dark cloak and has long white fangs.

name: Rilke the Demon
long: Rilke the Demon Stand grinning at you.
desc:
Rilke is a fat demon lord who stands very tall. His gray body is covered
with hair and his head is goat-like. Wings sprout from his body and he
has a long whip for a tail.

name: Balor the Demon
long: Balor the mighty Demon stands here.
desc:
Balor is a tall dark lord with a large wingspan. He is covered
with solid black hair and has ivory white horns.

name: Mahat the Devil
long: Mahat the Devil stares at you with piercing eyes.
desc: Mahat is a bony devil that delights in your suffering.

name: Dogretch the Evil Devil
long: Dogretch the Devil grins at you, then rushes to attack.
desc:
Dogretch the devil has scaly gray skinwith a long tail.
Atop his head are two very large horns.

name: Slavalous The Devil
long: Slavalous The Devil Sits here smiling at you.
desc:
Slavalous is a handsome man that has full control of his capabilities.
He is dressed in a full length jet black cape and has two
short, but very distinct horns on top his head.

name: A froghemoth
long: A froghemoth swims here.
desc:
The froghemoth is a large "froglike' thing with several
tentacles sprouting from his body.

name: The skeleton King
long: A large bony skeleton is standing here.
desc:
A large very bony creature who in his past life was one of 
importance begins moving toward you.

name: the guildmaster
long: Cel the mage guildmaster stands here.
desc: An old man peering through ancient tomes rests here.

name: the guildmaster
long: Gonde the Cleric guildmaster stands here.
desc: An older man wrapped in purple, long-flowing robes meditates here.

name: the guildmaster
long: Kolack the Warrior guildmaster stands here.
desc: A smaller man dressed in nothing but a tunic stands here waiting to train you.

name: the guildmaster
long: Frond the Rogue guildmaster stands here.
desc:
A small hobbit dressed in black rests in the corner. As you enter he grabs
a knife an throws it at you. It lands the wall next to your left ear. We
will now begin, is all he says.

name: the receptionist
long: A dark skinned, veiled woman greets you from behind the desk.
desc:
This Arabian beauty is obviously the daughter of some high ranking
official. As you attempt to sneak a peek under her veil you notice
a small moon-shaped birthmark on her left cheek.

name: the old withered mage/bartender
long: An old withered mage/bartender leans against the bar.
desc: He looks distracted as he pours five drinks at once without error.

name: Brother John
long: Brother John, lead singer for the Lokettes stands on stage.
desc: You see the lead singer of the Lokettes lip syncing to an old Zeppelin tune.

name: a panhandler
long: A panhandler rests here.
desc: A small skinny man rests here hoping to find a warm heart.

sounds.near: The panhandler says 'Something for the lady?'
sounds.far: You hear some talking nearby.

name: a panhandler
long: A panhandler rests here.
desc: A small skinny man rests here staring at your clothes.

sounds.near: The panhandler says 'Something for your mother?'
sounds.far: You hear talking nearby.

name: a beggar
long: A grubby beggar sits here in the filth.
desc: This poor soul seems down on his luck, perhaps you might spare a dime?

sounds.near: A beggar says 'Alms fer de po' ?'
sounds.far: You hear some groveling nearby.

name: the baker
long: The baker stands here playing solitaire.
desc: You see a large man in a white apron covered in flour from head to toe.

name: the shopkeeper
long: The shopkeeper stands here.
desc: You see a half-elf sitting on a stool behind his counter.

name: the banker
long: A banker stands here waiting to help you.
desc: This small hobbit seems adept at counting money.

name: Ahkeem the tailor
long: Ahkeem the tailor welcomes you to his store.
desc:
This middle-aged man looks over you with disdain and quickly suggests a new
wardrobe.

name: Vera the veggie lady
long: Vera the veggie lady beams as you look over her stand.
desc: A tall slender elf stands before you smiling broadly.

name: Butch the meat cutter
long: Butch the meat cutter stands here in his bloodied apron.
desc:
This stocky dwarf has a mad glint in his eye as he twirls his clever
carelessly into the air.

name: Abdul the armorer
long: Abdul stands here, waiting to help you.
desc:
Abdul returns your gaze with a steady eye. You quickly glance away under
his cold stare and place your order.

name: Igor the weaponsmith
long: Igor stands here doing... something.
desc: You see a small dwarf with a large hump on his left shoulder.

name: Cassandra
long: Cassandra stands proudly over her selection.
desc:
You see a happy weather-worn face whose lines suggest many years on the
open sea. It is only through years of fishing that she is able to withstand
the smell that permeates the air.

name: the foreman
long: The foreman stands here screaming at the workers.
desc:
A worried working dwarf stands here constantly making notes in his
book and looking at his watch.

sounds.near: The foreman yells obscenities at the workers.
sounds.far: You hear shouting nearby.

name: a construction worker
long: A construction worker steadily works here.
desc: A large sweaty looking man doesn't even return your glance.

name: The statue of Conner
long: The statue of Conner stands here.
desc:
A statue made of solid marble depicts the mighty Highlander defeating
the Kurgan in swordplay.

desc: The large half-orc quickly glances you over and returns to his duties.

name: the skinny kid

A magnificent winged steed, this horse looks much like the Arabian

You see a very healthy female dressed in black, with long flowing
hair to match her outfit.

You see one of the Royal Guards from Shadowdale who seems to have gone
through some training.

You see a really big guy here who seems to have lost an eye in one manner

You see the largest horse you have ever seen before. Standing 10' at the
shoulder he breathes flame from his nostrils and leaps to protect
his love.

You see a half wolf- half human beast wearing a glove with long thin
blades on it.

hot near this thing!

The creature's eyes are glowing black, and the body is scarlet and orange,
crimson and purple-blue, yellow and orange. These colors are ever-changing.
You see small flames burst from its' body from time to time.

desc:
This thing looks like a yellowish hedgehog but bigger. Its head is Skull
like.. eek!

name: the ice monster
long: A man-like creature made of ice is standing here.
desc: This humanoid is vaguely human at best. It's cold alright :)

desc:
You can just make out a creature in the smoke! There are two eyes
and a vague mouth.

name: the magma monster

desc:
The creature is half humanoid from the waist up. The bottom half
is pure magma. It's hot around this creature.

name: the ooze monster

desc:
This creature is a liquid mass of dark writhing tendrils. It's looks
like a mudman.

This creature is the best of monkeys, camels, lions, and eagles. Weird
to say the least.

name: the shade mage

desc:
The mage looks gloomy and is brooding. He's wearing dark clothes, his
skin and eyes are dusky and gray.

name: the shade thief
long: A thief cloaked in shadows is standing here.
desc:
The thief looks very unhappy. But sneaky! He's wearing pitch black 
clothes. His eyes and skin are dusky and gray.

name: the shade warrior
long: A fighter in plate mail is cloaked in shadows is relaxing here.
desc:
The fighter looks grim and unhuman. He's wearing black plate mail.
He's carrying a large two-handed sword. His eyes and skin are dusky
and gray.

name: the shade cleric
long: A cleric in plate mail is cloaked in shadows is standing here.
desc:
The cleric looks very sad. He's wearing dark blue plate mail. 
She's carrying a large morning star. Her eyes and skin are
dusky and gray.

name: the red guardian
long: A man-like creature is standing guard in front of the door.
desc:
The guardian is wearing plate mail and wielding a BIG AX! You 
can just see his eyes. They look dull and lifeless.

name: the thri-kreen
long: A insect warrior is standing here, looking for humans to kill.
desc: A insect but bigger! It's carrying weird weapons.. It looks mean!

desc:
The Ogre Lord has plate mail armor, and is using weird weapons. They are
large glowing weapons made from bone!

desc:
This is a woman with horns on her head. She has small wings on her
back.

name: the babau
long: A tall skeleton in form-fitting black leather is standing here.
desc:
This is a skeleton like demon. Its' arms, legs, and head are hill
giant sized.

desc: It's a demon not an animal eek..

This ugly creature was 4 fly-like hind legs and grasps with its 
forelimbs, which are equipped with strong, chitinous, pincer
fingers.

The creature has fur that's dirty gray. The creature's tail and face

The creature is dark brown. It's eyes are orange. It has a big nasty
stinger that its tries to impale you with!

desc:
This creature is huge over 300 pounds at least. It's covered in white fur.
Its' eyes are pale blue. Its' claws and teeth are ivory white.

The guard has chain mail armor on. It is holding a long sword. It looks

desc:
The elite guard has plate mail armor on. It's holding a great sword!
It looks very fast and nasty!

desc: A plain cat humanoid, nothing special about it at all.

desc: The cat has an apron on. It has a big meat cleaver in one paw.

desc:
The king of the cats is wearing all plate mail. He is holding a large weapon!
This cat looks very fast in his armor and very very tough!

name: the female cat person
long: This cat humanoid is wearing silks and pretty clothing. She lying on the bed.
desc: This creature is very beautiful for a cat. No weapons no nothing!

long: A dirty and very ugly oversized Ogre is standing here making a mess!
desc:
Dirty is not the work for this creature! Just wearing some animal skins
and faking work is all its going! This ogre looks bigger than what you are used
to seeing!

This little kitten looks like a miniature of Big Guy and has many

This little kitten is the brother of Little Guy and looks like a
lighter colored version of him.

the hordes of walking dead following him around...
