desc: A pigmy guardian is here alertly watching for intruders.

name: A pigmy revolutionary
long: A pigmy revolutionary stands here.
desc:
This pigmy's skin is plate white, but his eyes blaze a fierce blue.
He looks at you with anticipation, almost as if he was expecting
you to do something.

name: A pigmy cook
long: A pigmy cook is here cooking yummy food.
desc:
The pigmy cook is rather plump and out of shape.  He is covered
in flour and other unidentifiable substances.  Perhaps if you
shoved him in the oven he would make a rather tasty morsel.

name: A pigmy executioner
long: A pigmy executioner stands here.
desc:
A pigmy executioner stands here, his pale skin radiating a weak light.
He grins at your arrival and picks up his axe ready to lop off your head.

name: A pigmy jail guard
long: A pigmy jail guard is here guarding the jail.
desc:
The pigmy jail guard is as still as a rock, completely unmoving.  You
think for a minute perhaps he is dead, but then you can notice that
he is faintly breathing.

name: A pigmy jester
long: A pigmy jester stands here juggling.
desc:
The pigmy jester is dressed in bright colored clothing, and has
a permanent smile etched on his face.  His bright, cheery attitude
immediately makes you feel uneasy.

name: A pigmy storekeeper
long: A pigmy storekeeper sits here refusing to sell her goods.
desc:
The pigmy storekeeper glares at you, and mutters something about
an ugly stench invading the room.

name: A pigmy artist
long: A pigmy artist is here drawing.
desc:
The pigmy artist seems to completely ignore you, being totally involved
in her latest work of art.  Her curly silver hair and cute face could
almost be pretty, if only her skin weren't so pale.

name: A pigmy worshiper
long: A pigmy worshiper is here communing with the gods.
desc:
The pigmy worshipper is lost in concentration, sweat drips from his
nose and face from the strain.  His simple brown robes are grungy and
look as if they could use a washing.

name: A pigmy thief
long: A pigmy thief is here sneaking in the shadows.
desc:
The pigmy thief is small and stealthy.  He creeps along with near complete
silence.  His simple black grab makes him well adapted to his work.

name: A pigmy cleric
long: A pigmy cleric stands here praying to the gods.
desc:
The pigmy cleric notices you looking and let's out a bloodthirsty 
battle cry as he draws forth his mace.

name: A pigmy mage
long: A pigmy mage is here.
desc:
A pigmy mage is here dressed in dark robes and wearing 
an ugly pointed hat.  He notices you and starts to mutter
words of strange and evil magic.

name: A pigmy guard sub-captain
long: A pigmy guard sub-captain stands here awaiting orders.
desc:
A pigmy guard sub-captain is in an excellent physical condition.
You know it must have taken him years of work to get his muscles
to bulge in the manner that they do.

name: A pigmy guard captain
long: A pigmy guard captain stands here.
desc:
The pigmy guard captain stands at attention here, barking orders to his
sub-commanders.

name: A pigmy guard
long: A pigmy guard stands here guarding his city.
desc:
The pigmy guard is alertly watching the area for signs of trouble or
intruders such as yourself.

name: The pigmy king
long: The pigmy king stands here growling at your intrusion.
desc:
The pigmy king is extremely large for a pigmy, his skin is coal black
rather than the sickly white you are used to seeing.  His eyes glow
red as he charges forward and attacks.

name: The pigmy queen
long: The pigmy queen stands here by her husband.
desc:
The pigmy queen is beautiful beyond all belief, her skin is tanned,
her long black hair hangs down to her shoulders and her blue eyes
gaze intently at you.  She holds a stunning dagger at the ready.

name: A pigmy citizen
long: A pigmy citizens stands here.
desc: A pigmy citizens wanders about on his daily routine of life.

name: A pigmy sentry
long: A pigmy sentry stands here on guard.
desc: A pigmy sentry is here guarding the entrance to his wonderful city.

name: A trapper
long: A trapper is here trying to disguise itself.
desc:
The trapper is rather large about 10 feet by 10 feet shaped as
a rough square.  It's skin look just like the tunnel you are walking in.

name: A giant slug
long: A giant slug slithers along here.
desc: The giant slug is pale gray, and it's underbelly is dead white.

name: An animated suit of armor
long: An animated suit of armor is here mining.
desc:
The animated suit of armor is dust covered and squawks slightly
as it works.  From you best guess it is made out of bits and

pieces of plate and chain mail.

name: A gnome librarian
long: A gnome librarian is here filing away documents.
desc:
The gnome librarian is wearing a simple brown cloak and tunic and appears
to be engrossed in her work.

name: An observing gnome
long: An observing gnome sits here looking out the windows.
desc:
The gnome is completely distracted looking out the window and 
jotting notes down on his shirt sleeve.

name: A gnome guard
long: A gnome guard is here guarding the entrance to his wonderful city.
desc:
The gnome guard looks tired, his armor seems to sag around
his short body.

name: The gnome head inventor
long: The gnome head inventor is here looking depressed.
desc: The head gnome inventor looks depressed about something.

name: A gnome inventor
long: A gnome inventor is here dreaming up new ideas.
desc:
The gnome inventor looks lost in thought, after a few seconds he 
looks up at you, scratches his head and goes back to thinking.

name: An orc cleric
long: An orc cleric is here.
desc:
The orc cleric looks rather good for being a member of the 
orchish race, perhaps he's half-orcish?  He displays his
holy symbol proudly before he draws his morning star and attacks.

name: A chief's wife
long: A chief's wife is standing here trying to look pretty.

name: An orc captain
long: An orc captain stands here barking orders.
desc:
The orc captain is fat and ugly, and slobbers while he speaks.
If it weren't for the fact he were so big he would probably
banned from the orc community.

name: The orc chief
long: The orc chief stands here growling, snarling and foaming.
desc:
The orc chief is huge for an orc, perhaps his mother or father
was part ogre.  His teeth are stained yellow and his hide is
an ugly brown.

name: A common orc
long: A common orc stands here going about his daily duties.
desc:
The common orc glares at you for intruding his home but goes back
to his duties of cleaning and talking.

name: An orc fighter
long: An orc fighter stands here protecting his home.
desc:
The orc fighter look ready for a fight.  He also looks very capable
of dispatching intruders such as yourself.

name: A margoyle
long: A margoyle is here hiding in the rocks.
desc:
The margoyle looks very much like a gargoyle, but has horns coming out
of it's head and back.  Upon seeing you it cackles with delight and rushes
into to attack.

name: The dervish
long: The raggedy dervish walks on aimlessly.
desc:
Dressed in loose fitting rags, this man looks like he could use
some rest.

name: The dervish
long: The large dervish watches for signs of trouble.
desc:
Dressed in loose fitting rags, this man looks like he could use
LOTS of rest.

name: The coral snake
long: A brightly colored snake slithers along the sands.
desc:
This relatively harmless snake has bright alternating bands of red, yellow
and black.

name: The small scorpion
long: A small, red scorpion scuttles away at your approach.
desc: The little tail is mighty dangerous for such a small creature.

name: The giant, purple sand worm
long: A giant, purple sand worm thrusts up out of the sand and attacks!
desc: He's EXTREMELY big, mean, and purple. Watch out!

name: The brass dragon
long: A very large brass dragon steps out of the darkness and says "Hello".
desc:
This is a very large lizard like creature.  It's burnished brass scales
gleam in the light from your torch.

name: The nomad leader
long: The nomad leader sits silently in prayer.
desc:
He is clad in silk robes lined with gold thread. At his side
is a large, engraved cutlass. He has an especially haughty air
about him.

name: The nomad commander
long: The nomad commander stands here staring suspiciously at you.
desc:
This is the nomad leader's second in command. His clothes are richly
woven of silk and gold thread. A nasty cutlass hangs at his side.

name: The nomad warrior
long: A proud nomad warrior stands here.

name: The slave
long: A young slave sits here staring at you with pleading eyes.

name: The dracolich
long: A pile of bones rises up to form a skeletal dracolich.
desc:
The dracolich is now only bone with pieces of flesh hanging from it.
Obviously it no longer fears death.

name: The drider
long: The drider looks at you with anger while it draws its sword.
desc: This half-spider, half-drow creature is a formidable opponent.

loads.roomName: At the foot of the rubble

name: The dark dwarf
long: A duergar is here mining precious stones with his pick.
desc: The duergar could crush your head as easily as it does those rocks.

name: The myconoid
long: A myconoid lumbers along peacefully.
desc:
The myconoid looks something like a giant mushroom (and probably
has the same effect).

name: The myconoid shaman
long: A rather large myconoid stands here chanting in a strange tongue.
desc: The shaman shoots spores into the air.

name: The dustdigger
long: A small oasis invites you to dive in.

name: The rabid camel
long: A very dangerous rabid camel snorts at you.
desc: Don't mess with this animal.

name: The sand worm
long: The young sand worm launches out of the sand to attack you!
desc:
It is about 50 feet long, and looks very dangerous.  Better
flee!

name: The goblin slave
long: A goblin slave lies here asleep.
desc: The defenseless goblin begs for mercy.

name: The Drow commoner
long: A drow commoner walks around on guard duty.
desc: I doubt he is the type to give directions.

name: The drow warrior
long: The drow warrior stands here guarding his home.
desc: He looks kind of p.o.ed!

name: The drow mage noble
long: The drow mage noble is here protecting his home.
desc: The mage prepares to cast a spell...at you!!

name: The drow priestess
long: The drow priestess is here shouting orders.
desc: I wouldn't want go get on her bad side!

name: The drow master
long: The drow master stares at you angrily.
desc: The drow master is ALWAYS ready for a fight.

name: The weaponsmaster
long: the drow weaponsmaster is here shadow boxing.
desc: He definitely know his way around in combat.

name: The Matron Mother
long: The Matron Mother of the house is standing here.
desc: She looks really p.o.ed!!!!

name: Lareth
long: Lareth, the Matron Mother of the 1st house is waiting for you.
desc: She looks like she is about to rip your head of and eat it.

name: The yochlol
long: A yochlol forms out of a swirling mist.
desc: The yochlol is not in a good mood.

name: The mighty beholder
long: You meet a beholder's deadly gaze!
desc:
It has a large central eye that projects an anti-magic ray and ten
eyestalks atop the round body which can do anything from charm you
to disintegrate you.  Beholders are not known for their personality.

name: The lamia
long: A strange lamia stands here waiting for her next meal.
desc:
This is a creature with the upper torso of a beautiful woman, but the lower
body of a four-legged beast. She licks her lips as she looks at you greedily.

sounds.near: The lamia howls and shrieks at you
sounds.far: You hear a shrieking sound from nearby

loads.roomName: The private gardens and courtyard of Thalos

name: The mimic
long: A strong chest lies in one corner of the room.
desc:
A strong, wooden chest bound with iron straps and a heavy pad-lock on the
front.

name: The mimic
long: Two skeletons lie crushed under a large boulder.

name: The mimic
long: The stone floor of this house has been ripped apart.

name: The mimic
long: Some broken shards of pottery lie strewn about the floor.

name: The mimic
long: A few wooden planks lie stacked on a low shelf.

name: The horned lizard
long: A small horned lizard flicks his tongue and slithers away.
desc: A cute little lizard, that is, if you like reptiles!

name: The stone golem
long: In the corner you see a large, stone golem faithfully standing watch.
desc:
It is a big chunk of rock that has been magically formed into a giant
stone creature. He stands here still guarding the city.

name: The iron golem
long: A Huge iron golem stands here.  He raises his sword to strike you.
desc:
It has been set here to guard the nexus gate.  It will allow no intruders
to pass.

name: The lamia
long: A strange lamia stands here waiting for her next meal.
desc:
This is a creature with the upper torso of a beautiful woman, but the lower
body of a four-legged beast. She licks her lips as she looks at you greedily.

sounds.near: The lamia howls and shrieks at you
sounds.far: You hear a shrieking sound from nearby

name: The iron golem
long: A large iron golem stands here.
desc: He is large, and metallic.

name: The clay golem
long: A clay golem stands here
desc: He is large, and ceramic.

name: The stone golem
long: A stone golem stands here
desc: He looks large and granite.

name: The spectre
long: A spectre stands here, reaching out for you.
desc: He looks sad.

name: The mummy
long: A mummy gasps in astonishment at your success thus far.
desc: He looks like he wants to change your luck.

name: The statue
long: A statue of Akinra stands here, and blocks your path.
desc: He looks really mean.

loads.roomName: Altar of The Sun God Ra

name: Anubis
long: Anubis sits in his throne, wearing a glowing key.
desc: He has the body of a man, and the head of a jackal.

name: The mimic
long: An ornate chest sits in the corner.
desc: It looks well made.

name: A rust monster
long: A rust monster squats here, eagerly eyeing your armor and weapons.
desc: It looks hungry.

name: A black pudding
long: A black pudding oozes towards you.
desc: It is gelatinous and gooey.

name: The Nile crocodile
long: The Nile crocodile swallows the last of his rat appetizer.
desc: I bet you're next!

name: The guardian naga
long: The guardian naga slithers toward you to protect her lair.
desc: You are intruders, and you must die.

name: The rabid rat
long: The rabid rat scurries towards you.  Its eyes glowing deep red.
desc: They scurry into the shadows and attack en-masse.

name: John the Lumberjack
long: John the Lumberjack is here, looking for some trees to chop down.
desc:
He is six feet tall and looks quite strong, muscles bulging under his heavy,
checkered shirt.  His features are worn with hard work and his expression is
one of a peaceful man leading a simple life.

sounds.near: John says 'I'm a lumberjack, and I'm ok.'
sounds.far: You hear someone singing nearby.

loads.roomName: Outside a small cabin in the forest

name: the cute rabbit
long: A cute rabbit is here.
desc: It is a small, furry creature with long ears and big feet.

loads.roomName: An intersection in the dense forest
A small path in the dense forest
A small path in the dense forest
A small path in the dense forest

name: the brown bear
long: A big, brown, angry-looking bear is here.
desc:
The bear is a big, brown, furry animal with very large claws and very sharp
teeth.  It doesn't resemble those cute little thingies from toy shops at all.

name: the ferocious rabbit
long: A ferocious rabbit is here, glaring hungrily at you.
desc:
This small, furry creature with long ears and big feet has been attacked by
the dreaded rabbit rabies, a horrible disease that turns helpless and innocent
rabbits into ferocious and bloodthirsty monsters.

name: the fallow deer
long: A fallow deer is grazing peacefully here.
desc:
She is a graceful creature on long, slender legs, and with large, brown eyes
looking back at you with an air of watchful interest.

name: the brown fox
long: A brown fox is here, looking for some rabbits to chew up.
desc: It is a large fox with beautiful, red-brown fur and a long, thick brush.

loads.roomName: An intersection in the dense forest

name: the vicious warg
long: A vicious warg is here, snarling angrily at you.
desc:
It is an exceptionally large wolf with thick, black fur.  Saliva is dripping
quickly from its long, white fangs.  It looks quite dangerous and very angry.

loads.roomName: A small path in the deep, dark forest
A small path in the deep, dark forest

name: the ferocious warg
long: A ferocious warg is here, snarling angrily at you.
desc:
It is an exceptionally large wolf with thick, black fur.  Saliva is dripping
quickly from its long, white fangs.  It looks quite dangerous and very angry.

loads.roomName: A narrow trail through the deep, dark forest
A narrow trail through the deep, dark forest

name: the large, gray wolf
long: A large, gray wolf is here, glaring hungrily at you.
desc: The large, gray wolf eyes you with interest while licking its lips.

loads.roomName: A narrow trail through the deep, dark forest
A narrow trail through the deep, dark forest
A small path in the deep, dark forest
A small path in the deep, dark forest

name: the large, black wolf
long: A large, black wolf is here, glaring hungrily at you.
desc: The large, black wolf eyes you with interest while licking its lips.

loads.roomName: A narrow trail through the deep, dark forest
A narrow trail through the deep, dark forest
A small path in the deep, dark forest
A small path in the deep, dark forest

name: a huge ancient tree
long: A huge, ancient tree towers above you.
desc:
Its roots are extremely big and large parts of them are above ground.

>
The enormous gray trunk shivers slightly, as if sighing deeply.

loads.roomName: On the river bank in the deep, dark forest
A junction on the river bank in the deep, dark forest
A narrow trail through the deep, dark forest

name: a huge ancient tree
long: A huge, ancient tree towers above you.
desc:
Its roots are extremely big and large parts of them are above ground.
>
The enormous gray trunk emits a deep, moaning sound.

loads.roomName: A small path in the deep, dark forest

name: the huge, green dragon
long: A huge green dragon is here, its narrow yellow eyes glowing with rage.
desc:
This enormous winged serpent has dark green scales covering most of its
colossal body.  Numerous holes in its heavy wings tell of many fights as does
the nicks in the horns on its head.  It smells as disgusting as only dragons
do.

loads.roomName: The cave of the Green Dragon

name: the huge, poisonous spider
long: A huge, poisonous spider is here.
desc:
This disgusting creature is at the size of a human crawling on all four.  It
has eight hairy legs that gives it a tremendous speed on almost any surface and
sharp poisonous fangs to paralyze or kill its prey.

name: the Queen Spider
long: The huge, bulky Queen Spider is here.
desc:
This disgusting creature is at the size of a small elephant.  It has eight
huge, hairy legs that would give it a tremendous speed on almost any surface
if it wasn't so immensely fat.  Its large, bulbous eyes stare back at you.

name: Shargugh
long: Shargugh the Forest Brownie is here, grinning broadly at you.
desc:
This little fellow is only three foot tall with wild matted brown hair and long
tangled brown beard.  He wears ragged brown and green clothing and looks as if
he is having great fun.

loads.roomName: A narrow trail through the deep, dark forest

name: A Quickling commoner
long: A Quickling commoner is here, running circles around you.
desc:
The Quickling commoner is extremely fast, you almost break you neck trying
to turn your head as fast as he moves.

name: A Quickling raider
long: A Quickling raider standing here blurs into a attack position.
desc: The Quickling raider attacks you with a frenzied blood-lust.

name: A baby Quickling
long: A baby Quickling is  here, running around looking for someone to "play" with.
desc:
The baby Quicklings look kind of cute, but you are not deceived their
obviously malicious intent.

loads.roomName: The grove of the baby Quicklings.
The grove of the baby Quicklings.
The grove of the baby Quicklings.

name: The Queen of the Quicklings
long: The Queen of the Quicklings here ignores you as she orders commoners around.
desc:
The Queen of the Quicklings does not appear to acknowledge your existence
as she orders Quickling commoners to do their menial tasks.

name: The Raider Captain of the Quicklings
long: The Raider Captain is a large, extremely fast Quickling.
desc:
The Raider Captain of the Quicklings frowns at your entrance into the
barracks, and orders his troops to attack you!

name: A Quickling raider guard
long: A Quickling raider guard here blurs into a attack position.
desc: The Quickling raider guard attacks you, determined to hold his position.

name: Tephanis, King of the Quicklings
long: Tephanis glares at you with unconcealed hatred blazing in his eyes.
desc:
Tephanis is the biggest, fastest, most dangerous Quickling you've ever 
seen.  He gets off his throne angrily and rushes to attack you!

name: The Quickling look-out guard
long: The Quickling Guard here assigned to spy on Shadowdale ignores you completely.
desc:
He is hunched over some sort of spy glass which is looks through.  It 
appears to be pointed in the direction of Shadowdale.

name: King Greylin
long: King Greylin of Rhyiana is here on his throne.
desc:
King Greylin is the model of a perfect elf. He looks like a well weathered
battle vetran, but is still a handsome elf. Simply looking into his eyes
makes you aware of his great intelligence and compassion.

sounds.near: King Greylin looks at you knowingly.
sounds.far: You feel you are near a great presence.

name: The Field Worker Elf
long: A Field Worker Elf is here tending King Greylin's fields.
desc:
This elf looks like a very diligent worker. He hardly seems to notice you
except that you seem to be in his way.

name: A Noble Elf
long: A Noble Elf from the court of Rhyiana is here.
desc:
As all nobility in the land, this elf looks very wise. He nods his head
at you and smiles when he notices your look.

name: An Elven Archer
long: An Elven Archer is here, readying his bow.
desc:
The archer looks like a very sure shot. You really don't think you want to
mess with him.

name: Prince Mardren
long: Prince Mardren, brother of Greylin is here.
desc:
Prince Mardren is a man in touch with nature. Looking at his face you can tell
that he is a ranger and a champion of all things good.

name: Lord Drolchan
long:
Drolchan, Lord Chancellor of Rhyiana is here, his thoughts turned towards the
kingdom.
desc: Lord Drolchan has spent his entire life devoted to the kingdom. He is a peacefulman, but

name: The peasant
long: A village peasant is here relaxing after a hard days work.
desc: He seems to be a hard working peasant.

name: The mother wolf
long: The mother wolf is here, playing with her cubs.
desc:
The mother wolf looks very happy with her cubs, and not at all aggressive,
unless you mess with her cubs.

name: A wolf cub
long: A cute wolf cub is here.
desc: The wolf cub is very cute and licks you as he sniffs around your feet.

name: A pile of vines
long: A pile of vines is here, twisting about madly.
desc: The vines writhe with a serpentine quality.

name: The Elven Guard
long: An Elven Guard is here, protecting his kingdom.
desc:
The Elven Guard will stand at nothing to protect his kingdom and his king.
He will give his life in service to them.

name: The King's Secretary
long: The King's Secretary is here, rushing to and fro.
desc:
The King's Personal Secretary has a frantic look to her, as if great (and
quickly executed) responsibilty lies on her shoulders.

name: A maid
long: A maid is here, tidying up.
desc: The maid is very attractive, and does her job well.

name: A servant
long: A servant is here, lounging around.
desc: The servant looks like he is a little lax in his duties.

name: The butler
long: The butler stands here, looking very proper.
desc: The butler looks very suave and calm. He asks you, 'May I be of service?'

name: A prisoner
long: A prisoner is here, quaking in fear.
desc: The prisoner looks as if he fears the decision to make King Greylin an enemy.

name: The Jailor
long: The Jailor is here, dozing lightly.
desc: The Jailor seems a jolly fellow, especially considering his job in life.

name: The Hooded Torturer
long: The Hooded Torturer is here, his red eyes glowing evilly.
desc:
The Hooded Torturer looks slightly insane, as if he doesn't know you are a 
prisoner or not.

sounds.near: The Hooded Torturer throws his head back and cackles with insane glee.
sounds.far: You hear a low evil laugh.

name: The Sentinel Tree
long: The Sentinel Tree is here guarding the enterance to the kingdom.
desc: The tree is big. VERY big. You don't want to mess with it.

name: Moe the Bartender
long: Moe the Bartender is here polishing glasses.
desc: Moe is definately a bartender.

name: Queen Katriana of Rhyiana
long: Queen Katriana is here relaxing in her garden.
desc:
Queen Katriana is most likely the most beautiful woman you have ever laid your
eyes on. Her flowing black hair and lavender eyes are like none other you have
seen before.

name: a dwarven guard
long: A dwarven guard is here.
desc: The guard looks very tough and mean.

name: a dwarven worker
long: A dwarven mining worker is here.
desc: He is very dirty, and looks extremely over-worked.

loads.roomName: Path to the north of shop

name: a Night Wraith
long: A Wraith is awaiting your first move here.
desc: A black, almost transparent wraith.

name: the Hide & Tooth storekeeper
long: There is the Hide & Tooth storekeeper standing here, waiting patiently.
desc: The storekeeper is very rotund, but looks in excellent condition.

name: Granite Head the baker
long: Granite Head, the baker, is waiting for a customer here.
desc: Granite Head is covered with flour and grains.

name: The giant lizard
long: A giant lizard is here.
desc:
This scaly creature looks like it is well adapted to it's underground
habitat.  He looks very powerful.

name: The giant
long: A giant is here.
desc:
The giant is about 8 feet tall, with arms of steel, and looks in
excellent physical condition.

name: A dwarven mineworker
long: A dwarven mineworker is here.
desc: The mineworker is very tired, and very dirty, and he has bulging muscles.

name: A dwarven mine leader
long: A dwarven mine leader is here.
desc: The mine leader is very big and very strong.

name: the dwarven doctor
long: The dwarven doctor is here.
desc: He is a very skilled surgeon, with hands of steel.

name: the dwarven peon
long: A dwarven peon is awaiting help here.

name: the dwarf
long: A dwarf is here.

name: the unwanted son
long: An unwanted son is here.

name: the unwanted daughter
long: An unwanted daughter is here.

name: the barracks's guard
long: A barrack guard is here.
desc: He looks alert

name: the dwarf in waiting
long: A dwarf in waiting is here.
desc: He looks bored.

name: the mazekeeper
long: A mazekeeper is here.
desc: He looks VERY tough.

name: the giant snake
long: There is a giant snake here.
desc: You see nothing special.

name: Sir Lancelot du Lac
long: Standing here is Lancelot du Lac, the greatest among mortal men.
desc:
He looks like he has been fighting all of his life, and has yet to lose.
The courage in his cold, gray eyes is unmistakable.  Enormous muscles
bulge on his arms, and his chest appears slightly larger than the last
wine barrel you saw.  Having this man for an enemy is about the worst 
mistake one might make.

name: King Arthur
long: Arthur, king of the land, sits comfortably on his throne.
desc:
Arthur rules justly over all of Prydain, but you get the feeling that 
he has a better grasp of matters of state than he does on the ways
of his friends and family.

name: Guinevere
long: The beautiful and graceful queen, Guinevere, shines with tempting beauty.
desc: She winks suggestively at you, and you hope Arthur doesn't notice!

name: Mordred
long: The fallen knight, Mordred, stands here.
desc:
Clad in gleaming armor of solid gold, Mordred is an excellent specimen
of manhood.  A sharp spear in his right hand seems not to have been
completely cleaned of blood since his last battle.

name: Sir Galahad
long: The cleanest, most noble man you have ever seen stands here on guard.
desc:
Dressed head to toe in white samite, Galahad seems to shine from some
internal holiness.  Unlike most holy men, however, he carries a rather
large sword that appears to have seen some use.

name: A knight
long: A knight of the famous round table stands here chivalrously.
desc: As he notices your attention, he strikes a rather photogenic pose.

name: A servant
long: A serving knave from the king's kitchen stands here planning a meal.
desc: You see nothing special.

name: A squire
long: A young squire stands here, practicing to become a full fledged knight.
desc: He has sweat on his brow and a wooden sword in his hand.

name: The Fearsome Dragon
long: A fearsome dragon rests here with smoke curling out of its nostrils.
desc:
Scales like steel, claws like swords, teeth like spears, breath so
hot it melts stone, but otherwise pretty normal.

name: The Black Knight
long: A mighty warrior clad entirely in black blocks your path.
desc: He appears to have all four limbs still attached.

name: The Questing Beast
long: A large, colorful, and mean monster pounces to eat your small intestine.
desc: It looks rather ugly, but at least its colorful patterns clash.

name: Zippy the Mage
long: Zippy the Mage is irritated with you and just may kill you.
desc: It isn't polite to stare, especially at psychotic mages.

name: A bad man
long: A bad man jumps out of the foliage and hacks at you with his sword.
desc: He's bad, oooh yeah, he's bad.

name: A Castle Watchman
long: A castle watchman is standing here, making sure it doesn't run away.
desc:
He is liveried in Arthur's colors, and carries himself as though his
posture were in the job description.  He winks at you and says,
'You are safe here with me!'

name: Morganna
long:
Morganna interrupts her spell research to notice you, and decides that
your ears would make great material components.
desc: She is beautiful, but she is clearly a bitch.

name: Merlin
long: A gray harried old man putters about the room.
desc:
At first glance, you notice nothing special, but after a second, you
begin to be struck as though you are in the presence of a mighty
mage, and the timeless Merlin hides his majesty only through powerful
dweomers.

name: Hippo the Hippogriff
long: Hippo is not too well trained, and his cage is quite a mess.
desc: Part bird, part mammal, part slob, all mean.

name: Coco the Cockatrice
long: Coco the Cockatrice prowls his cage.
desc:
You don't really want to look at a cockatrice, do you?  They are damn
ugly and might make you sick to your stomach.

name: Sir Gawain
long: Sir Gawain lives here in the lap of luxury.
desc:
He is well dressed, well groomed, and well trained in fighting.  If
he can fight half as well as he can curry favor in court, he is darn
tough.

name: The Master of Arms
long: The Master of Arms is here, wondering why he has to train nincompoops.
desc:
He is well seasoned in the ways of war.  Scars cover most of his exposed
torso, and tattoos pretty much get the rest.  He is equally comfortable
with virtually any weapon, but he prefers to pummel people with his
iron-like fists.

name: The Antipaladin
long: A warrior of pure evil is eager to kill you and drink your blood.
desc:
He is everything your mother warned you about.  He is tall and strong,
armored in black armor, with a large black sword in his right hand.
His forehead is marked with the sign of his guild, a black heart.

name: The Master of Antipaladins
long: The Master of Antipaladins stands here, ready to slay for the cause.
desc:
In all ways dark, this man represents all that the knights of the 
table seek to destroy.  He looks as though he could even give the
mighty Lancelot du Lac a good fight.

name: A Dog of War
long: A Dog of War sits here, ready to fight for its master.
desc:
Five feet tall at the shoulder, this hellish canine looks big enough
to swallow children whole.  An evil red glow emanates from its eyes,
and its long, sharp teeth are exposed as it growls evilly.

name: The Statue of Haag
long:
An enormous statue of the patron stands here, and no antipaladin dares
speak its terrible name.
desc:
Haag is portrayed here in all of his terrible majesty.  Dwarfing his 
giant dogs, the statue scares the sh-- out of all sane people in the
room.  Each of his fists is larger than your head, and he looks like
he could squeeze coal into diamonds.  An angry fire in his eyes echoes
the evil glow of the black amulet about his neck.

name: The fire demon
long: You feel nauseated as you approach a demonic figure
desc: It appears to be formed of fire and diamonds, and it loves to kill!

name: The Ice Golem
long: An Ice Golem stands here, guarding the way to Zippy's hangout.
desc:
He is a 12 foot tall man fashioned out of ice, and doesn't seem to be
much of a conversationalist.

name: The Grail
long: The Holy Grail is sitting in the corner of this room.
desc: It is a beautiful chalice like none you have found before.

name: The Midget
long: The smallest man you have ever seen looks up at you defiantly.
desc:
The midget is a very small man with contempt for anyone over three
feet tall.

name: The fat lady
long: An extremely large woman winks seductively at you.
desc: This woman looks to have been brought up in a donut shop.

sounds.near: The fat lady sings.
sounds.far: You hear singing near by.

name: The ugly man
long: A disgusting man is standing here popping zits.
desc:
You try to keep from hurling as you look into the face of the most
disgusting person you have ever seen.

sounds.near: The ugly man pops a zit into your face.
sounds.far: You hear a popping sound.

name: The three armed man.
long: The three armed man sits comfortably in his chair.
desc: You see nothing special.

name: The gorilla
long: A very hairy man is here.
desc:
A low sloping forehead and lots of hair are covered up with a
cheep hat and a set of jams.

sounds.near: The hairy man grunts.
sounds.far: You hear grunting nearby.

name: Fat Frank
long: Fat Frank stands here covered in pizza sauce.
desc: You see nothing special.

sounds.near: Frank slurps pizza sauce off of his finger and burps loudly.
sounds.far: You hear a loud belch.

name: The sword swallower
long: A tall man stands here with many swords hanging off his belt.
desc:
The sword swallower returns your gaze with a grin. His dark eyes
quickly have you sized up.

name: The flame blower
long: A dark skinned man stands here putting out fires.
desc:
The flame blower looks to have burnt all of his hair off in a 
recent accident.  Don't mention it to him or he night do the 
same to you.

name: The master juggler
long: The master juggler stands here sharpening his swords.
desc:
The master juggler looks very handy with a sword or just about any
other weapon you could think of. Scars run all up and down his
leathery arms.

sounds.near: The master juggler carefully sharpens his sword.
sounds.far: You hear a grinding sound.

name: The prestidigitator
long: A tall old man sits here studying an old book.
desc:
The prestidigitator looks old, but in his eyes you see a glimmer
of knowledge beyond your comprehension.

name: The tarot reader
long: An old woman sits here behind a large crystal ball.
desc: She looks back at you knowingly.

name: The fair greeter
long: A large man stands here bellowing out welcome to all.
desc:
The fair greeter is dressed in wild colors and has a contagious smile
on his face.

sounds.near: The fair greeter welcomes you heartily.
sounds.far: You hear someone yelling nearby.

name: The fair juggler
long: A juggler from the fair is here juggling dangerously.
desc: This is a student of the master juggler.

name: Cave giant
long: A large and mean cave giant stands here.
desc: You see nothing special.

name: Ice Dragon
long: A large white dragon is here, making snow-men and stepping on them.
desc: The Ice-dragon looks like it hasn't eaten in a while.

loads.roomName: Lair of the Great White Dragon

name: The Herald of Prydain
long: The Herald of Prydain is here, spreading the news.
desc: He is dressed in Arthur's colors.

sounds.near: The Herald announces some important news.
sounds.far: You hear excited jabbering.

name: the Killer Penguin
long: The Killer Attack Penguin is standing here.
desc:
Penguin is a small Arctic bird with a sharp beak and an evil look in its eye.
It also has blood stains around its beak.

loads.roomName: The Lair of the Great and Terrible Emperor Penguin

name: the huge, white dragon
long: A huge white dragon is here, its narrow red eyes glowing with rage.
desc:
This enormous winged serpent has snow white scales covering most of its
colossal body.  Numerous holes in its huge wings tell of many fights as does
the nicks in the horns on its head.  It smells as disgusting as only dragons
do.

name: the silver dragon
long: The Noble Silver dragon stares at you curiously.
desc:
The silver dragon stares at you, in dismay, as it wakes when you
arrives.  It says 'Oh, adventures welcome to my lair....', while
it moves closer she tells you,'Beware there is a White dragon in this
area...'

name: the Killer Emperor Penguin
long: The Killer Emperor Attack Penguin is here cooling its heels.
desc:
The Emperor Penguin is a largest of the penguins with a sharp beak and an evil
look in it's eye. It has a bright yellow feathers on the top of it's head
blood stains around it's beak.

loads.roomName: The Lair of the Great and Terrible Emperor Penguin

name: the Polar Bear
long: A Polar bear is here, sniffing the air for food.
desc:
A BIG Polar bear is here looking at you as thou you would make a nice midnight
snack. *YUMMY*

name: the owlbear
long: A Large Owlbear is here.
desc:
The Owlbear has brownish-black to yellow fur and feather. The beaks of these
creatures are yellow to ivory. The eyes are red-rimmed and exceedingly
terrible to behold.

name: the snow owl
long: A white snow owl is perched here.
desc: He looks pretty mean.

name: the Arctic fox
long: the large Arctic fox is here.
desc: The Fox looks like a large, mean look creature.

name: the seal
long: A Seal is sitting here, flashing it's big blue eyes at you.
desc: The Seal looks so cute that you wish you could just hug it.

name: the Walrus
long: The Walrus is here, wondering what in blizzard's name you are doing here.
desc:
He is six feet long and looks quite strong, muscles bulging under his heavy,
coat of blubber.  His features are worn with hard work and one of his tusks is
broken half off.

name: the cute mink
long: A cute mink is here.
desc: It is a small, furry creature with a very thick fur coat.

name: the yeti
long: A big, white, angry-looking yeti is here.
desc:
The yeti is a big, white, furry animal with very large claws and very sharp
teeth.  It doesn't resemble those cute little thingies from toy shops at all.

name: the ferocious snow crow
long: A ferocious snow crow is here, glaring hungrily at you.
desc:
This small, feathered bird with long sharp peak and feet has been attacked by
the dreaded rabies, a horrible disease that turns helpless and innocent
creatures into ferocious and bloodthirsty monsters.

name: the moose
long: A moose is grazing peacefully here.
desc:
She is a huge creature standing on long, slender legs, and with brown eyes,
and a large set of horns looking back at you with an air of watchful interest.

name: the brown yak
long: A brown yak is here, looking for some plants to chew up.
desc: It is a large yak with beautiful, red-brown fur and a long, thick brush.

name: Jack Frost
long: Jack Frost is here, staring angrily at you.
desc:
He is an exceptionally large, Snow white man with ice cycles for hair. The only
color you see are the red stains on his teeth and hands.

name: the reindeer
long: The Reindeer is here, looking for some grass to eat.
desc:
The Reindeer has a small red harness around his neck as if it once he had
pulled a sled.

name: the Siberian Husky
long: A Siberian Husky is standing here looking strong an proud.
desc: A big, strong, helpful, trustworthy Siberian Husky

name: the Otter
long: A small Otter is here.
desc: The Otter looks like a cute, little, fierce fighter.

name: the Ice Lemure
long: A large, Ice lemure is staring at you hungrily.
desc: The Ice Lemur looks like he would eat even you in a few days.

name: the woolly mammoth
long: A large mammoth is here, slowly clambering along.
desc: The Mammoth looks like it would take a lot to bring him down.

name: the Snow Snake
long: The huge, bulky Snow Snake is here.
desc:
The Large Snow Snake lies here staring at you with beady red eyes. The scales
that armor its body are such a bright white that he is almost
impossible to see against the snow in which he sleeps.  As you enter he
stirs from his sleep and coils...prepared to ATTACK!!!!!!!

name: the Snow Lizard
long: The Snow Lizard stares at you.
desc: The Snow Lizard is very thin. His scales are almost as white as snow.

name: the Frost Giant
long: The Frost Giant is here playing in the snow.
desc:
The Frost Giant has long woolly looking fur all about his body. His eyes are
dark and hollow as if no one or thing is behind them. He stands about 15 feet
tall and 400 pounds. It is quite obvious that such a large creature requires a
lot of food. He smiles hungrily at you!!

name: the purple dragon
long: The Dreaded Purple dragon stares at you curiously.
desc:
Here stands the Dreaded Purple dragon.. He looks at you for a second 
considering eating you but, changes his mind because you don't look tasty...
Yawning deeply he looks like he might fall asleep at any moment.

loads.roomName: The Lair of The Purple Dragon

name: the Winter Thief
long: A thief, all dressed in a snow white suit.
desc: You saw what?? or Who??

name: the computer bug
long: A little, hairy computer bug is here, trying to mess things up.
desc:
It is one of those irritating little creatures that like to infect innocent
and defenseless programs, trying to make them act weird.  Programmers spend
countless hours trying to eliminate them, but they are indeed very hardy.
DikuMUD is known to be one of their favorite habitats.

name: Isha the Dark Elf
long: Isha the Dark Elf is here, observing you silently.
desc:
She is no less than beautiful, skin as dark as the night and hair shining like
silver in the moonlight.  Her slender body is adorned with a sleeveless shirt
and a short skirt made from black scales joined with silver threads.  Her back
is covered by a large, hooded cloak as black as her skin and in her broad
silver belt hangs a long, slender sword in a silver scabbard.

name: Death
long: Death the Grim Reaper is observing you silently from empty eye sockets.
desc: The dark-robed skeletal figure radiates an unendurable coldness.

name: The horrifying Mudmonster
long: A horrifying Mudmonster is slowly evolving from the mud ...
desc:
It sure looks like something out of a horror movie. It strongly resembles
a huge figure made up from mud alone, and it sure looks like it had human 
flesh for breakfast and is strongly intent on having the same for dinner
- Perhaps you?

loads.roomName: A muddy bend in the sewer system
A muddy bend in the sewer system

name: The small bat
long: The small fierce-looking bat is hanging from the ceiling, obviously sleeping.
desc:
You have never in your entire life seen such a mean looking small creature,
though it looks rather peaceful, hanging there, sleeping. The thought of 
arousing this cruel creature doesn't appeal to you

name: The Great Sewer Rat
long: The Huge Hungry-looking Sewer Rat sits here
desc: It is large, and very hungry looking

sounds.near: The Huge rat squeaks and scurries about
sounds.far: You hear a strange scurrying and squeaking nearby.

loads.roomName: A junction in the sewer pipes

name: The small Spider
long: The small hairy Spider

name: The giant earth beetle
long: The Giant Mean-looking Earth Beetle

name: The maggot
long: The Giant Maggot

name: The slithering snake
long: The snake slithers towards you

loads.roomName: The narrow ledge going east to west

name: The evil wanderer
long: The evil wanderer stares at you
desc: The evil wanderer is very thin. He is dressed in a gray cloak.

name: the creature homonculous
long: The creature homonculous is here, looking at you with an evil look.
desc:
The Homonculous appears in a man-like form, about 18'' tall, have a
greenish, reptilian skin, leathery wings, and a bat like mouth, with
teeth passing on a venom.

name: The Grand Knight of Paladins
long: The Grand Knight is standing here, waiting for someone to help.
desc:
The Knight is standing here, smiling at you. He is dressed all in
white, blue and silver. He looks VERY strong, as he stands here, ready to
help the innocent.

name: the evil chr-eff'n
long: The chr-eff'n is crawling here, looking around with its yellow eyes.
desc:
The head and torso of a chr-eff'n is copper-covered, with yellow
glowing eyes. The lower body is in an orange shading.

name: the shadowy morkoth
long: The morkoth are standing here, waiting for someone to KILL!
desc:
It's a five feet tall, shadow monster. This has the shape between
a human and a rat. It breaths very heavily, while it stares at you.

name: Madam Esther
long: Madam Esther is standing here, trying to sell dust.
desc:
She is very big standing here, smiling to you. She looks like the
mother of the town, sometimes playing with the children, sometimes 
helping the old people, with their daily work. All this in spite of
her own hard work.

name: The red dragon
long: The Red fierce-looking dragon stares at you angrily
desc:
The red dragon stares at you, angrily, as he wakes when you
arrives.  He says 'Oh, human YOU woke me up...Hsssss', as
he moves closer ,'Can one NEVER sleep in peace..Hssss'.

name: The sea hag
long: The Sea Hag is swimming around here
desc:
The sea hag is so ghastly looking that you feel the deepest
fear. Big yellow eyes and sharp teeth. Its ears are very big,
and it have small sharp horns. This type of monsters are one of
the greatest haters of beauty (Next after Medusa).

loads.roomName: The south end of the pool

name: The guardian naga
long: The Guardian Naga looks kindly at you.
desc:
The naga are a snake-liked creature. She is covered in green-gold
scale with silvery triangles along her back. Her eyes are golden.
She notice that you look at her, and she says: 'Watch out. This way
leads to some evil creatures'.

name: The scaled basilisk
long: The scaled Basilisk crawls towards you slowly.
desc:
The basilisk is a reptilian monster. It has eight legs, and a strong
toothy jaws. It is dull brown with yellowish underbelly. It's eyes are
glowing pale green.

name: The lemure
long: The lemure blob slithers terribly precisely towards you for an attack!
desc:
This looks like a vaguely human blob. Big black yellow eyes, and a
mouth going a little bit out from the face. The lemure does not look
interested in you at all, but anyway it attacks. It looks like it's
mind has been burned out.

name: Jones 'cruncher' the ettin
long: Jones is standing here glaring at you.
desc:
At the first sight you thought Jones was an Orc, but when it came
closer you saw his second head. He wears an animal skin dress,
filthy and moth eaten. Jones really stinks...

name: Harold 'the mouse-killer' ettin
long: Harold is standing here looking confused at you.
desc:
When you look at Harold, you feel petty. His dress are really poor,
and the one of his heads hangs down. At the rope around his stomach
hangs dead mice and rats. He does not smell good.

name: The master mindflayer
long: The master mindflayer is here, looking at you with an evil look.
desc:
It's a seven foot tall humanoid dressed in a purple cloak, and swinging a
black and purple rod above its head as if it was going to attack you any
moment now. In the middle of its head are four tentacles with sharp points.

name: The senior mindflayer
long: The senior mindflayer walks around here, looking for something useful.
desc:
This is a horrifying monster indeed, 6'6" high. Dressed in purple and black,
and carrying a large mace in its hand. In the center of its head are four large
tentacles with very sharp points.

name: The junior mindflayer
long: The junior mindflayer is here, watching you carefully from the corner.
desc:
This mindflayer is six foot high. It has a small mace in its belt, and is
dressed in purple and black cloth. It has four small tentacles in the 
center of its head.

name: The ugly wererat
long: An ugly wererat is here, looking at you with a strange flick in his eyes.
desc:
The wererat is about four foot tall. It looks very much like rat, except
that it is standing.

name: The gigantic rat
long: There is a gigantic rat here, looking at you with a hungry look.
desc:
The gigantic rat is about ten foot long from head to tail and has claws
the size of your head looking very nasty.

name: The Keeper of the Sword
long: The Demon keeper of the sword of King Syagrius stands here grinning.
desc:
Blocking the way to the glowing holy sword is a terrible demon!  It grins
horribly at you, as if to say, "You shall fail like all before."

sounds.near: The demon gibbers insanely.
sounds.far: Demonic noises come from nearby.  Fear quivers through you.

name: a cloud giant child
long: A small child around 6 feet high is playing here.
desc:
This child might be considered a runt because his growth spurt has not yet
kicked in. This child like all children is very curious and inquisitive. Right
now it is looking at you exactly how a human child with a firecracker in his
hand looks at a frog.

name: a giant teenager
long: A typical eighteen foot tall teenager with freckles to match bustles by you.
desc:
Ahh, a typical 18 foot teenager. However this one usually carries a large club
and looks for all kinds of ways to prove his manhood. He casually looks at you
to consider your trophy value.

name: a cloud giant maiden
long: A very large maiden winks suggestively at you.
desc:
This giant is very beautiful (to giants at least), and is very large, over 18
feet in height.  She is not what you would call a Graecian beauty, as her
life is divided between war and her Giant children.

name: a cloud giant guard
long: A burley giant guard grumbles at you.
desc:
This is a very tall, powerful guard. He is here to guard the citadel against
all intruders. He continuously looks in your direction.  He swings his club
low and strides toward you.

name: the Giant Battlemaster
long: A fierce looking giant, bristling with weapons, is crouched in battle stance.
desc:
The scarred old giant stands here, bristling with weapons.  He appears to
be a veteran of a thousand wars.  The mark of many a dwarven axe is upon
him.  He looks a very tough nut to crack.  He looks into your eyes and
says, "you are a cunning mensch to come this far into the castle.  But I
say you not so smart as you think because Now You Die!"

name: The King of the Giants
long: The Lord of the Cloud Giants holds court here.
desc:
Lord over all the cloud giants, in fact over most giants period. He displays a
good deal of commanding power and shows his power repeatedly. The King is
always ready to test his mettle against the best.  He leans back in throne
imperiously, as if mocking your indiscretion in entering HIS domain.  He
fingers his axe, itching to make your visit short indeed.

name: a slave boy
long: A tired and beaten slave child goes about his duties.
desc:
His eyes no longer hold any hope.  He has been beaten into wretched
servitude of the giants since he was kidnapped from the distant valley of
Shadowdale.  His clothes hang in rags.

name: a slave girl
long: A tired and beaten slave child goes about her duties.
desc:
The slave girl is little more than a rag doll.  She pitifully sweeps the
floor and cries about her lost parents.  If you ask her name she says it is
Cosette.

sounds.near: The child sings about her castle on a cloud, where crying is not allowed.
sounds.far: You here the wretched singing of a crying child.

name: a slave
long: A human slave toils here.
desc:
The slave is hunched and dirty.  His clothes are ill fitting rags.  Hard
work has made him strong.  There is no light in his eyes- slavery to the
giants has killed his spirit.

name: a dwarven slave
long: A dwarven slave glares about him as he works.
desc:
A stocky dwarf strains with labor.  He scowls about him, hating all
humans and giants alike.  He waves his fist as he pushes his rocks into
his trolley.

name: a slaver
long: A human slaver is here, appraising his merchandise.
desc:
This is one of the cold northern men who engage in the flesh trade.  They
are a rich people now, for the Giants pay well for slaves.  This one wears
fine Thalos silk, and perfumes from the distant south.  He flies about
confidently like all of his people but does not look to be a mage himself.

name: The Slaver Mage
long: The slaver mage flies about here.
desc:
Dressed in fine silks and gleaming jewelry, this painted man has a position
of power among the slavers.  His magic keeps an air-ship aloft, and lets
the crew roam the sky without fear with him.  Such men are the foundation
of the Slaver's industry.

name: The Giant bartender
long: The bartender stares down at you suspiciously.
desc:
This giant is at least a little friendly.  He has left the life of a
warrior to maintain the Landman's Inn.  He is always ready with a mug of
beer for his giant and slaver friends.  Something tells him you are
different.. and for now you are not his friend.

name: a visiting giant
long: A cloud giant relaxes at the bar.
desc:
This giant wears the rough clothes of the giants who live on the land far
below.  He is here on some unknown task from his clan lord.  Perhaps the
eating is bad in the mountains this year and he is here to buy some slaves.

name: human client
long: A slaver relaxes at a table.
desc:
This slaver has decided to frequent the Landman's Inn.  Perhaps he is tired
of his vessel or his here on official business to the Giant Lord.  He sits
a stone table, mug in his hands.  He smiles at you as you come in.

name: a winger
long: A curious winged pink creature is flying about here.
desc:
The creature is a strange one indeed.  The small pink center sprouts two
membranous wings.  A mouth like opening in the body sends out an inaudible
shriek which seems to make magic waver about you.

name: a cloud giant warrior
long: The cloud giant warrior stands here, preparing for battle.
desc:
The Warrior is over 18 feet tall.  He is scarred and tattooed.  His club 
moves easily in his hand.  He lives to fight, and he isn't too picky.

name: the butterfly
long: A beautiful, butterfly-like thing is fluttering around here.
desc:
It is, on closer inspection, not really an animal, but a variable 
number of brightly-colored, translucent planes of breathtaking beauty 
and delicacy. The planes pulse, waver, sometimes disappear, but are 
always replaced by another. None of the planes move, but through 
continuous replacement, the butterfly does, in random sweeps.

name: the Asp
long: A hissing asp slithers nearby.
desc: The asp looks quick and mean

name: The creepy spider
long: A creepy spider crawls around.
desc: It is about 10 inches long, with small fangs.

name: The Norwegian Blue
long: the Norwegian Blue parrot is here, it's just stunned.
desc: It has remarkable plumage.

name: The baby pigmy brontosaurus
long: The baby pigmy brontosaurus is here, looking for her momma.
desc:
There are supposed to be LOTS of dinosaurs out there somewhere!  This one
is just 6' tall, and looks very confused.

name: The alligator

name: The Saber-Tooth Tiger

name: A Polar Bear

desc: He looks VERY mean.

name: the Vampire bat
long: A Vampire bat is here.
desc:
He hovers around your head, waiting for his moment to strike....

OUCH!
That REALLY hurt!

name: The Vampiress
long: A vampiress stands here
desc: Lovely in every detail, but Lethal!

name: the orc
long: A ugly orc is standing here.
desc: Yrkk..

name: the Elite Hill Giant
long: There is a very large Hill Giant standing here.
desc:
A 10 and 1/2 foot tall humanoid stands before you. He has reddish brown skin,
and he strangely appears a bit more alert than your average hill giant.

loads.roomName: Guard Post (use direction to open door)

name: the Hill Giant Chieftain
long: The Chieftain of the Hill Giants is standing here.
desc:
The largest and meanest looking Hill Giant you have ever seen stands before
you. He has the scars from many bodies across his body. He is wearing some
hides of a very large dragon. He returns you look with a look of pure and utter
hatred.

name: The Hill Giant Chieftess
long: The Chieftess of the Hill Giants is standing here.
desc:
The largest female you have ever seen stands before you. She has a moose skin
wrapped around her shoulders. You smell the scent of "Eau de Giant" originating
from her. She appears to be heading off to go shopping. A huge stone VISA card
is clenched between her fingers.

name: The Cloud Giant Ambassador
long: The Ambassador of the Cloud Giants is standing here.
desc:
A strange looking giant stands before you. He has a light blue skin, silver
hair, and is about 18 feet tall. He is wearing a badge of the Cloud Giant Clan
from the east. He looks at you with an interested look in his eyes.

name: The Stone Giant
long: A large Stone Giant is standing here.
desc:
A 12 foot tall, gray skinned, silver eyed giant with blue-gray hair stands
before you. He has a stony appearance to his skin. His rock colored garments
make him tough to pick out from the shadows of the light.

name: The Cave Bear
long: A large Cave Bear is standing here.
desc:
A incredibly large bear stands on his hind legs before you. He has got to be a
full 12 foot tall! The bear has a dark brown fur coloring and its growl is very
loud and powerful sounding.

name: The Dwarf
long: A Dwarf with a crazed look in his eyes paces around the room frantically.
desc:
He appears to have been a great warrior at one time, now driven insane through
some inhuman torture. Scars cover his body and he has a strange, confused look
in his eyes. He is frothing from the mouth and muttering something to himself.

name: The Keeper of the Hill Giants
long: A large, hunchbacked Hill Giant is standing here.
desc:
This hill giant has a large hump over one shoulder. He is missing one eye and
walks with a limp. His scars show him to be a warrior of great age and his arms
show that he still has great strength.

name: The Undead Priestess
long: A priestess is standing here, it's flesh falling off its bones.
desc:
A humanoid that once appears to have been a cleric is standing here. Its flesh
is rotted away in many places. Empty eye sockets turn stare at you, a strange
internal light glowing inside them.

name: The Undead Hill Giant
long: A skeletal hill giant stands before you
desc:
The body of once might have been a Giant has been animated into what you now
see. The flesh of the creature is rotted and missing in many places. It turns
in your direction and points at you!

name: A troglodyte
long: A small troglodyte stands here
desc: She smells repulsive.

name: a gnoll
long: A gnoll stands here, he looks mean.
desc:
He is dressed in yellow rags, and has a dog-like face.  He is not very much
fun to stare at like this.  People are looking at you

name: An ogre
long: An ogre stands here, grinning at you
desc:
He is rather large, and nasty looking.  You are well aware of his huge
muscles.  Pissing him off is not a good idea.

name: A carrion crawler
long: A carrion crawler searches for food here.
desc: It is a grotesque beast, with numerous legs, and strange tentacles

name: a manticore
long: A manticore stands here, tail thrashing.
desc: It is like a lion, but with a spiked tail.

name: the orc
long: The orc walks around, looking for someone to kill.
desc: You notice an evil look in his eyes

name: the bugbear
long: A hairy bugbear stands here.
desc: It looks like a walking carpet.

name: An Old Blue Dragon
long: An incredibly huge blue dragon sits here.
desc: You see a very large blue dragon before you. It appears to be quite old.

name: a hill giant
long: A rather large humanoid stands here, picking his teeth
desc:
He is about 10 feet tall, maybe 12.  He carries a spear that is substantially
taller than you are.

name: The Jarl
long: The leader of the frost giants is here, practicing his combat moves
desc:
He is large, and extremely mean looking.  He is scarred from head to
toe, a demonstration of the many battles he has fought and (apparently)
won.

name: The Queen
long: The queen of the frost giants sits here.  She demands that you bow.
desc: She is BUTT-ugly.

name: The Shaman
long: The frost giant shaman is here, conjuring minor demons
desc:
He looks like a cross between an aboriginal shaman, and a massive growth
pill.

name: The Captain
long: The Captain of the frost giant stands here fearlessly
desc:
He looks very angry that you are here. His skin is a cloud blue color
and his hair is a bright white.

name: A dark figure
long: You see a dark figure crouching in the corner, preparing to strike!
desc:
He is small for a giant, and looks to be a bit more cunning.  He has
a large, sharp implement of destruction, and likes to place it in the
backs of non-giants

name: A guard
long: A frost giant guard is here, watching for intruders
desc: He looks at you keenly, and flexes his muscles as you approach

The goblin is dressed in roughly made hide clothes, with bits and

Dressed in the finiest armor and clothes that you have seen a goblin
soldier where.

This guy is sound asleep our would be if people would leave him
alone

He wears piece-meal armor and really obscene colored clothing. Around his

name: A blacksmith goblin

He wears a black leather apron, his arms and face are coated with black
powder. He looks pretty mean

sounds.near: The goblin smith pounds his hammer on a red hot piece of metal
sounds.far: A ringing of a hammer on hot metal sounds out nearby

name: A dumb half-giant
long: A slow looking half giant stands here chopping wood with a large axe
desc:
The poor sod looks like he was dropped on his head as a child. The goblins
seem to be making use of him by a wood cutter. He looks taken care of and
happy.

name: A goblin cook
long: A goblin cook runs about stirring pots and poking meats
desc:
She wears a leather apron and wield several spoons and knives as
she works. The greasy hair covers her face.

name: A small furry spider
long: A small furry spider scurries about
desc: Looks like a ecky furry spider!

loads.roomName: Dark Trail in the Spider Haunt

name: A very large spider
long: A very large spider leaps down from above and attacks you!
desc: The largest spider you have seen before looms down upon you

name: A dire wolf
long: A large looking wolf sniffs around here
desc:
The largest wolf you have ever seen glares back at you with red
glowing eyes.

name: A small rat
long: A small rat scurries about here
desc:
A small mean looking rat with grey matted hair and evil looking
eyes scurries away from you.

name: a small woodland ferrit
long: A small woodland ferrit scurries about the tree trunks here
desc: A small rat looking creature, but pleasant looking

name: A dark elf guard
long: A dark skinned elf stands here guarding against intruders
desc:
Other than the pitch black colored skin and his white hair, this guy
looks like a normal elf. That is, except for his outlook on life, one
of which is probably to slip his dagger across your throat. He is armored
is a black metal mesh of mail.

name: A dark elf
long: A wandering dark elf glares at you in anger
desc:
His skin is black as night and his hair is as white as the night moon. 
Strapped about his waist is a dark metal sword that matches his black clothing
and black mesh armor.

name: A dark elf priestess
long: A important looking dark elf priestess screams obscene curses at you
desc:
She wears very elaborate jewlery, mostly adorned with a spider
symbols. Here eyes seems to carry the power of every dark elf you
have seen if your short life. At her waist she carries a writhing snake
headed whip.

keywords: dark elf wanderer wandering female woman
name: A dark elf priestess
long: A wandering dark elf priestess stands here converting others to Lolth
desc:
She carries a small snake headed whip at her side, ready to convert
non-believers to the way of Lolth. She ccarries herself with power and
authority, but still moves with the glide of elvish females.

name: Briza Do'Urden
long: Briza Do'Urden snarls in anger at you and pulls out her whip!
desc:
A powerful looking female dressed in noble cloths, at her waist she
carries a nasty slithering whip. You catch a glimps of dark mesh armor
benieth her clothes.

name: Matron Malice Do'Urden
long: Matron Malice Do'Urden howls at you for defiling her house
desc:
Wearing the most regal clothing avalible to her people she carries
herself with pride. Jewlerey glitters off her fingers and neck, at her waist
a evil looking whip hisses at you.

name: Rizzen Do'Urden
long: Rizzen Do'Urden blinks at you in suprize before leaping to his feet to attack
desc:
This shady elf is dressed in a dark cloak and boots. His is but a
shadow of his brothers.

keywords: dark elf priestess-high priestess high vierna do'urden
name: Vierna Do'Urden
long: Vierna Do'Urden glares at you in anger
desc:
She wears a long flowing robe atop her mesh armor. At her waist she
carries a small slithering whip.

name: Maya Do'urden
long: Maya Do'Urden the priestess meditates here quietly
desc:
Cloaked in darkness, you can barely see a thing. You do hear the
hiss of a snake.

name: Dinin Do'Urden
long: Dinin Do'Urden leaps at you with a drawn sword before you blink
desc:
He looks like a stout elf, wearing worn mesh armor. At his waist you
see a fine longsword and a glittering shortsword.

name: Zaknafein Do'Urden
long: Zaknafein Do'Urden raises an eyebrow at your arrival
desc:
A fine specimen of a dark elf, his body is one of the most
physically developed you have seen. He has several small scars about his
body on his exposed skin.

name: Drizzit Do'Urden
long: Drizzit Do'Urden suffles away from you holding twin swords in his hands
desc:
This dark elf looks like any other, except for the feline movements
and the lavander eyes.

name: A dark elf mage
long: A dark elf wearing shimmering black robes stands here.
desc:
He wears a flowing black and dark red robe, pulled together with a
purple belt.

name: A dark elf
long: A dark elf blends into the shadows
desc:
The dark elf looks like a commoner, wearing plan clothes and boots.
Still, he carries a shortsword at his waist.

sounds.near: Screams echo off the cavern walls, sending shivers down your spine.
sounds.far: Screams echo off the cavern walls sending a shiver down your spine.

name: A subterranean lizard
long: A very large lizard used as a pack beast flicks it's tonge at you
desc:
This huge beast has thick scally hide and cupped feet, used to move
across the walls a ceilings of caverns.

name: A weak slave kobold
long: A weak looking kobold stands here reeking of filth
desc:
The kobold is barly 3 feet high with scaly hide that ranges from dark rusty
brown to a rusky black color. He has two small horns  atop his head. He
wears very raggedy cloths.

name: A hook horror
long: A bipedal hook creature hisses at your arrival
desc:
The hook horror looks like a cross between a vulture and a human
having large hooks where his hands would normally be. Large spikes
grow from various points on his body of thick exoskeleton. He stands
about 9 feet tall and weights about 350 pounds.

name: A grimlock
long: A grim looking humanoid stands here cocking his ears twards you
desc: It looks like a powerfully built humanoid clad only in dark filthy rags

sounds.near: A droplet of water splashes to the floor, with a loud SPLOSH!
sounds.far: Strange sounds echo off the cavern walls.

name: A small gremlin
long: A small gremlin looking creature looks at you with a sneer
desc:
The jermlaine looks like a tiny human dressed in baggy clothing and
a leather helmet.

sounds.near: A small green snake slithers into a hole in the cavern wall
sounds.far: Several rats scatter off into the cracks in the walls.

name: A gnoll
long: A hyena-like humanoid creature snarls at you
desc:
The body of the creature is shaped like that of a large human, the details
are those of a hyena however. It stands about 7 to 8 feet tall with a dark
reddish mane of hair flowing down it's back.

name: A gnoll
long: A hyena-like humanoid creature snarls at you
desc:
The body of the creature is shaped like that of a large human, the details
are those of a hyena however. It stands about 7 to 8 feet tall with a dark
reddish mane of hair flowing down it's back.

name: A gnoll chieftain
long: A hyena-like creature dressed in pieced armor snarls in anger at your arrival
desc:
The body of the creature is shaped like that of a large human, the details
are those of a hyena however. It stands about 7 to 8 feet tall with a dark
reddish mane of hair flowing down it's back.

name: A gnoll sentry
long: Standing at attention, you see a gnoll guard
desc:
The body of the creature is shaped like that of a large human, the details
are those of a hyena however. It stands about 7 to 8 feet tall with a dark
reddish mane of hair flowing down it's back.

name: a Labyrinth Liar
long: A Labyrinth Liar stands here speaking almost unceasingly.
desc: It speaks the truth a quarter of the time. I think!

name: a Labyrinth Liar
long: A Labyrinth Liar stands here speaking almost constantly.
desc: It speaks the truth a quarter of the time. I think!

name: the Labyrinth Sentry
long: The Labyrinth Sentry stands here in total silence. Unflinching to the end.
desc: An large impassive fellow who seems to ignore the little people out there.

name: Lord Python of Castle Python
long: Lord Python is resting on his great throne. His eyes glow yellow.
desc:
Lord Python sits here contemplating higher realities and bad
sketches. However Python has killed more people on the battlefield
than you have ever seen.

sounds.near: Lord python quaffs a yellow potion of see invisible, which vanishes

name: the Elite Guardsman
long: The Elite Guardsman is standing here, maintaining order in the castle.
desc:
The guardsman is HUGE, and has little patience for evildoers. You
immediately grab the nearest halo and hang it over your head.

The Python crest is emblazoned on his armor.

name: the Guardsman
long: A guardsman is standing here, watching over the castle.
desc:
A big, strong, helpful, trustworthy guard.

The Python crest is emblazoned on his armor.

name: the Guardsman
long: A guardsman is standing here, guarding his post.
desc:
A big, strong, trustworthy guard. He will not abandon his post.

The Python crest is emblazoned on his armor.

name: the Guardsman
long: A guardsman is standing here, drinking lots of ale.
desc:
A big, strong, ale drinking guard. He will not abandon his ale.

The Python crest is emblazoned on his armor.

name: the Guardsman
long: A guardsman is standing here, lifting weights.
desc:
A big, strong, guard. He is intent on his weightlifting.

The Python crest is emblazoned on his armor.

name: the sheep

desc: The sheep appears to be nesting.

sounds.near: The sheep baaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaas
sounds.far: You hear farm animals in the distance

name: A commoner
long: The commoner stands here, looking at the sheep.
desc:
You see an average commoner, not too bright.
>
The commoner says "My theory is that the sheep think they are birds."
The commoner says "Right now you can see them nesting."
The commoner says "You should see them when they try to fly."

sounds.near: The commoner says "Mighty strange animals, these sheep."
sounds.far: You hear someone talking nearby

name: the pantomime horse
long: A pantomime horse runs around, playing pranks.
desc:
The pantomime horse doesn't look that real.

The words "Property of the BBC" are stamped on the horse.

name: the pepperpot
long: A pepperpot walks by, chatting annoyingly.
desc:
The pepperpot appears to be a housewife from Bristol. However, you
suspect that she is not a woman.

sounds.near:
The pepperpot says 'Excuse me, could you show me the way to the Ministry of
Silly Walks?'
sounds.far: You hear some muttering nearby.

name: The Cheeser
long: The cheeser is here, waiting for your order
desc:
He smiles happily while waiting for you to ask for something that
he can sell you.

name: The Official, Guaranteed Genuine Python Castle Baker
long: The Official, Guaranteed Genuine Python Castle Baker stands here
desc: He looks very real.

name: The maid
long: A buxom maid stands here, waiting to take you to your room
desc: She looks very healthy.

name: The Nudge Nudge guy
long: The Nudge Nudge guy is standing here, winking at you
desc: He smiles knowingly.

name: The Grand Inquisitor
long: The Grand Inquisitor shows up unexpectedly.
desc: The Grand Inquisitor stands here ready to accuse you of evil things.

sounds.near: The Grand Inquisitor says 'Nobody expects the Spanish Inquisition!'.
sounds.far: You do not expect the Spanish Inquisition.

name: Cardinal Biggles
long: Cardinal Biggles stands here, awaiting orders from his superior.
desc:
He doesn't appear very competent, and he is easily confused. In fact
you suspect he wouldn't really notice it if you hit him.

name: Cardinal Fang
long: Cardinal Fang stands here, planning tortures for the Inquisition.
desc:
He has an evil glint in his eye, but you suspect that he fights bravely
only against a helpless opponent.

name: A gumby
long: Your average, run-of-the-mill gumby is standing here, looking confused.
desc: Confusion appears to be the normal state of mind for this person.

name: A tall gumby
long: A tall gumby stands here, trying to look confused.
desc:
Having his head elevated as high as it is, his head doesn't receive
enough oxygen and blood to be able to look confused. He does appear
stronger than the average gumby though.

name: A thinking gumby
long: A gumby is sitting here, trying very hard to think.
desc: This fellow looks smarter than your average gumby.

sounds.near: A thinking gumby says 'Ohh! My brain hurts!'
sounds.far: You hear someone groan in the distance.

name: A rabid gumby
long: A rabid gumby stands here, flailing his arms about madly.
desc: Foam is gushing from his mouth.

name: The man behind the desk
long: A man sits quite calmly behind a desk here.
desc: He seems perfectly out of place.

sounds.near: The man behind the desk says 'And now for something completely different'.
sounds.far: You hear something in the distance.

name: The Vicar
long: The Vicar is standing here, practicing his lines.
desc: The Vicar notices you and says 'Sorry, I'm not in this week's show'.

name: The first man
long: A man sits behind the desk, arguing with the other man.
desc: He appears to be selling arguments.

sounds.near: The first man says 'No it isn't!'.
sounds.far: You hear someone arguing in the distance.

name: The second man
long: A man sits in front of the desk, arguing with the first man.
desc: He seems to have come here for an argument.

sounds.near: The second man says 'Yes it is!'.
sounds.far: You hear someone arguing in the distance.

name: The old man
long: An old man stands here, keeper of the Bridge of Death.
desc: He is the old man from scene 24

sounds.near:
The old man says 'Stop! Who would cross the Bridge of Death must
answer me these questions three, ere the other side he sees.'.

The old man says 'What is your name?'.
The old man says 'What is your quest?'.
The old man says 'What is your favorite color?'.
sounds.far: You hear an old man in the distance.

name: Sir Bedamere
long: Sir Bedamere wanders about, searching for the grail.
desc: He has a white tree on a blue background emblazoned on his armor.

name: Sir Lancelot
long: Sir Lancelot stands here, waiting.
desc:
He appears to be waiting for a chance to make a dramatic rescue. His armor
has a griffin emblazoned upon it.

sounds.near: Sir Lancelot says 'Don't go on, the peril is too perilous!'.
sounds.far: You here someone in the distance.

name: Concord
long: Sir Lancelot's faithful squire, Concord, stands here.
desc: He is looking for his lord.

name: Sir Galahad
long: Sir Galahad quests for the Holy Grail.
desc:
He has a red cross emblazoned on his white armor. He actually would rather
go back and face the peril in Castle Anthrax if he had a choice.

name: Sir Robin
long: Sir Robin stands here, wondering where the grail is.
desc:
He has a chicken emblazoned on his armor. He seems to have done some running
recently.

sounds.near: Sir Robin yells 'Run away! Run away!'
sounds.far: You hear someone yell in the distance.

name: Sir Not-Appearing-In-This-Film
long: Sir Not-Appearing-In-This-Film is appearing on this mud.
desc: He appears to be a baby in a full suit of armor.

name: Robin's minstrel
long: Robin's minstrel is singing of Robin's exploits.
desc: He sings of Robin's running away from danger.

name: The vorpal bunny
long: A small, cute furry bunny hops along innocently.
desc: Isn't he cute and furry. Look out for those teeth!

name: The Black Beast of Argh
long: The Black Beast of Argh, the cartoon peril, stands here.
desc:
It has two large horns, dozens of eyes, a huge mouth, and two legs.
It appears to be a cartoon.

name: Tim
long: Tim the Enchanter stands here.
desc: He is a powerful sorcerer.

sounds.near: Tim waves his hands and rocks explode nearby in a burst of flame.
sounds.far: You hear explosions nearby.

name: The peasant
long: The peasant works the field here.
desc: He seems to be a hard working peasant.

name: The oppressed peasant
long: The peasant works the field here.
desc: He seems to be a hard working peasant.

sounds.near: The oppressed peasant shouts 'Help! Help! I'm being oppressed!'
sounds.far: You hear someone call for help nearby.

name: Zute
long: Zute is in charge here.
desc: She is a beautiful young woman dressed in white robes.

sounds.near:
Zute says 'Ohh bad, bad, wicked Zute!'.
Zute says 'I'm the one who left the grail-shaped beacon lit.'.
sounds.far: You hear a young woman muttering nearby.

name: A young girl
long: A young girl stands here.
desc:
She is dressed in white robes and is somewhere between 16 and 25 years
of age.

name: The man
long: A peasant man stands here, dressed in lupines.
desc: He looks like he hasn't had a good meal in ages. He does smell good however.

name: The woman
long: A peasant woman lies here, she looks rather sick.
desc: She appears to be sick of lupines.

name: Dennis Moore
long: Dennis Moore is here, riding his faithful steed Concord.
desc: He is dressed in black.

name: Moore's steed Concord
long: Moore's steed Concord stands here.
desc: This is a rather ordinary horse.

name: Brother Maynard
long: Brother Maynard stands here ready to assist the king.
desc: He is a loyal follower of King Arthur.

name: An Unseen Servant
long: An visible Unseen Servant floats around aimlessly, waiting to be summoned.
desc: It definitely wants a master.

name: A Dust Devil
long: The Dust Devil floats long, picking up debris left lying around.
desc: A swirling vortex of dust.

name: A Lesser Air Elemental
long: One of the lesser Air Elementals exists here.
desc: A swirling mass of air.

name: An Invisible Stalker
long: A Stalker is standing here, glaring at you.
desc: He seems pretty nasty, but he does hold the key to the other realms.

name: The Djinn
long: A powerful Djinn, Lord of this Element, glances at you with scorn.
desc:
Clad in silken Pantalons and a flowing azure cloak, he seems in control of
the situation.

name: The Djnniyeh
long: A Djinniyeh reclines upon a silken cushion.
desc:
This Djinniyeh, while not very strong, is in command of superior magical
forces.

name: The Greater Air Elemental Guard
