long: A Greater Air Elemental stands guard here.
desc: This mass of air looks very large and hard to hit.

name: The Water Weird
long: You faintly make out a disturbance in the water here.
desc: A vaguely snake-like discoloration of the water.

name: Lesser Water Elemental
long: One of the Lesser Water Elementals swirls here.
desc: Two orbs of deep green peer out of this wave.

name: A Triton
long: A strange fish-man is swimming by you
desc:
The lower half of this creature ends in two finned legs, while his
torso, head, and arms are handsomely human.  He has a silvery skin,
which fades into sliver-blue scales on the lower half of his body.
His hair is deep blue.

name: The Greater Water Elemental
long: This Elemental seems much more powerful than the lessor's of its kind.
desc: A very large pool of swirling water.

name: Steven the Marid
long: A tall Marid named Steven glances at you with his arms crossed in contempt.
desc: A tall, arrogant Marid.  His muscles are very well developed.

name: a robber
long: A robber is trying to hide here.
desc: He is dressed in all black and seems to be wanting some of your gold!

name: a highwayman
long: A highwayman is waiting here for someone to steal from.
desc: The highwayman is dirty, gruff, and mean. He has a very nasty disposition.

sounds.near: The highwayman says, "Here take a closer look at my axe!"
sounds.far: Psst, hey buddy, com'ere I wanna show ya somethin'!

name: a killer
long: A sadistic killer looms here ready to live up to his name.
desc: The killer is a wild looking individual who looks really mean!

sounds.near: eee hee, mommy? Mommy is that you mommy? Mommy says I have to kill you, hee he
sounds.far: Kill...kill..kill. Murder...murder..murder.

name: a murderer
long: A murderer is here waiting for another victim.
desc: The murderer is an evil man with no apparent care for life, his or yours!

name: a black thief
long: The black thief grins at you as he eyes his soon-to-be valuables.
desc: He is clad in all black garb. He looks very crafty and evil to the core.

name: Sly the thug
long: Sly the thug is busy doing Wylie's dirty work.
desc:
Sly is Wylie's top henchman. He is so busy filling out forms that he
doesn't notice you. You faintly hear someone mutter 'damn W2 forms'.

sounds.near: Sly mumbles, "Why can't he do his own damn paperwork!"
sounds.far: You hear someone cursing under their breathe.

name: Slash the thug
long: Slash the thug stands guard here.
desc:
Slash is one of Wylie's top henchmen. He is half-man, half-beast, and
whatever it is its weird and its pissed off, and it calls itself Slash!

name: the fat little merchant
long: The fat little merchant is here in between points on his travels.
desc:
He is a short, round little man, with beady little eyes and a sweat
covered face. He looks very nervous.

name: a merchant's guard
long: A guard is here protecting the merchant and his goods.
desc:
The guard is a stout fellow, who seems to be bothered by nothing. Then 
again he does kind of look disturbed by something or maybe it is someone.

name: Wylie Baker
long: Wylie Baker, lord of thieves, is here plotting to rob the world blind.
desc:
Wylie is quite the nasty individual. He is wanted by Thar Theron for crimes
against the kingdom, dead or alive. At his choice you can see that it will
have to be the first of the two. As you stare at him longer you begin to
notice his striking resemblance to an old friend of yours!

name: the minor dragon
long:
A minor dragon is here drooling as he thinks about the warm marrow in your
soon-to-be broken bones!
desc:
The minor dragon looks like a smaller version of a red dragon. you wonder if it has a complex about it's 
size.

name: a draco
long: A draco is here doing his lord's bidding.
desc:
The draco is a cross between a dragon and a humanoid. It walks up-right
yet it is covered with scales, horns, and a nasty tail. you wonder if 
he has the terrible breath possessed by his larger cousins. You soon
discover that his master's bidding is ridding the world of all 
humans!

name: Zeus
long: Zeus, Wert's loyal rottweiler waits for his master here.

name: the Theronian cityguard
long: The Theronian cityguard is here making sure all is right.
desc: He is a confident man with little sign of worry.

name: the Theronian tower guard
long: A Theronian tower guard is here gazing off into the horizon.
desc:
The guard seems to be looking out for something, like he is expecting 
trouble. His loyalty to Thar is unwavering and would never think of
leaving his post without one heck of a fight.

name: the Theronian archer
long: A Theronian archer is here keeping a sharp eye out for invaders.
desc:
He is a tall, slender man with extremely keen eyesight. He looks like
he could handle himself quite well, even though he lacks huge muscles.

name: a huge Theronian guard
long: An immense Theronian guard is righting any wrongs for good.
desc:
This guard is so muscle-bound that he can't put his arms down to his
side. He notices you and yawns and stretches, snapping a few straps on
his armor. Maybe you had better move along, he doesn't look like he
is in the mood to be bothered by little 'ole you.

name: the gate guard
long: The Theronian gate guard is here guarding the entrance to Theronia.
desc:
This is a giant of a man. He looks quite impressive in his nice shiny
armor. You wonder how it has stayed so clean. Is he a coward or a
master?

name: the Royal Theronian guard
long: A Royal Theronian guard is here protecting the kingdom and Thar.
desc:
The royal Theronian guard is the highest honor that can be bestown upon a
guard in Theronia. They are the fighting elite of the kingdom, second
only to Fargo, their captain. Better mind your manors around this guy.

sounds.near: Praise Wert, God of Theronia!
sounds.far: Hail Thar, lord of all Theronia!

name: a Theronian commoner
long: A Theronian commoner is here taking care of daily business.
desc:
The commoner is well dressed for just a commoner, Theronia must really
be a thriving city. The commoner tips his hat to you and wishes you a 
good day.

name: a Theronian citizen
long: A Theronian citizen is here enjoying the easy life.
desc:
The citizen is dressed in nice clothes and light armor. He bows to you
and wishes you wealth and prosperity while in their fair city.

name: Fargo Feldspar
long:
Fargo Feldspar, captain of the Theronian guard, is here protecting 
Lord Thar and his kingdom.
desc:
Fargo is clad in beautiful green and yellow armor. You can tell by 
looking at him that he knows the art of the sword well. From the way
he is dressed and the powerful items he possesses you realize he is
the Captain of the Theronian guard.

name: Wolfblood
long: Wolfblood, the Royal assassin, is here plotting his next covert operation.
desc:
Wolfblood is a highly skilled assassin who was hired by Thar to get
rid of any unwanted rulers in other lands. You realize this is one guy
better left alone. Was it 1001 or 1002 ways that he could bring you to 
a slow, agonizing death. Wolfblood denies all accusations of being in 
league with the C.I.A.

name: Sarger the Seeker
long: Sarger the Seeker is here trying to get all of the sand out of his armor.
desc:
Sarger is a well-tanned, well-built halfling. He appears to know the
desert better than the sand in it.

name: Samual Steeljaw
long: Samuel Steeljaw is oiling his jaw after a long adventure.
desc:
Samuel Steeljaw is a tall, semi-muscular half-elf, with a deep tan and
 a strange helmet upon his head. It looks like large steel jaw has
been attached to the helmet. The jaw seems to be very well used. He 
almost reminds you of a garbage disposal.

name: Cazar the Demolisher
long: Cazar the Demolisher is here sharpening his armor.
desc:
Cazar is the brother of Toron Goldenhorn. Cazar's armor is covered with
many nasty spikes. It looks like you would hurt yourself if you just hit
him. Cazar is one of the Elite members of the Royal Theronian guard.

sounds.near: Glory to Thar! Down with Lord Dragos!
sounds.far: You here the sounds of sharpening metal.

name: Andar the Able
long: Andar the Able is here learning the ways of a paladin.
desc:
Andar is humble in his appearance, as are most of his secular group. Andar
is currently studying his clerical abilities from the wise old cleric, Zan
Orzord. Andar is a very good-natured and kind person. A true knight in every
since of the word.

name: Zan Orzord
long: Zan Orzord quietly teaching all the ways of kindness and oneness with nature.
desc:
Dispite his appearances, Zan is a very powerful cleric, yet he chooses to
use his powers for healing the sick and curing the blind. In a single glance
you can tell that he is a very kind, peaceful man. As he notices you looking
him over, he smiles, nods at you and says, "peace and love my child."

name: Toron the Crusher
long: Toron the Crusher waits here solemnly, watching for signs of trouble
desc:
Toron is a gigantic man, larger than any you have ever seen. He is clad in
golden armor with a helmet shaped like a bull's head. He wear's a large mace
over his right hand, hence the name Crusher. Toron is Cazar the Demolisher's
brother. Toron is the second in command of the Royal Theronian Guard.

name: Azar Azlan
long: Azar Azlan is here protecting Lord Thar and his kingdom.
desc:
Azar is clad in bright red armor that is intertwined with gothic designs 
and he wields an enormous flaming sword. As you enter the Throne room, Azar
moves to Thar's side, ready to die protecting his friend and Lord. Azar is
the Theronian WarLord, and commander of all the troops in the kingdom.

name: Lord Thar Theron
long:
Thar Theron, Lord of Theronia, is here ruling his people with a kind heart and
a bloodied sword.
desc:
Thar is a massive individual dressed in red and black armor. As you look at
his masked face, you wonder who or what could have scared such a powerful man.
The bright, blue eyes that burn beneath his mask, seem troubled, but what 
could possibly worry this Lord of the battlefield. What ever it is, it had 
better have five heads and really bad breath, because Thar looks really upset.

name: Princess Deanna
long: The beautiful princess Deanna is here brightening this part of the world.
desc:
Deanna is the very picture of beauty. Her long hair shines like stands of
spun gold. Her deep brown eyes look deep into your soul, revealing all your
secrets. A brief word from her lips is like an enchanted melody. What a 
beautiful woman, too bad her father is the mighty Thar Theron.

name: Steelbanger the Armorer
long: Steelbanger is here mending pieces of armor.
desc:
Steelbanger is old and leathery, kind of like his armor. Dispite his worn
appearance, he looks like a force to be reckoned with.

name: Zal the Weaponsmith
long: Zal is here forging all sorts of deadly weapons.
desc:
Zal is a big man, due to the banging and pounding in his craft. He looks
like he could wield anyone of the weapons in his shop with deadly skill.

name: Heather the Barmaid
long: Heather anxiously waits to serve you with a smile.
desc:
Heather is a pretty little barmaid. You wonder what it is that she is 
serving?

name: the Theronian cityguard
long: The Theronian cityguard is here making sure all is right.
desc: He is a confident man with little sign of worry.

name: the Theronian cityguard
long: The Theronian cityguard sits here relaxing between shifts.
desc: He is a confident man with little sign of worry.

name: Zord
long: An ancient man stands here, offering to sell you his wares.
desc:
Zord is an ancient mage, interested in magical artifacts and the
like.  His interests have become costly as of late and he is now
forced to sell some of his prized treasures in his shop to the general 
public.  He looks up from his studies and offers to help you with
your selection.

name: The scribe
long: The scribe is here scrawling spells onto scrolls.
desc:
The scribe is a withered old man with squinty little eyes.  Dispite
his age his hands do not shake as he transfers arcane knowledge 
onto parchment.  It has been said that he can scrawl any spell into
a scroll.  Without looking up from his work he asks how he maybe of
assistance.

sounds.near: The scribe hums an ancient tune as he writes.
sounds.far: You hear someone humming an odd melody.

name: Xerse
long: Xerse is here cleaning animal cages.
desc:
This is a happy man, with long brown hair.  He whistles as he works
at keeping his animals' cages clean.  He talks softly to the animals
in passing.  Truly an animal lover, he offers only the finest pets.

name: Bob, the repairman
long: Bob is here fixing weapons and armor.
desc:
Bob is a simple dwarf.  He busily pounds and bends away at an item
he is repairing.  As you look at him he asks if he can help you.

name: Ol' Salty
long: An old broken down sailor is here selling sea faring vessels.
desc:
Weather beaten and withered, Salty passes the days buy making and
selling boats and rafts.  Though once a mighty sailor, Salty is
nothing more than an old braggart drinking his life into oblivion.
He catches you staring at him and offers to hang you from the yard
arm, whatever that is.

sounds.near: Aye me harties, they be the finest ships on the sea!
sounds.far: You hear someone engaged in a drunken sailor song.

name: The White Cleric
long: A white clad cleric is here healing the masses.
desc:
This man is dressed all in white.  He walks about healing the sick
and the blind.  He stops in front of you and offers to heal your 
ailments for a small donation.

name: Ben, the Baker
long: A large, flour covered man is here baking bread and pastries.
desc:
Ben is a large happy man, you loves to eat.  He gives a deep 
chuckle and ask how he may be of service on this fine day.

name: The town Summoner
long: An old man stands here calling forth people and objects from all over.
desc:
The town Summoner is a strange old coot.  He stutters and bubbles about,
complaining of the late night requests he keeps getting for a summoning.
He blindly stumbles into you as he wonders about.  He apologizes and 
informs you that he can't summon you here, there would be no point in it!

name: Madam Alexandria
long: An older, attractive woman sits here fanning her bosom.
desc:
Madam Alexandria greets you with an elegant voice, asking you to
come in a rest for a while.  She informs you that social talk is
free here.  She inquires if you have been to the velvet room?  
You simply must visit there.  She then offers to 'loan' you the key
to the Velvet room.

name: A peasant
long: A happy peasant is here doing his daily chores.
desc:
This man seems very health for a peasant.  It appears that Theronia's
good fortune is not limited to the rich merchants and royalty.

name: Newnar Ackbar
long: Newnar Ackbar stares out at you from the shadows.
desc:
You can not see Newnar's face as he keeps it well hidden in the 
shadow's of his dark shop.  It is said he is in league with Wylie
Baker himself, but there is no solid evidence of this.  With a 
whispery snarl he tells you to get what you need and be on your way.

name: Peg-leg Pete
long: An old peg-legged sailor hobbles about serving drinks to the clientele.
desc:
Pete looks over at you and nods, indicating he will be with you in a 
moment.  It appears Pete had been swimming in the wrong waters, by
the lack of a right leg.  You assume it was taken by a shark, since
the leg is carved in the shape of a shark.

name: The jailer
long: A stout man sets here keeping an eye on the prisoners.
desc:
The jailer is a big man, with a large belly.  He tips his cap to you
when you enter and wishes you well.

name: The Auctioneer
long: A fast talking man is here offer items to the highest bidder.
desc:
You can but catch a quick look at this man as he moves about, pointing
and waving.  He speaks so fast that you can't understand what he is
saying.  You do manage to make out a few 'do I hears..' and 'Sold!'
as you look over the items up for auction.

sounds.near: The auctioneer points to someone in the crowd and shouts 'Sold!'
sounds.far: You hear the rumblings of a crowd and a person speaking rapidly.

name: the Locksmith
long: A thin little gnome is here bent over a grinding wheel making keys.
desc:
The locksmith is very thin and frail, from working long days.  He 
glances up at you briefly and squeaks on offer to help you.

name: the Banker
long: Octavian Schwartz, the city banker, is here waiting to help you.
desc:
The banker is a short, fat, bald halfling.  He greets you with a
warm smile and a handshake.

name: the Mapkeeper
long: A sour looking highlander sits here copying maps.
desc:
Randal McNalley scowls at you and tells you to be quiet as you view
his maps.  He turns and goes back to his work.

name: the Alchemist
long: A strange old man is here pouring different colors of liquids together.
desc:
The Alchemist makes potions for almost any need.  He looks up at you
as he mixes a potion, only to add a drop to much and cause a minor
explosion.  He chuckles and offers to show you his wares.

sounds.near: The Alchemist bumbles a vial and drops it, resulting in a loud explosion.
sounds.far: You here a loud explosion and the sound of breaking glass.

name: Snarl
long: A battle scarred mercenary eyes you with his good eye.
desc: Snarl is old and mean, but his fellows for hire are second to none.

name: Daniel Popoll
long: A tall slender man walks about checking on his patrons.
desc:
Daniel is a tall elf, who is a fine cook.  He promises that he will
love his food.  He turns and heads for another customer.

name: the Auctioneer's guard
long: A massive guard stands here keeping the riffraff out of the auction hall.
desc:
The guard looks like a mini mountain.  He asks you for your pass, and holds
out his huge hand.  If you aren't a guild member you had better be going.
This fellow looks like a bad one to upset.

name: A worshipper of Wert
long: A citizen stands here worshipping the almighty Wert.
desc:
The citizen is young and beautiful.  She has devoted her life to serving
Wert in any way possible.  Mostly she wanders about telling people of 
Wert and his kind heart and the rest of the day she spends praying to
Wert.

sounds.near: Oh great Wert, please bless this humble servant and our lovely city.
sounds.far: You hear someone praying nearby.

name: A shadowy assassin
long: A dark figure lurks in the shadows.
desc:
You have discovered one of Wylie Baker's personal assassins.  One
of the black assassins.  If you are close enough to see him, then
you will soon be off to meet your maker.

name: A blonde woman
long: A beautiful blonde woman lounges here looking for some company.
desc:
The woman winks at you and asks if you want some company.  The clothes
that she does ware are see through, allowing you to view her deeply 
tanned breasts, and firm thighs.  Her long blonde hair flows down about 
shoulders caressing them.  She moves over and makes room for you to
join her.

sounds.near: The blonde woman says 'Hey there handsome, need some company?'
sounds.far: You hear the sound of a woman laughing.

name: A redheaded woman
long: A voluptuous redhead eyes you with a wild lust in her eyes.
desc:
This woman has skin as white as the driven snow, and locks as red as
fire.  Her large bosom and curvaceous hips are more than inviting.
The scanty clothing that see wares leave nothing to the imagination.
Whether you are male or female this woman arouses a primal sexual
urge.  Her soft lips are asking to be kisses and her long red tresses
curl down about her bosom, driving you wild.  Her green eyes seem
to look right through you, sending shivers up and down your spine.

sounds.near: The redheaded woman shifts about on her chair exposing herself briefly.
sounds.far: You hear moans of passion and squeals of delight.

name: A black haired woman
long: A women with hair as dark as night lies here inviting you closer.
desc:
With hair as dark as night that stretches to her buxom behind, this
woman makes your heart skip a beat as you lay eyes on her.  Her tight 
fitting outfit outlines her every curve.  She shifts her hips side to 
side as if to intice you into joining her for a torrid night of pleasure.
With features like that you have a hard time saying no.

sounds.near: The raven haired woman caresses herself, longing to be touched.
sounds.far: You hear moans and sighs of ecstasy coming from nearby.

name: a pickpocket
long: A grungy little man is here mingling with the crowd.
desc:
What a sly looking character.  He seems to be very clumsy, bumping into
people as he walks around.

sounds.near: A dirty little man bumps into you as he passes.

name: a sailor
long: A seafaring man is here looking for a goodtime and a noisy tavern
desc:
The sailor is well tanned, and scruffy looking.  He pays you little
mind as he searches for alittle boredom relief.

name: a beastly fido
long: A mangie, dog sniffs about here.
desc:
The ugly little mutt sniffs about looking for something to
eat.  It notices you and snarls, showing it's nasty teeth
complete with little scraps of meat in the teeth.

name: a rat
long: A scaley-tailed rodent resembling a mouse scurries about here.
desc: This hungrey little rat has been raiding the grainary.

name: the streetkeeper
long: A peasant streetkeeper is here picking up the trash.
desc:
The peasant beams you a friendly smile. 'Help keep Theronia beautiful,
please junk your trash.' He tips his cap and returns to his work.

name: the phantom spirit of the forest
desc:
You have discovered the protector of the Theronian forest. It wonders
about the forest, protecting it from harm. It is not allowed to harm
any living being regardless of it alignment, unless of course it is
attacked. Instead it wanders about cleaning up the forest, so that any
items dropped there can not be used by the vile thieves.

name: A brave warrior
long: A brave warrior sharpening his sword stands here.
desc:
This brave warrior does not fear death.  He has been through trials of
life and death that are unknown to you.  His wounds from many a battle
have formed scars on his bulging muscles.

name: A Graecian Guard
long: A Graecian Guard cautiously watches his post.
desc:
This man wears the insignia of the town of Graecia on his breastplate.
Although, lightly armored, his battle scars indicate that this man
REALLY knows how to fight.  Judging by his companions, you think it
would be wise not to anger him.

name: King Agamemnon
long: King Agamemnon, ruler of Graecia, is sitting upon his throne.
desc:
King Agamemnon, the wise and fair ruler of Graecia is sitting on his
huge throne.  He has huge muscles balanced only by his wisdom.  As you
can tell, he is the strongest warrior in all of Graecia.

name: A scholar
long: A Scholar, arguing over the future of Graecia is standing here.
desc:
This feeble old man represents the wisdom of Graecia.  He was taught by
Aristotle and really is much wiser than you will ever be.  He is
advising King Agamemnon about the future of Graecia.

name: the assassin
long: An Assassin is hiding here, eager to place a dagger in your back
desc:
This cruel man is wearing a black cloak which conceals him very well.
Judging by the way he stalks you as you look around, it would be a good
idea to leave before he attacks.

name: Hercules
long: Hercules is resting here, tired from his many labors.
desc:
Hercules is wearing only a Large belt and shorts about his waist.  He is
definitely the largest man you have ever seen.  He is wielding a Huge
club that is made from the finest wood in all of Graecia.  His muscles
are so huge that it looks like he could crush you by flexing.

name: a horse
long: A horse is here making a big mess for you to clean up.
desc:
This horse has been spoiled rotten from the start.  He is allowed to do
whatever he wants and Nero might even recruit him into his army if he's
lucky.

name: The Nemean Lion
long: The Nemean Lion is looking for its next meal.
desc:
This lion is mean!  His hide looks to be as hard as steel and his teeth
remind you of a knife shop.  His claws are as sharp as swords.  He looks
straight into your eyes and you can tell that he is thinking DINNER.

name: the hydra
long: The Pyro Hydra is stalking for prey
desc:
Count them...1, 2, 4, 8, 10!  Ten huge heads coming from all directions
to eat you.  He has the body of a dragon, but his ten heads mean that he
is no push-over.

name: an amazon warrior
long: A huge amazon warrior stands here, defending her home
desc:
This woman is huge, considering she towers over you at nearly 7 feet in
height.  Now you know why no one has attacked their secret village and
survived.  Although she is only equipped with a spear and shield, she
looks like a formidable opponent

name: Queen Hippolyta
long: Queen Hippolyta, queen of the amazons, stands here.
desc:
This fierce warrior is the queen of the amazons.  You can tell that she
earned her position by battle.  Like her sisters she is only armed with
a spear and shield, but her agility is amazing.  Around her waist is a
Jeweled Girdle, which signifies her leadership over the amazon tribe.

name: the two-headed giant
long: A Huge Two-Headed Giant stands here guarding Geryon.
desc:
The only strange thing you notice other than his huge size is his second
head.  They say two heads are better than one.  As they grin you feel
like maybe the old saying may be true after all.

name: the Two-Headed Dog
long: A Giant Two-Headed dog snarls at you.
desc:
You've seen dogs, and giants, but never a giant dog.  And certainly not one
with two heads.  His legs are so muscular that he could rip you to
shreds without even using both sets of his powerful jaws.  But you
wouldn't get so lucky.

name: Geryon
long: Geryon, Nero's prized Oxen, stands here eating some grass.
desc:
This is the largest oxen you have ever seen.  You can see PRIME RIB
Written all over him in tiny letters.  He is flawless in all respects
and his presence makes you the slightest bit hungry.

name: A Watchful Dragon
long: The Watchful Dragon roars as you enter
desc:
Welcome to Dikumud
0) Exit Dikumud
1) Enter the game at Shadowdale
2) Set Password
3) Enter Description
4) Read Background Story
5) Enter the game somewhere else

Enter Choice:

name: A Giant
long: A huge Giant stands here
desc:
He is a typical giant: tall, strong, and mean.  His huge club indicates
that he doesn't like you very much.

name: the thief
long: A shadowy figure
desc:
This cruel man cares about nothing except the contents of your money
pouch

name: the huge snake
long: A Huge Green Snake
desc:
This foul creature has huge fangs and you can tell that his poison is
quite potent, judging by the glands on his head.

name: A hungry wolf
long: A hungry wolf growls at you
desc: This wolf looks like it was bred for one purpose...eating YOU!

name: Cerebus
long: Cerebus, the guardian of Hades is here.
desc:
Cerebus has three heads, all of which are much bigger than you!  His
teeth look like a knife shop, and it makes you wander whether you should
try to enter Hades after all.

name: a spirit
long: A peaceful spirit resides here.
desc: There is really not much to see, just the outline of a human.

name: A skeletal warrior
long: A skeletal warrior guards the way back to Graecia
desc:
This creature was once a powerful warrior in his mortal days, but now
his only care is that you don't leave the underworld.

name: A torturer
long: A torturer is here, eager to show you the meaning of pain
desc: He is big, mean, and looks at you like you are his special project

name: The acid monster
long: The acid monster reaches out to corrode you.
desc: There is not much here except decaying flesh.

name: Doctor Guillotine
long: Doctor Guillotine is ready to behead you
desc: This man is quite inventive and eager to test his new toy

name: The evil centaur
long: The evil master centaur is staring at you.
desc:
This half-man and half-horse would draw and quarter you himself, but he
has too many volunteers today.

name: Vlad the Impaler
long: Vlad the Impaler is standing here.
desc: Vlad is everything you expect him to be...mean, nasty, and cruel.

name: the roper
long: A roper is looking for something to strangle.
desc: This creature has eight tentacles and a huge mouth with decaying teeth.

name: the giant octopus
long: A giant Octopus is swimming here
desc: This guy is pretty simple, 8 tentacles and a strong beak.

name: the giant Squid
long: A giant Squid is here, pulling victims underwater.
desc: Like his friend the octopus, he has many tentacles to grab you with.

name: the master torturer
long: The Master torturer of the underworld is standing here.
desc:
This spirit is big and mean, and he is going to show you the meaning of
pain.

name: Proserpina
long: Proserpina is weeping here.
desc:
This woman is really beautiful and has the most beautiful eyes you have
ever seen.

name: Pluto, ruler of the Underworld
long: Pluto, ruler of the Underworld is sitting here
desc: What do you expect??

name: Zeus
long: Zeus, ruler of the Gods, is standing here.
desc:
Zeus has a flowing white beard and is wearing gleaming white robes.
When he looks at you, you see lightning in his eyes, and you tremble
before his mighty presence.

name: Aphrodite
long: Aphrodite, the goddess of love, is standing here.
desc:
This is the most beautiful woman you have ever seen.  She is wearing a
very close fitting dress, and as you look into her eyes you fill like
melting like a lump of butter.

name: Hera
long: Hera, the wife of Zeus, is standing here.
desc:
This is one mean woman.  You better hope that she is not in a bad mood,
otherwise she could really do some damage.  She his lines in her face
that remind you of the stress Zeus places on her.

name: Apollo
long: Apollo, god of the sun, is standing here.
desc:
Apollo is wearing only a pair of white shorts.  He wears a crown made on
fire and he is holding a whistle in his left hand.  His eyes glow fiery
red and and you can see flames coming from his mouth.

name: Dionysus
long: Dionysus the god of wine is passing out here.
desc:
This man is really drunk, but he still looks like he could crush you if
he desired.  He is holding a huge flagon that is constantly emptied and
filled with wine.

name: Ares
long: Ares, the god of war, is preparing for battle
desc:
Ares is surely the strongest of the gods.  He is the prefect example of
a warrior.  He has bulging muscles and is fitted with the finest armor
possible.

name: Athena
long: Athena, the goddess of wisdom, is standing here.
desc:
She is the wisest of all the gods and perhaps the most noble.  She is
wearing very old armor and has a spear.  She smiles as you enter, but
she knows why you have come here.

name: Hermes
long: Hermes, the god of thievery, is standing here
desc:
Hermes is a teenager, and has very odd clothing.  He is only wearing a
pair of boots, and a tunic that fall to his thighs.  He looks very fast,
and clever.

name: A rabid dog
long: A rabid dog is foaming at the mouth here.
desc: This dog looks very sick.  WATCH OUT!

name: A witch
long: A wrinkled old lady is cackling here
desc: This foul lady is evil down to the last bone.

name: A cyclops
long: A one-eyed giant is standing here.
desc: Looks like a giant except it has only one eye in the center of its head.

name: The Cyclops King
long: The King of the Cyclops is resting here.
desc: He looks like the others, except he is much stronger.

name: A serpent
long: A huge serpent is hissing here.
desc: This is one of the largest snakes that you have ever seen.

name: A mermaid
long: A lovely Mermaid is singing here.
desc: This beautiful woman has the lower body of a fish.

name: A gorgon
long: A hideous gorgon is slithering here.
desc: This foul creature was once a beautiful maiden.

name: A Golem
long: A massive golem is guarding the gate.
desc: This golem is made from pure granite.

name: A harpy
long: A harpy is singing here.
desc:
This creature has the head of a woman, wings of a bird, and razor sharp
talons.

name: A pirate
long: A pirate is waiting to kill you.
desc: This man is cruel and wants to do nothing except hurt you.

name: Medusa
long: Medusa leaps form the shadows and tries to meet your gaze.
desc: Medusa is the most evil of the three gorgons.

name: A pirate corporal
long: A mean looking pirate is ready to kill you.
desc: This pirate is much larger than the rest and he looks quite tough.

name: An elf
long: An elven pirate is frozen by fear.
desc: Yup.. he definitely looks scared

name: A pirate leader
long: A pirate leader is trying to escape.
desc: This pirate is responsible for the pillaging of the Graecian coast.

name: A Minotaur
long: A Minotaur tries to impale you.
desc: The creature has the head of a bull and the lower body of a man.

name: The troll
long: A large, gross looking troll stands here
desc: He looks like a wrestler

name: the wilkey
long: An angry wilkey stands here, howling at the moon.
desc:
This wolf-like creature has shaggy black fur. His teeth are 
large, but his most menacing weapon is his horned snout. 
He doesn't seem happy to see you.

sounds.near: A horned creature rears back and howls at the moon.
sounds.far: You hear a dog's howl.

name: the owl
long: A Giant Owl snaps its beak at you.
desc: This giant owl is pretty mean looking. Best keep your distance.

sounds.near: A Giant Owl snaps its beak at you.

name: the huge eagle
long: A Huge Eagle is here ruffling its feathers.
desc: This huge bird is truly a work of nature. It has beautiful plumage.

sounds.near: The huge eagle ruffles her feathers.
sounds.far: You hear the caw of a large bird.

name: the Skexie Reject
long: A Skexie Reject makes his home in this pit.
desc: This Skexie is a gnarled old codger. His beak is horribly crooked.

sounds.near: A Skexie stands here pulling feathers from his head.
sounds.far: You hear someone grumbling.

name: the Festering Charik
long: A Festering Charik flashes his tail at you.
desc:
This armadillo type animal has a long pointed tail with a diamond
at its tip. Its scales look like pretty good protection.

sounds.near: The Festering Charik bangs his sharp tail on the ground.
sounds.far: You hear a thumping sound nearby

name: the Ghost of Brackenred
long: An Apparition hisses at you.
desc: This is the ghost of Brackenred. He's not expecting visitors today.

sounds.near: Brackenred cackles with insane glee.
sounds.far: You hear a ghostly, sinister chuckling noise

name: the flying rat
long: A Flying Rat whizzes by your head.
desc:
This is some sort of mutated pigeon/rat. His beak is really
sharp though!

name: a secrant
long: A trash eating Secrant gobbles some nearby junk.
desc:
This insatiable little guy looks like some sort of small dog.
He can open his jaws really wide, though, to let garbage into his
seemingly bottomless gullet.

sounds.near: The secrant engulfs some garbage.

name: the Skexie Guard
long: A Skexie guard is here checking your progress.
desc:
This Skexie has a certain robustness about him. His feathers 
are rather shiny. He's only here doing his job. Don't mess with him,
and he won't mess with you.

name: the Skexie Maiden
long: An ugly Skexie Maiden winks at you suggestively.
desc: Wow! Is she ugly!

name: the Skexie Matron
long: An obese, Matronly Skexie is here barking orders.
desc: Wow! Is she ugly! And so fat! Sheeesh!

sounds.near: The Skexie Matron barks some orders at you in an unknown tongue.
sounds.far: You hear someone squawking orders.

name: the Skexie Nanny
long: A Skexie Nanny tends to Skexie young here.
desc: She seems really run down from chasing these little demons.

name: the Fledgling Skexie
long: A Fledgling Skexie youth is here exercising his wings.
desc:
This little guys is really flapping hard. His young feathers
are still growing. His beak looks real sharp though.

sounds.near: The Fledgling Skexie flaps his wings.

name: the Ancient Mantern
long: An Ancient Mantern snickers at your feeble armor.
desc:
A cross between a human and a giant vulture, the Mantern is a 
relative of the Skexie. His claws are huge long spikes. Mantern's are
very hateful creatures. Queeklor is their god. He has magic in
his eyes!

name: the Skexie Guard
long: A Skexie guard is here using the facilities.
desc:
This Skexie has a certain robustness about him. His feathers 
are rather shiny. He's only here doing his job. Don't mess with him,
and he won't mess with you. Let him pull his pants up!

name: the Ancient Skexie
long: An Ancient Skexie with blue robes stands here performing a ritual.
desc:
This Skexie is really old. He has several talisman around
his neck. His wiry claws have many rings. His eyes are a fiery red. 
Do not bother him now, he is praying.

sounds.near: The Ancient Skexie repeats a mantra.
sounds.far: You hear the chanting of mantras nearby.

name: the Neathar Supervisor
long: A Neathar Construction Supervisor is here supervising some workmen.
desc: This man is rather strong and commands a great deal of respect.

name: the Neathar Workman
long: A Neathar Workman is here repairing the masonry.
desc: This man is rather strong and can carry huge bricks.

name: the Skexie Altar Boy
long: A Skexie Altar Boy is here praying quietly.
desc: This young Skexie seems to be a bit more studious than others.

name: Palthor the Skexie Sergeant
long: Palthor the Skexie Sergeant at Arms is here practicing his swordsmanship.
desc:
Palthor is a very strong middle-aged Skexie. He is red feathered 
and shows signs of many battles. He is a very serious Skexie, and prefers 
prefers to be left alone.

sounds.near: Palthor the Skexie Sergeant says, 'Welcome to the Skexie Palace.'
sounds.far: You hear a booming voice from somewhere close by

name: Wegendel the Skexie Illusionist
long: Wegendel the Skexie Illusionist waves his hands in a magical gesture.
desc:
Wegendel is a master of illusion. His feathers are green and red.
he has a very strong beak. He has several strings of decorative beads
hanging from his neck.

sounds.near:
Wegendel waves his hand, and a huge white dragon appears!
A huge white dragon now follows Wegendel.
sounds.far: You hear a roaring sound from nearby

name: Crandel the Skexie Mage
long: Crandel the Skexie Mage is here playing with reality.
desc:
Crandel is a master of magic. His feathers are green and red.
He has a very strong beak. An unusual mark has been burnt into
his chest. He often assists the Ancient Skexie in performing special
rituals.

sounds.near:
Crandel utters the words, 'frzlbkckm'
Crandel is surrounded by a glowing red aura.
sounds.far: You sense great energy nearby. The hairs on your neck stand on end.

name: Alastair the Skexie Leader
long: Alastair the Skexie Leader is here relaxing in an easy chair.
desc:
Alastair doesn't take his job too seriously. He is a very large 
robust Skexie. His feathers are red and yellow. His entire appearance
is a bit more professional than that the other Skexies, however.

sounds.near: Alastair the Skexie Leader says, 'Thank You for coming. Good Luck!'

name: Turendac the Skexie High Magister
long: Turendac the Skexie High Magister is here smoking a pipe.
desc:
Turendac is a very professional Skexie. He handles most of the 
disputes that occur among Skexie. He is highly revered for his 
intelligence and fairness.

name: the Skexie Child
long: A Deaf Skexie Child is here banging a big hammer on the ground.
desc: This Skexie cannot hear a thing.

sounds.near: A Skexie Child bangs a large hammer on the ground.
sounds.far: You hear banging and clanking.

name: the Skexie Jester
long: The Skexie Jester falls down laughing.
desc:
This Skexie is dressed in human clothing. The Skexie find
this very amusing.

sounds.near: The Skexie Jester falls down laughing.
sounds.far: You hear insane laughter.

name: the Skexie Magister
long: The Skexie Magister has a very serious look about him.
desc:
This Skexie is the assistant to the Skexie High Magister.
He takes his job very seriously. He says, "What are you doing in
my room! Get out!"

sounds.near: The Skexie Magister waves a quill at you threateningly.

name: the Skexie Scribe
long: The Skexie Scribe sits at a nearby desk scribbling frantically.
desc: He doesn't even care that you are looking. He keeps on writing.

sounds.near: The Skexie Scribe re-inks his quill, and continues to scribble frantically.

name: the Skexie Bard
long: The Skexie Bard is here fiddling with a strange instrument.
desc: He's not too impressed with you. He continues to twang away.

sounds.near: The Skexie Bard leisurely strums his unusual instrument.
sounds.far: You hear the faint sounds of music.

name: the Skexie Lair Guard
long: A Skexie Lair Guard stands here rather concerned about your presence.
desc:
The is a very big strong Skexie. Normally outsiders are not
welcome in the lair. You'd better go quickly to the Challenge Area.

name: the Mulichort
long: A Mulichort jumps up out of the tank and snaps his jaws at you.
desc: This is some sort of mean reptile!

name: the Champion of Queeklor
long: The Champion of Queeklor is here guarding the statue.
desc:
He is a 20' tall Golem with the head of a rat. His fists are 
the size of an average shield! He hits really hard!

name: the Champion of Rugrat
long: Ruggy the Champion of Rugrat is here guarding the statue.
desc:
He is a 20' tall Golem with the head of a rat. His fists are 
the size of an average shield! He hits really hard!

name: a Bachelor Skexie
long: A Skexie Bachelor relaxes on a nearby nest.
desc:
This Skexie has black and red feathers. He is otherwise a 
normal looking bird-man.

name: a Gentleman Skexie
long: A Skexie Gentleman sits in his chair.
desc:
This Skexie has black and orange feathers. He is otherwise a 
normal looking bird-man.

sounds.near: A Skexie Gentleman puffs on his pipe.

name: an Adolescent Skexie
long: A Skexie Adolescent is lying on the floor looking quite intoxicated.
desc:
Boy is he hammered! He has black and yellow feathers. He's been 
in a scuffle recently and has lost some feathers.

name: the Skexie Waiter
long: A Skexie Waiter is here preparing for a feast.
desc:
This Skexie has all black feathers. This job is considered 
very undesirable.

name: the Gelfling Child
long: A Gelfling Child throws a big snowball at you.
desc:
Fun and frolicking all the time. All fun, and no work. He 
points his finger and laughs at your appearance.

sounds.near: A Gelfling Child bounces around happily.

loads.roomName: The Home of Gilkey the Gelfling

name: the Blink Dog
long: A Blink Dog flashes into phase nearby.
desc:
This is no regular dog. He can travel ethereally. The Gelfling 
feed them and keep them as pets.

loads.roomName: The Home of Gilkey the Gelfling

name: the Striped Bechemel
long: A Striped Bechemel smiles cutely at you.
desc:
A friend of the Gelfling, the Bechemel come in all colors. 
This one happens to be black and white.

sounds.near: A Striped Bechemel offers you a tulip.

loads.roomName: The Home of Gilkey the Gelfling

name: the Polkadotted Bechemel
long: A Polkadotted Bechemel smiles cutely at you.
desc:
A friend of the Gelfling, the Bechemel come in all colors. 
This one happens to be Polkadotted.

sounds.near: A Polkadotted Bechemel offers you a tulip.

name: the Herringbone Bechemel
long: A Herringbone Bechemel smiles cutely at you.
desc:
A friend of the Gelfling, the Bechemel come in all colors. 
This one happens to be wearing a herringbone suit.

sounds.near: A Herringbone Bechemel offers you a tulip.

name: the Midnight Bechemel
long: A Midnight Bechemel smiles cutely at you.
desc:
A friend of the Gelfling, the Bechemel come in all colors.
This one happens to be wearing a midnight suit.

sounds.near: A Midnight Bechemel offers you a tulip.

name: the Gelfling Guardsman
long: A Gelfling Guardsman smiles broadly.
desc:
He is very happy to see you. He's glad that you will some 
day destroy the Skexies!

loads.roomName: The Home of Gilkey the Gelfling
The Home of Gilkey the Gelfling

name: the Gelfling Cleric
long: The Gelfling Cleric sits here meditating.
desc:
This Gelfling is dressed in white robes. His face is a pale 
color. His robes are lined with a golden silk.

sounds.near: The Gelfling Cleric repeats a lengthy mantra.
sounds.far: You hear someone reciting mantras.

name: Gilkey
long: Gilkey the Gelfling is here sharpening his knives.
desc:
Gilkey is highly respected among Gelfling. He is bearded and 
a bit portly.

sounds.near: Gilkey the Gelfling looks up from his work and smiles at you.

loads.roomName: The Home of Gilkey the Gelfling

name: the Gelfling Weaponsmaster
long: The Gelfling Weaponsmaster is here pounding away at some metal.
desc:
He is a very strong Gelfling. His muscles ripple, and he sweats, 
even in this cold environment.

sounds.near: The Gelfling Weaponsmaster slams a hammer upon the anvil. Sparks fly.
sounds.far: You hear clanking and hammering from somewhere nearby.

name: the Mad Gelfling
long: The Mad Gelfling stands here acting like a Skexie.
desc: Except for looking like a Gelfling, he acts like a Skexie.

sounds.near: The Mad Gelfling wanders around aimlessly.
sounds.far: Someone is yelling and cursing.

name: the Warrior Gelfling
long: A Gelfling Warrior is here socializing.
desc:
He is a more muscular Gelfling, and has more experience with 
fighting the Skexies.

sounds.near: The Gelfling Warrior drinks beer from a stein.
sounds.far: There is a party going on nearby.

name: the Beautiful Gelfling
long: A Beautiful Gelfling Woman smiles at you.
desc:
She is quite attractive. She has a wondrous body and lovely 
long dark hair.

name: the Porgi
long: A Porgi waddles around happily.
desc:
This is a penguin type creature with extra long feet. He is 
really cute.

sounds.near: A Porgi wanders around happily.

name: Feuq the Gelfling
long: Feuq the Gelfling is here working on some new traps for the Skexies.
desc:
Feuq is a very popular Gelfling. He makes the best traps 
among all the Gelfling.

name: Dasillea the Gelfling
long: Dasillea the Gelfling is wandering around searching for troublemakers.
desc:
Dasillea the Gelfling is a rather beautiful young woman. 
She is quite busty in fact!

name: Thrack the Gelfling
long: Thrack the Gelfling stands here. He smiles. Then gives you the bird!
desc:
Thrack is a really well known warrior. He also has a bit 
of a sense of humor.

sounds.near: Thrack the Gelfling runs about playing pranks.

name: Driscol the Gelfling
long: Driscol the Gelfling pokes you in the ribs.
desc: Driscol is a generally nice guy.

sounds.near: Driscol the Gelfling says, 'Nice to see you again!'

name: Horgg the Gelfling
long: Horgg the Gelfling Gentleman shakes your hand. He's really glad to see you.
desc: Horgg is very much a gentleman. Too bad you have to kill him.

sounds.near: Horgg the Geflling says, 'Wow! We haven't seen one another in so long!'

loads.roomName: The Home of Gilkey the Gelfling

name: a Lost Soul
long: A ghostly apparition floats here, staring at you in utter hatred.
desc: The lost soul is a ghostly apparition, seeking revenge on the living.

name: a dwarven worker
long: A dwarven mining worker is here.
desc: He is very dirty, and looks extremely over-worked.

name: the huge, green dragon
long: A huge green dragon is here, its narrow yellow eyes glowing with rage.
desc:
This enormous winged serpent has dark green scales covering most of its
colossal body.  Numerous holes in its heavy wings tell of many fights as does
the nicks in the horns on its head.  It smells as disgusting as only dragons
do.

name: the black enfan
long:
There is a positively evil enfan in front of you. He is dressed in black and
carries a large weapon.
desc: He looks like a large piece of licorice, only bigger.

name: A Polar Bear
long: A giant white polar bear is here.
desc:
A large white fur ball. He is handing out Klondike Ice Cream (tm) bars.
Would you like one?

name: The Enchanter
long: The Enchanter is here placing a dweomer upon well made sword

name: The master charmer
long: The master charmer utters the words, 'uuuzzldctz'
desc: The master charmer sizes you up, always looking for a new pet.

name: The Ringwraith
long: A Ringwraith stands here.
desc:
Dressed in black, it is almost invisible within the shadows. It promises
to be a formidable opponent

name: Sisyphus Jr.
long: Sisyphus Jr. of Corinth stands here, guarding the gate.
desc:
The once tyrannical King of Corinth has been consigned to barring
unqualified characters from entering the Tower.  A Sisyphean task indeed.

name: The Bengal tiger
long: A white Bengal tiger is here.
desc: Large and very ferocious looking.

sounds.near: A Bengal tiger growls and roars
sounds.far: You hear a ferocious roar nearby

name: the Elven Wizard
long: An Elven Wizard is here, creating fireworks for the festivities.
desc:
The Elven Wizard looks at you in a solemn sort of way.  His gaze seems
penetrate through your innermost being.  He is wearing a silvery cloak
and holding a multi-colored staff.  Although he appears to be older
than the oldest man, he seems to have an inner strength which most mortals
cannot overcome.

name: The Flame
long: The Flame hovers here before you.
desc:
The Flame flickers almost imperceptibly about you.  You can barely feel the
warmth, so gentle is The Flame.

name: the Queen Spider
long: The huge, bulky Queen Spider is here.
desc:
This disgusting creature is at the size of a small elephant.  It has eight
huge, hairy legs that would give it a tremendous speed on almost any surface
if it wasn't so immensely fat.  Its large, bulbous eyes stare back at you.

name: Raistlin
long: Raistlin the Arch-Magi
desc: You see nothing special.

name: the black enfan
long:
There is a positively evil enfan in front of you. He is dressed in black and
carries a large weapon.
desc: He looks like a large piece of licorice, only bigger.

name: A wizard
long: An old wizard is here making a speech

name: Anubis
long: Anubis sits in his throne, wearing a glowing key.
desc: He has the body of a man, and the head of a jackal.

name: The Librarian
long: The Librarian has fallen asleep at his desk here
desc: He looks like a rather peaceful old man.

name: the battle master
long: The battle master offers you the services of his fine trainees.
desc: The battle master is a wizened fighter, with many scars to prove his worth.

name: The High Priest
long: The High Priest is standing here
desc:
He is dressed in back robes and wields a very wicked mace he
would give you a very tough challenge

name: a dwarven guard
long: A dwarven guard is here.
desc: The guard looks very tough and mean.

name: The Necromancer
long: The Necromancer is here raising undead servants
desc:
Attired all in black, the Necromancer is tall and gangly, but still quite
an imposing figure. A dark cowl shrouds most of his face, but two blazing
embers which must serve as eyes can be seen through the shadow.
The Necromancer shrieks some obscenities and orders his minions to attack.

name: Lord Python of Castle Python
long: Lord Python is resting on his great throne.
desc:
Lord Python sits here contemplating higher realities and bad
sketches. However Python has killed more people on the battlefield
than you have ever seen.

name: Yevaud
long: Yevaud the Usurper of Shadowdale is here, grinning evilly at you.
desc: Old, scaly, but still with a lot of bite in him left.

name: the Grand Knight of Paladins
long: The Grand Knight of Paladins rests here, welcoming you to his guild.
desc:
He is huge warrior, clad in very magical armor, he rests here,
silently observing you.

name: a dwarven guard
long: A dwarven guard is here.
desc: The guard looks very tough and mean.

name: the Keeper of the Ring
long: The Keeper of the Ring is here, guarding his treasure jealously.
desc:
The Ring Keeper is a rather big but short halfling.  His short stature and
bulbous nose belie his true nature.  An elven sword that glows with a blue
light hangs from his belt, and on his finger you see the One Ring.  Although
usually a halfling of peace, he will fight you to the death if you attempt
to take away that which belongs to him.

name: A wandering minstrel
long: A wandering minstrel is here, playing a merry tune
desc: He smiles and bows

name: An aged mercenary
long: An aged mercenary stands here, staring at you suspiciously.
desc: He is old, but looks seasoned.

name: A merchant
long: A traveling merchant is here, he'll sell you just about anything.
desc: He looks pretty poor.

name: A pack horse
long: A pack horse is here, trotting steadily down the path
desc: It looks like a big dumb horse!

name: A mime
long: A mime is here, acting strange
desc: He seems to be feeding spaghetti to an Elephant.

sounds.near: The mime bumps into an invisible wall.
sounds.far: You hear someone chatting nearby

loads.roomName: At the top of the elevator

name: A pilgrim
long: A worshipper of Odin is here, acting pious
desc: She is dressed in simple brown cloth

sounds.near: The pilgrim hits herself over the head with a board
sounds.far: You hear someone chanting nearby

name: A dangerous looking man
long: A dangerous looking man is walking along the path here
desc: He looks like he is having a really bad day

name: A brigand
long: A brigand leaps to attack
desc: He is strong and dangerous looking

name: A bandit
long: A bandit grins and draws his sword
desc: He looks cunning and fearless

name: the bandit chief
long: An old bandit is standing here, giving orders
desc: He seems competent and experienced

name: A traveler
long: A weary traveler wanders about
desc: He looks as though he has walked many miles.

name: A traveler
long: A weary traveler wanders about
desc: He looks as though he has walked many miles.

name: A traveler
long: A weary traveler wanders about
desc: She looks as though he has walked many miles.

name: A traveler
long: A weary traveler wanders about
desc: He looks as though he has walked many miles.

name: An old man
long: An old man is here
desc: He is wearing faded brown robes and a mouse-brown hat

name: A lady
long: A richly dressed lady is here
desc: She is quite beautiful, and she looks like she has a lot of money

name: A knight
long: A knight in brilliant armor is here
desc: He looks noble and valorous

name: A squire
long: A squire is here, keeping track of his lord's equipment
desc: He looks young and flustered

name: A hawk
long: A hawk soars above you
desc: She looks noble and fierce

name: A mountain lion
long: A mountain lion leaps at you!
desc: He looks mighty hungry

name: A rattlesnake
long: A rattlesnake shakes his tail in warning.
desc: It is rather large for a snake... You probably want to go now...

name: A cleric
long: An elven cleric wanders in search of adventure
desc: He seems young and inexperienced

loads.roomName: The eastern edge of the ravine

name: A warrior
long: A dwarven warrior stands here, eyeing you gravely.
desc: He seems very stalwart

name: A thief
long: A mischievous thief stands here, eyeing your valuables
desc: He looks like he has sticky fingers

name: An ogre
long: An ogre roars as he attacks you!
desc: He looks large and mean

loads.roomName: At the Eastern edge of a large pile of rubble

name: A giant centipede
long: A giant centipede stands here, searching for food
desc: It looks mindless

name: A bard
long: A wandering bard is here, playing a tune.
desc: He is fat, and he looks like he enjoys his ale!

sounds.near: The bard sings a sweet tune
sounds.far: You hear a lovely singing voice nearby

name: A paladin
long: A noble paladin stands here
desc: He is noble and pure looking.  Kinda makes you sick just looking at him.

sounds.near: The paladin says 'Go north at thy own peril.'

name: A small gray goblin
long: A small gray goblin stands here, guarding the cave.
desc: He seems fairly muscular.

name: A small gray goblin
long: A wretched gray goblin stands here, running errands
desc: He seems rather pitiful, even for a gray goblin!

name: A gray goblin girl
long: A gray goblin girl stands here, playing with a piece of bone.
desc: She seems small and weak.

name: A white centipede
long: A small, white centipede scurries about,
desc: Its just a harmless insect, but it looks hungry!

name: A gray goblin
long: A gray goblin stands here
desc: It is weak, but it seems ready to defend its home.

loads.roomName: The entrance to the chief's area

name: A gray goblin guard
long: A gray goblin guard stands here.
desc: He looks ready to defend something.

loads.roomName: The entrance to the chief's area
The entrance to the chief's area

name: A gray goblin soldier
long: A gray goblin soldier stands here, preparing for battle
desc: He looks ready to fight.

name: The gray goblin chief
long: The gray goblin chief is here, eating his lunch.
desc: He looks like a fat bloated pig!

name: A gray goblin shaman
long: A gray goblin shaman is here
desc: He prepares to cast a spell at you

name: A dwarven worker
long: A dwarven mine-worker is here, working the mines
desc: He seems happy, and he sings to himself while he works.

sounds.near: The dwarven worker sings 'Hi Ho, Hi ho, its off to work I go.'
sounds.far: You hear a Disney tune in the distance.

name: A stirge
long: A stirge dives towards you
desc: Its large, stinger-like nose is pointed straight at you!

loads.roomName: The northern part of a deep ravine
The northern part of a deep ravine

name: A roc
long: A huge roc-bird stands here
desc: It is larger than a house, and twice as mean.

name: A harpy
long: A harpy is here, fouling her nest
desc: Disgusting creatures.  Too gross for print, really

name: A harpy sentry
long: A harpy sentry stands here, guarding the nest.
desc: She smells like guano, and looks like it too!

name: A hill giant
long: A hill giant stands here
desc: He seems happy with life.

name: A hill giant
long: A hill giant guards the gate
desc: He seems relaxed and content

name: A hill giant
long: A hill giant sleeps here, soundly
desc: His snores fill the room.

name: A hill giant
long: A hill giant sleeps here, soundly
desc: Her snores fill the room.

name: A hill giant
long: A hill giant sleeps here, soundly
desc: His snores fill the room.

name: A hill giant
long: A hill giant sleeps here, soundly
desc: Her snores fill the room.

name: A hill giant
long: A hill giant sentry stands here
desc: He watchfully looks down all passages for intruders

name: A dwarven prisoner
long: A pitiful dwarf stands here, waiting to be eaten
desc: He looks weak and scared

name: The giant king
long: The hill giant king is here, enjoying a feast
desc: He tears into his meat, looking for the tender parts

name: The giant queen
long: The hill giant queen is here.
desc: She is standing by her man.

name: The giant cook
long: The hill giant cook is here, roasting.
desc: She is huge, and mean looking.

name: A polar bear
long: A polar bear sleeps here at her lady's feet
desc: She snores loudly.  Good thing too!

name: A hill giant
long: A hill giant sits here, dining happily
desc: He seems to be enjoying his meal

name: A hill giant
long: A hill giant sits here, dining happily
desc: She seems to be enjoying her meal

name: A drow priestess
long: A drow priestess walks around her room, making plots.
desc: She is beautiful, and dangerous looking

name: A quasit
long: A tiny quasit stands here
desc: It looks evil, and malicious

name: Abdul
long: Abdul stands here smiling broadly.
desc:
Abdul is a tall muscular gypsy with a broad smile and a long 
black mustache.

sounds.near: Abdul says 'Welcome to my village'
sounds.far: You hear talking nearby.

name: The Gypsy Guard
long: The Gypsy Guard is guarding... well he's here, ok?
desc: You see a proud gypsy warrior.

name: The Gypsy Merchant
long: A Gypsy Merchant stands here, looking pleased.
desc:
You see a small, greedy little merchant, who would probably trade in his own
mother for a piece of change.

name: The Drunken Gypsy
long: A Drunken Gypsy staggers around here, looking nauseous.
desc:
You see a dishelved looking gypsy man, who is apparently tanked.
He seems to have vomit stains all over his clothes.

sounds.near: The Drunken Gypsy vomits noisily.
sounds.far: You hear retching sounds coming from nearby.

name: The Gypsy Child
long: A Gypsy Child runs around here, bugging the hell out of you.
desc:
You see a small child dressed in gypsy garb. From his state of hyperactivity,
you assume that Gypsies must have a lot of sugar in their diet.

sounds.near: The Gypsy Child says 'Ya wanna play?'
sounds.far: You hear a child babbling nearby.

name: The Palmreader
long: The Palmreader rests here with a glazed look in her eyes.
desc: You see what appears to be Shirley Maclaine dressed up as a gypsy whore.

name: An Ugly Dog
long: An Ugly Dog walks around, sniffing your shins.
desc: I said it was an ugly dog, why ya looking at it? Visual masochism? Sheesh.

name: The Gypsy Warlord
long: The Gypsy Warlord stands here imperiously.
desc: You see a giant gypsy warrior, who will die to protect his caravan.

name: The Gypsy Wizard
long: The Gypsy Wizard stands here ominously.
desc: You see a powerful mage who will die to protect his caravan.

name: The Gypsy Assassin
long: The Gypsy Assassin lurks in the shadows.
desc: You see a powerful thief willing to die for his caravan.

name: The Gypsy Paladin
long: The Gypsy Paladin stands here quietly.
desc: You see a powerful priest willing to die for his caravan.

name: The Warrior CaravanMaster
long: The Warrior CaravanMaster stands here, ready to train.
desc: You see one of the scariest looking warriors you have ever seen.

name: The Mage CaravanMaster
long: The Mage CaravanMaster stands here, ready to train.
desc: You see a mage that makes you shake in your shoes. Yes, he is bad.

name: The Thief CaravanMaster
long: The Thief CaravanMaster stands here, ready to train.
desc: You see a thief of great power before you. Best keep your hands to yourself.

name: The Priest CaravanMaster
long: The Priest CaravanMaster stands here, ready to train.
desc: You see a priest of great power before you. He is one with his god.

name: The Gypsy Shopkeeper
long: The Gypsy Shopkeeper is here, smiling from behind the counter.
desc:
You see a tall, fat gypsy, with a broad grin and a loud voice hawking his
items for trade.

name: The Gypsy Weaponsmith
long: The Gypsy Weaponsmith is here behind a counter, selling his weapons.
desc:
You see a massive gypsy warrior, who seems to need little use for his
weapons with muscles like that.

name: The Gypsy Armorer
long: The Gypsy Armorer is here, selling his items of protection.
desc: You see a massive gypsy warrior, who would probably kill you in a blink.

name: The Gypsy Alchemist
long: The Gypsy Alchemist stands behind his counter, fumbling through vials.
desc:
You notice that he seems to be sampling his wares at random....
which is a BIT disconcerting....

name: The Gypsy Bartender
long: The Gypsy Bartender is here, intent upon your intoxication.
desc: You see a heavily tattooed gypsy, serving drinks with a good attitude.

name: The Gypsy Marketmaster
long: The Marketmaster of the Gypsy Black Market looks down at you evily.
desc:
You see a dark, foreboding gypsy lord, who would kill you as soon as deal
with you. If you trade here, you are truly desperate.

name: The Gypsy Innkeeper
long: The Gypsy Innkeeper stands here, helping people upstairs.
desc: You see a kindly old gypsy man. Pretty wimpy looking. But maybe....

sounds.near: The Innkeeper says 'Enjoy your stay!'
sounds.far: You hear a kindly old voice nearby.

name: The Gypsy Receptionist
long: The Gypsy Receptionist is here, ushering people to their rooms.
desc:
You see a beautiful gypsy maiden. Just looking at her makes you want to
sleep here.

name: The Swamp Thing
long: The Swamp Thing stands here oozing.
desc:
You see a horrific pile of oozing slime, with an eerie yellow glow coming
from the twin sockets of its eyes. The bulk of this creature seems to be
made of the decomposing bodies of those who have died in the swamp, along
with large amounts of mud and vegetable material. He shows no sense of any
recognition, he seems to attack you out of nature.

name: A pile of vines
long: A pile of vines is here, twisting about madly.
desc:
The vines writhe with a serpentine quality, a faint yellow aura surrounds
them.

name: the ogre
long: An ogre stands here, grinning broadly.
desc: It looks rather pleased with itself.

loads.roomName: On the floor of a ravine
On the floor of a ravine

name: An ogre magi
long: An ogre magi stands here, feasting on human flesh.
desc: He is large, and vaguely oriental.

name: the ogre guard
long: An ogre stands here, guarding its home.
desc: It looks rather disturbed that you have gotten this close

name: The deep gnome
long: A deep gnome is here, mining precious stones.
desc: He looks very tough for such a small creature!

name: The cave turtle
long: A huge cave turtle swims about in these chill waters
desc: He is huge, and white.  He looks very hungry.

name: The mindflayer
long: The mindflayer walks around here, practicing magical incantations.
desc:
This is a horrifying monster indeed, 6'6" high. Dressed in purple and black,
with green skin peeking out. In the center of its head are four large
tentacles with very sharp points.

name: The mindflayer
long: The mindflayer is sitting here, studying a large book.
desc:
This mindflayer is six foot high. It has greenish skin, and is
dressed in purple and black cloth. It has four small tentacles in the 
center of its head.

name: The small wererat
long: A small wererat is here, scrounging for food.
desc:
The wererat is about four foot tall. It looks very much like rat, except
that it is standing, and seems to have prehensile hands.

name: The small wererat
long: A small wererat is here, watching its master
desc:
The wererat is about four foot tall. It looks very much like rat, except
that it is standing, and seems to have prehensile hands.

name: The cave gar
long: A huge form glides silently beneath you.
desc: It looks like a huge white fish, with lots of pointy teeth

name: The cave thing
long: A small, wretched creature squats here, shaking and muttering
desc:
It vaguely resembles a halfling, although it is clearly old, and
quite pitiful looking.   It snarls and shivers, truly an unpleasant
sight

sounds.near: The cave thing looks at you and moans 'Have you seen my pretties???'
sounds.far: You hear a low moan from somewhere nearby

name: The beholder
long: A viscous beholder waves it's many eyestalks at you.
desc:
It is a large sphere, floating 4 feet off the ground.   A large mouth,
and a single eye adorn the body, while 12 eyestalks crown the top of the
sphere.

name: A giant lizard
long: A subterranean lizard stands here
desc:
It is a large lizard, with stone-like plates on its back, which makes
it very hard to damage.

name: The giant slug
long: A giant slug is crawling here, sliming every flat surface in sight
desc:
He is really big, and rather putrescent.   A trail of slime leads
off into the distance.   By the way.. he looks very hungry (how can you tell?)

name: The drow soldier
long: An outcast drow soldier stares at you in anger.
desc: She appears to be an outcast from the small drow city to the east.

name: The drow warrior
long: An outcast drow warrior stands here, smirking evilly as you approach
desc: She seems to resent your intrusion into her home.

name: The drow cleric
long: An outcast drow cleric readies her weapon
desc: She seems to have fallen from grace with the goddess of the drow

name: The drow leader
long: The leader of the outcasts stares at you, wondering why you wish to die.
desc:
Although ragged and young, she is extremely beautiful, and quite 
a scrappy fighter to boot.

name: The huge cave lobster
long: A positively enormous white lobster is staring at you
desc:
This is the largest lobster you have ever seen.  It has apparently
been living in these tunnels for hundreds of years, feeding off of the
giant cave gars.   Now it seems to want to eat you for desert.

name: The death knight
long: An ancient form awakens as you intrude upon its prison
desc:
It is a spirit of incredibly potent evil, clearly imprisoned here
for countless centuries.   Bright red lights flare in its eye sockets.
Clearly, it enjoys the challenge you present to its imprisonment.

name: The mindflayer
long: A mindflayer stands here, studying ancient text.
desc:
It is a tall humanoid creature, with green skin, blank yellow eyes,
and four long tentacles dangling about its mouth opening.  They are
known to be powerful magicians.

name: The Hoeur
long: The Hoeur stands here guarding.
desc:
A huge man-bat creature with scaly wings, his body is glowing.
Now would be a good time to recall...

name: The Black Dragon
long: The Black Dragon is hungry, you are her food, DINNER time
desc:
The Black Dragon is huge and strong...  Her hide is thick, hard,
and jet black. She flaps wings, slaps her tail and the cavern shakes,
as she leaps at you.

name: The Portal guard
long: A Portal guard stands here to prevent creatures from leaving the Abyss.
desc:
A huge burly man stands here.  He tells you "Don't enter, or you will
surely die." He is wearing full plate mail and carries some very nasty
looking weapons.  He says "IF you do enter make sure you have a recall...
You've been warned."

name: A Priest
long: A Priest stands here uttering arcane words.
desc:
A man of the cloth, he adorns a long flowing black robe.  In one hand
he holds a mace adorned with dragon like features.  On his head is a long
and huge tattoo of a black dragon.  He says "Join us!"

name: A High Priest
long: A High Priest stands here, before an altar, waiting to perform a sacrifice
desc:
A GARGANTUAN man of the cloth stands here with a large flowing dragon cloak.
He says "Join us, we will rule the world!"  He has a scepter with a dragon's
claw on it.

name: The Minotaur
long: The Minotaur stands here licking his wicked blade.
desc:
A huge half-man, half-bull humanoid is standing here licking its evilly
curved and wicked blade.  You see him flaring his nostrils at you and you
wonder if it isn't time to leave.

name: A Elven warrior
long: A Elven warrior stands here guard a doorway into the unknown
desc:
A tall but slender man, with pointed ears and green almond eyes, stands here
mindlessly fingering his sword and mutter words in a arcane fashion.  He says
in a rich baritone voice "Please go away, I don't have time to talk, I must
guard this portal with my life."

name: The Drow Maiden
long: A female drow warrior stands here looking very displeased
desc:
A female drow warrior is standing here balancing a dagger on her finger.
She says in a high pitched squeal, "Leave now, or DIE!"  She then draws her
weapons.  You'd better do something fast!

name: A Air Elemental
long: An Air Elemental is here, racing madly about the room.
desc: A tornado with glowing green eyes swirls about the room.

name: A Earth Elemental
long: A Earth Elemental stands here, he contorts his ugly face in a silent scream.
desc:
A man-like creature rises out of the ground, with fists the size of small
boulders.  It doesn't appear to like you very much at all!

name: A Fire Elemental
long: A Fire Elemental burns here consuming all in sight.
desc:
It coughs and hacks.  Telepathically it tells you, "Buddy, gotta light?"
It explodes into many great balls of fire.

name: A Water Elemental
long: A Water Elemental rises out of the pool, it's not happy to see you!
desc: It is huge wave like thing.  It squirts you, playfully.

name: the shining blue dragon
long: A large elder wyrm blue dragon rises up to tower above you.
desc:
This dragon is one of the largest of its kind. Residing here for centuries, He
is not at all pleased with your intrusion on his home.

name: the trapper
long: A trapper mimics the wall, waiting to snare its next meal.
desc:
This monster can mimic any part of a dungeon corridor, acting on instinct
alone it seeks out its prey to survive.

name: the shade
long: A dark figure that seems to part of the shadow.
desc:
The shade seems to draw his power from the surrounding shadows of the room. He
is wielding a black blade created from the substance of shadow.

name: the sorceress
long: An evil sorceress with an insane glint in her eye.
desc:
She has fire red hair and emerald green eyes, and is as beautiful as she is
mad.

name: the skulk
long: An evil skulk is lurking here.
desc:
It blends in with its surroundings almost to the point where you can't see it.
It is nothing but a coward, seeking to kill its prey while they sleep.

name: the ochre jelly
long: A large almost transparent slick is crawling along the floor.
desc:
It looks like a giant amoebae, looking around for bits of flesh and cellulose 
to consume.

name: the mobat
long: A vicious mobat swoops up from below to attack
desc:
A giant cave bat with red eyes swoops up from the blackness below in search
of its next meal.

name: the amber golem
long: A tall figure stands here baring your passage.
desc:
Staring at you with unthinking eyes, this creature is over 14 feet tall and
made out of solid amber.

name: the specter lord
long: A misty figure of pure evil begins to form.
desc:
Created from the souls of the evil dead in this crypt, this specter looks to 
be one of the most powerful of his kind.

name: the pit fiend
long: A tall dark figure with the look of death in his eyes.
desc:
This is a large hulking beast with bat wings and talon-like fangs, who doesn't
look all to happy to be here or to see you.

name: Miko
long: Miko, princess of this castle, is about to make you a permanent resident.
desc:
Dressed in bloodied robes, she stares at you with a sinister smirk and an evil
glint in her eye. Boy are you in trouble!

name: the styx devil
long: A styx devil flies in ready to defend itself.
desc:
It has large wings and an elongated forehead, it's so horrid you retch
and fall to your knees just looking at it!

name: the ghoul
long: A ghoul is scavenging around looking for some flesh to feast upon.
desc:
Digging through the graves of the recently buried the ghoul is feasting on
the decaying flesh of the dead.

name: the ghast
long: A ghast is mulling about among the graves.
desc:
It looks almost exactly like a ghoul, except for the horrid stench that it
emits you'd never know the difference.

name: the wraith
long: A misty wraith is drifting around here.
desc:
Made up of the pure negative energy the wraith feasts upon the life energy of 
all living creatures.

name: the skeletal warrior
long: A skeletal warrior stands guard here.
desc:
Larger than a regular skeleton and certainly more power, this skeleton looks 
as if it has been standing guard here for centuries.

name: the death knight
long: The death knight is here praying at his unholy altar.
desc:
This is a fallen knight paladin, whom during his life broke his vows and is 
now cursed for his evil actions in life. He is armored in obsidian platemail,
and stands before an altar covered in dried blood and defecation. His eyes
glow with an Erie reddish light and he seems to be drawing his power from the
altar itself.

name: the gargoyle
long: A gargoyle guards the entrance to the castle.
desc:
Made of stone the gargoyle looks just like any of the stone statues you would 
find adorning the guilds of midgaard. The only difference is this one is 
alive.

name: Charon
long: Charon the boat man of the river styx is here, selling his boats.
desc:
A tall dark figure dressed in robes that cover all of his features. He holds a 
black staff in one hand and a is prepared to sell safe transportation for a
*slight* fee to anyone who is in need.

name: the ice devil
long: An ice devil stands here with an unfeeling look on his face.
desc:
A figure not much taller than your average hill giant, it has eyes of azure 
and a powdery blue complexion. It is somewhat beautiful in a twisted sense.

name: the bone devil
long: A bone devil hisses at you in defiance.
desc:
This monster is one of the lesser devils of this plane. He stands nearly nine
feet tall and has a tail with a poisonous barbed stinger on the end.

name: the manes demon
long: A manes demon is staring you with an insane bloodlust.
desc:
A man sized figured with long taloned hands. It has been summoned here by a 
greater power to serve without question.

name: the dying man
long: A weak and dying man looks at you with pleading eyes.
desc:
This is one of Kaylor's mighty paladins. He has been beaten and tortured, to 
near death. He speaks to you in a voice so weak you have to get right next to 
him to hear. He says 'the death knight draws his power from the altar, beware 
the evil that lies below...' Then he passes out.

name: the succubus demon
long: A beautiful humanoid female looks at you with an alluring stare.
desc:
She looks almost human except for the wings and the fangs. She's strangely 
alluring even as she is coming at your throat.

name: the enchantress
long: An evil enchantress is here, preparing to cast a spell.
desc:
Dressed in exquisite robes with flowing red hair and blue eyes. She smiles 
in your direction as she begins to intone some strange words.

name: the evil patriarch
long: The high patriarch has been resting here, waiting for you to arrive.
desc:
Dressed in a flowing green robe, he stares at you with extreme loathing in his
eyes. He doesn't seem pleased with your presence, however he doesn't look all
surprised by it.

name: baalzebul
long: The arch-devil Baalzebul is here, laughing at you.
desc:
With the head of a fly, he stares at you with extreme contempt. Wondering 
what possessed you to seek him out and loose your feeble life.

name: dispater
long: The arch-devil Dispater is floating here, peering at you quizzically.
desc:
He is evilly handsome, and only his small horns, tail and cloven left hoof 
distinguish him from humanity. He wields a rod and staff which emanate pure 
power.

name: moloch
long: The arch-devil Moloch looks upon you with disgust.
desc:
He is a great square bodied creature with red-orange skin, short thick arms 
and legs, and huge square hands. His feet and head are horned. His head is huge
with slanting eyes and a gaping mouth.

name: bael
long: Bael, the duke of hell stands here hating everything.
desc:
He is a well formed humanoid with golden skin. His head is rather long and 
has small, forward curling bull horns. His features are rather bovine with large, round eyes, a long and board nose, and protruding ears.

name: the dretch demon
long: A dretch demon patrols the castle.
desc:
It has a round, rubbery body and thin spindly arms and legs. Its mouth is 
slack and slobbering with many small fangs.

name: the ultrodaemon
long: An Ultrodaemon is sneaking around on patrol.
desc:
It is a shadowy creature with a featureless face and large round eyes that 
resemble fire opals.

name: the rutterkin
long: A rutterkin demon lurks about here.
desc:
Humanoid in shape, it resembles an ugly human. Completely hairless, misshapen 
limbs and large features.

name: a nabassu
long: A nabassu demon stands here gating in more of its kind.
desc:
A tall, than scaly form. It has a long head with small horns and bat-like
features, and small hands with long digits of razor sharpness.

name: the priestess of Odin
long: A priestess of Odin is standing here smiling at you.
desc:
Dressed in nothing but a long white gown, she has emerald green eyes and long
flowing red hair. Her features are perfect, you are so awed by her beauty you
couldn't bring yourself to harm a single hair on her head.

name: the darken beast
long: A winged skeletal creature swoops in to attack.
desc:
A large winged bat-like creature, it looks like a cross between a wyvern and a
pterodactyl. It has black, reptilian hide, fangs, razor sharp claws and dimly
lit glowing red eyes.

name: the hell hound
long: A very large black dog surrounded by a fiery aura.
desc:
It has rusty red fur and deep red glowing eyes. It's eyes, teeth and markings
are soot black and it has the distinct odor of smoke and sulfur.

name: A large wererat
long: A large wererat stands here, glaring at you.
desc:
