The wererat is about six feet tall.  He is eyes your purse appreciatively,
then attempts to liberate it.

name: A huge wererat
long: A huge wererat stands here, ordering the other wererats to attack.
desc:
The huge wererat appears to be in charge of his younger cousins, he 
probably helps Count Boarish run the criminal elements of life in the city 
(basically everything).

name: A powerful werewolf
long: A powerful werewolf stands here, looking at you hungrily.
desc:
A large, muscular wolf-like creature standing about seven feet tall.  It 
plans to solve its malnourishment difficulties with your corpse.

name: A lithe weretiger
long: A lithe weretiger standing here, slashes at you angrily.
desc:
A powerful lythcanthrope, weretigers are notorious for their like of 
ripping humans limb from limb.

name: A wereshark
long: A wereshark crawls onto the dock out of the Black Sea.
desc:
The wereshark is one of the most vicious sea creatures, it was rumored
that they were extinct, apparently not.  It stands about ten feet high, 
lunging at you with powerful jaws.

name: Pooh the werebear
long: Pooh the Werebear is resting here after a day of werewolf hunting.
desc:
Pooh the famous good-natured werebear is relaxing in his home.  He looks
up at your arrival and says, "Hello there, I hope you didn't have any 
difficulty getting here... those bad little werewolves are always getting the
way.  I would show you a map of the land that I've explored back in my 
adventuring days, but the evil Count Boarish has stolen it from me."

name: The werefox mistress
long: The werefox mistress angrily attacks you for interrupting her preening.
desc:
Count Boarish's mistress a lovely silvery colored werefox is standing
before the mirror preening herself.  She snarls at you before attacking.

name: A werebadger
long: A werebadger is partaking in the entertainment The Wild Boar provides.
desc:
The werebadger looks extremely angry for being interrupted in one of
his favorite pastimes, he attacks with only the fury a angry werebadger
can deliver.

name: A werefox whore
long: A werefox whore is helping the werebadger partake.
desc:
The werefox whore was busy doing her job until you interrupted, she 
doesn't take kindly to you looking at her either.  (you haven't even paid!)

name: Count Boarish the Wereboar
long: Count Boarish the Wereboar snorts at you angrily.
desc:
Count Boarish, the ruler of Lythcanthropia, is busy counting his money,
he doesn't appreciate you interrupting him.  He is the largest lythcanthrope
you have every seen, about 14' tall.  He has massive tasks which uses to
gore his opponents (you).

name: The ugly wererat
long: An ugly wererat is here, looking at you with a strange flick of his eyes.
desc:
The wererat is about four feet tall.  It looks very much like a rat, except
that it is standing.

name: The black pudding
long: The black pudding is scavenging trash here.
desc:
This 8' diameter mass has billions of microscopic mouths dripping
corrosive saliva.

name: The invisible stalker
long: The invisible stalker stalks you.
desc: You can't see it!

name: The wight
long: The wight winces at your light.
desc: This undead hates all life.

name: The bugbear
long: A bugbear is pissing on the wall here.
desc: It's 8' tall and covered with light brown fur.

name: The gynosphinx
long: The gynosphinx sits here proudly.
desc: It has the upper torso and head of a woman.

name: The shadow
long: A shadow is projected on the wall.
desc: You can't really see it very well.

name: The air elemental
long: The air funnels viciously!
desc: It looks like a vortex.

name: A geyser spouts below you
long: A geyser bubbles here, It could mean instant death.
desc: it looks like it could blow any second!

name: The green slime
long: A green slime is lurking.
desc: It's violet....duh!

name: The Vampire Amelia
long: A vampire is sleeping here.
desc: Very cute, but Lethal!

name: The giant crab
long: The largest crab you've ever seen guards this portal!
desc: It must be 8' in diameter!

name: The mimic
long: Wave awaits you here.
desc: It doesn't look like a trident anymore.

name: The ghoul
long: A ghoul is stinking here.
desc: Looks like it's back from the grave!

name: The giant crayfish
long: A giant crayfish is floating and snapping its pincers.
desc: It's about 10' long!

name: The sea lion
long: A sea lion swims here.
desc: It has a lion's upper-half and a shark's lower-half.

name: A chubby hobbit
long:
A chubby hobbit reclines in an armchair here.
Qesnef raises his hand in greeting, "I've been waiting for you."
desc: You see a very powerful ogre-magi through the illusion.

name: The flesh golem
long: A flesh golem stares without expression.
desc:
It shows no emotion, as if controlled by an outside force.
	There is a large 'January' on its chest

name: The flesh golem
long: A flesh golem stares without expression.
desc:
It shows no emotion, as if controlled by an outside force.
	There is a large 'February' on its chest

name: The flesh golem
long: A flesh golem stares without expression.
desc:
It shows no emotion, as if controlled by an outside force.
	There is a large 'March' on its chest

name: The flesh golem
long: A flesh golem stares without expression.
desc:
It shows no emotion, as if controlled by an outside force.
	There is a large 'April' on its chest

name: The flesh golem
long: A flesh golem stares without expression.
desc:
It shows no emotion, as if controlled by an outside force.
	There is a large 'May' on its chest.

name: The robo-sentry
long: A robo-sentry stands here, its red optic laser scanning in all directions.
desc:
It looks like a 3 foot barrel on two treads with arms.  You notice one
arm has a nasty edge to it.

name: A camp guard
long: A nomad dressed in armor under desert robes watches you.
desc:
The nomad camp guard looks relaxed and seems to take no concern
over your presence.  However, despite his casual attitude you can feel
his eyes on you, and you see a glint of steel beneath his robes when the
wind picks up.  You know that the wrong move could cause him to eagerly
fight you to the death.

name: The merchant
long: The merchant shows you his goods, eyeing your coin pouch in anticipation.
desc:
The merchant is dressed in somewhat richer robes than the common
passerby outside.  He happily points to one item, then the next, all the
while babbling a stream of compliments and encouragement. Judging from
the gleam in his eye he is eager to make another sale.

sounds.near: The merchant shoves an item in your face, telling you an incredible price.
sounds.far: A merchant calls to you from a nearby stall, hawking his goods.

name: A camel
long: A camel stands here, eyeing you with disdain.
desc:
The camel is of the double-humped variety, more suitable for
carrying cargo across the hot desert sands.  It looks you over, then
scornfully spits at your feet.

name: A horse
long: A horse stands here, stomping his hoof as you approach.
desc:
The horse is lean and looks tough.  I is one of the hardy desert-
breed, built to go long miles across the desert with only small amounts
of scrubby plants and water.

name: An angry nomad
long: A nomad stands here, arguing in a loud voice and yelling curses.
desc:
The nomad's face is beginning to go purple with rage as he argues
with his companions.  You try to see what caused the gleam that
attracted your eye, but his long robes cover all.

sounds.near: The nomad utters an extremely vile curse, and you remember it for later use.
sounds.far: You hear a few voices shouting nearby.

name: The thug
long: A man stands here in the shade of the tent.
desc:
The man is dressed head to toe in a dirty desert robe wrapped
tightly about his body.  He has an evil gleam in his eye, and as he
approaches you he pulls a shining object from a pocket inside his
robe.

name: The Slave Master
long: The Slave Master yells "Get away from my slaves!  Kill the intruders!"
desc:
The slave master is a large, dirty, pot-bellied man, his lips curled
in a perpetual sneer.  He obviously enjoys his work, and from his
expression, it seems he wants to make you his next pet project.

name: The Caravan Master
long: The Caravan Master is here, looking over various trade documents and maps.
desc:
The caravan master is clothed in a white robe trimmed with gold and
he wears on his head a turban holding a sparkling red gem.  Despite his
rich clothing, he appears quite fit and strong, and the large two-handed
scimitar at his feet shows the signs of hard use.

name: A large nomad guard
long: A rather large nomad watches you, his two-handed scimitar close at hand.
desc:
This nomad is larger than most of the other nomads you've seen.  He
looks very strong, and appears to know how to use that two-handed
scimitar he holds ready.  He follows you with his his gaze, waiting for
any possible hostile action.

name: A palace gate guard
long: A Palace Guard stands here watching travelers pass through the gate.
desc:
This man is outfitted in metal armor barely concealed by his
sun-blocking white robe.  He stands casually at his post, but he looks
alert and you have heard that the Pasha's Palace Guard are trained to
fight fiercely to the death.

name: The snake charmer
long: The snake charmer sits here blowing his flute.
desc:
The snake charmer is a small brown-skinned man.  He is wearing only
a loincloth and head wrap.  His body is covered in sparkling beads of
sweat, but you can't tell whether that's from the fierce rays of the sun
or from his concentration on his playing.

sounds.near: A simple but haunting melody floats from the snake charmer's flute.
sounds.far: You hear faint strains of music drifting on the wind.

name: The charmed snake
long: A snake arises from the basket, swaying in time to the music.
desc:
This large sandy-brown snake is swinging back and forth, bobbing
its head as the snake charmer plays his flute.  You notice the snake's
pointed fangs and understand why the snake charmer has such a look of
concentration on his face.

sounds.near: The snake writhes and bobs with the flute music.

name: A desert traveler
long: A desert traveler, burdened with small bags and packages, walks by.
desc:
The desert traveler is outfitted with loose-fitting robes and a
hood to shade himself from the harsh sun.  He is carrying quite a few
packages, probably everything he owns, as he journeys across the desert.

name: A nomad trader
long: A nomad trader is here exhibiting his goods and haggling with passerby.
desc:
The trader carries his small selection of merchandise with him.
You see him step in the way of passerby and show them his goods,
hoping to interest them enough to get a sale.  More often than not he
is ignored.

name: A wandering dervish
long: A wandering dervish stands here, dirty from his long desert journeys.
desc:
The dervish is unkempt and dirty, and looks ill-at-ease among
crowds of this size.  He maintains an aloof posture, which is fine with
the rest of the crowd because of his state of (more than normal)
uncleanness.

name: A hopeless slave
long: A hopeless and dispirited slave is here, waiting to be sold.
desc:
The slave is dressed in only a few rags, and is red and burnt all over
from the scorching rays of the sun.

name: The slave trader
long: The slave trader is here exhibiting his slaves.
desc:
The slave trader is dressed in desert robes and carries a baton
which he uses to poke and beat the slaves.  He has a greedy glint in his
eye, and shows no compassion for the cares of the slaves.

name: A veiled woman
long: A woman wrapped head to toe in a loose robe hurries by.
desc:
This woman is totally concealed by the folds of her robe, with only
her eyes showing.  She glances at you as she comes near you, then
quickly averts her eyes and hurries on.

name: Emilither
long: Emilither paces the room, trying to remember what he's brewing.
desc:
Emilither is a stately old Mage, garbed in mouse-colored robes, and the
tattered remnants of a graying beard.  His puzzled expression is that of
undiscovered bewilderment.

sounds.near: Emilither says 'Hrm...healing potions require belladonna, no?'
sounds.far: Off in the distance, someone babbles random confusion.

name: Belmirek
long: Belmirek the Jeweler stands here, appraising you with his beady eyes.
desc: He looks like a fink.

name: Heimslan
long: Heimslan stands at the counter, taking inventory.
desc: A tall, brooding man.  He looks around, then smiles at you.

name: Damathar
long: Damathar the Blacksmith is standing here.
desc:
Damathar is a man of great muscular strength; ideal for his work of forging
metals.  His long, fiery red hair falls over one eye as he peers at you,
inspecting your manner.

name: Syrathen
long: Syrathen the Healer stands here.
desc: You see before you a young, bright cleric.

name: Illyari
long: Illyari sits here, at a desk.  She appears to be filing papers.
desc:
Illyari is a small, elven maiden.  Her long, dark hair seems to
flow down her shoulders.  Best not to look too long, as she may become
offended, and unpredictable.

name: the Guildmaster
long: Gilda the Mage guildmaster is standing here.
desc:
Even though your guildmaster looks old and tired, you can clearly see the
vast amount of knowledge she possesses. She is wearing fine magic clothing,
and you notice that she is surrounded by a blue shimmering aura.

name: the Guildmaster
long: Ron the Cleric guildmaster is standing here.
desc:
You are in no doubt that this guildmaster is truly close to your god; he has
a peaceful, loving look. You notice that he is surrounded by a white aura.

loads.roomName: The Room of the Healing Arts

name: the Guildmaster
long: Polly the Rogue guildmaster is standing here.
desc:
You realize that whenever your guildmaster moves, you fail to notice it -
the way of the true thief. She is dressed in poor clothing, having
the appearance of a beggar.

name: the Guildmaster
long: Rob the Warrior guildmaster is standing here.
desc:
This is your master. Big and strong with bulging muscles. Several scars
across his body proves that he was using arms before you were born. He
has a calm look on his face.

name: Shazilmira
long: Shazilmira the Master Wizard is guarding the entrance.
desc:
He is an experienced mage who has specialized in the field of Combat Magic.
He is here to guard the Mage's Guild and his superior knowledge of offensive as
well as defensive spells make him a deadly opponent.

loads.roomName: The Entryway to The Guild of Magicians

name: Grenath
long: Grenath the High Priest is guarding the entrance.
desc:
He is a specially trained warrior belonging to the military order of the Faith.
His duty is to protect the faithful from persecution and infidel attacks and
his religious devotion combined with his superior skill makes him a deadly
opponent.

loads.roomName: The Entryway to The Guild of Clerics

name: Hyiastrin
long: Hyiastrin the Master Thief is guarding the entrance.
desc:
He is a thief who has specialized in killing others as effectively as possible,
using all sorts of weapons.  His superior knowledge of how and where to use
them combined with his extraordinary stealth makes him a deadly opponent.

loads.roomName: The Entryway to The Guild of Thieves

name: Melchar
long: Melchar the Human Lord is guarding the entrance.
desc:
He is an expert warrior who has attained knighthood through countless
chivalrous deeds.  His duty is to protect the Guild of Warriors and his
extreme skill combined with his experience in warfare makes him a deadly
opponent.

loads.roomName: The Entryway to The Guild of Warriors

name: Adair
long: Adair Bladebreakers stands behind the bar, mixing drinks.
desc:
A longtime Mercenary, Adair Bladebreakers has retired to a good life
as owner and barkeeper of Der Ratskeller's Bar and Grille.  He is of
medium height, of stocky build, and has long, black hair.  His left
eye is obscured by an ornate red eye patch.

name: the City Patrolman
long: A City Patrolguard stands here, watching for trouble.
desc: You see a well-trained soldier of the peace.

loads.roomName: Outside the Southern Gate of Mordilnia

name: the Streetsweeper
long: A streetsweeper is walking around, sweeping the streets.
desc: He has a look of pure bored content on his face..

name: the rabid cur dog
long: A cur dog is here, foaming at the mouth.
desc: Perhaps you should stay away from it?

loads.roomName: Inside the Southern Gate of Mordilnia

name: the Gladiator
long: A Gladiator stands here, taking a break from the arena.
desc: He looks pretty scarred to you.

loads.roomName: Inside the North Gate of Mordilnia

name: the Citizen
long: A wandering citizen is standing here..
desc: Nothing spectacular here....

name: the Pauper
long: A pauper is here, bedraggled and filthy.
desc: The pauper looks like she has never eaten in her life.

sounds.near: The pauper says 'Dost thou have a moment, kind one? Alms for the poor!'
sounds.far: You hear someone begging nearby

name: Sylira
long: Sylira the Swordpupil is standing here.
desc:
You see nothing special about her...but she does have an evil glint in her
eye...

name: the Gateguard
long: A gateguard stands here, alertly doing his job.
desc:
A hulking, armor-encrusted guard.  He has a look of helpfulness about
him.

name: the City Watchman
long: A City Watchman is here, patrolling the area.
desc:
You see a large, dark-mooded guard of the Watch standing before you,
glancing in various directions for lawbreakers of every sort.

loads.roomName: The Entryway to The Guild of Magicians
Inside the Southern Gate of Mordilnia

name: the evil rogue
long: An evil-looking rogue crouches here in the shadows.
desc:
He is a scruffy-looking character, with a nasty scar on his face.  His
clothes are all black, and he carries an assortment of knives with him.

name: A glowing green Orb
long: The Glowing Green Orb Pulsates with energy.
desc: You are BLINDED for a few seconds as you are forced to look away!

name: Inhep the Huge Giant
long: Inhep the Minion of Evil
desc:
You see a Huge green creature whose all white eyes stare into you.
Inhep is dripping with blood.

name: A pale gaunt man
long: A pale gaunt man stares at you.
desc:
You see a pale gaunt man with taut muscles
and a strong facial structure. His eyes see
right through you.

name: Shadow guard
long: A large Shadow guards the door.
desc:
You look into a shadow and feel slightly disorented!
Your eyes black out for a moment.
The shadow is fifteen feet tall.

name: A bloody corpse.
long: A blood corpse screams in agony.
desc:
Blood covers this once human form. Its limbs are swolen and infected
The corpse lunges towards YOU!

name: A bloody guard.
long: A blood covered guard attacks YOU!
desc:
You see a huge creature whose eys glow green.
You feel your energy leaving you as he draws near.

name: A huge guard.
long: A huge guard attacks you.

name: A strange looking man
long: A strange looking man is here.
desc: You see a man who should have been dead years ago.

name: A man covered in mushrooms
long: A man covered in mushrooms emits spores into the room.

name: An Insectoid Guardian
long: An Insectoid Guardian blocks your way

name: A Grotesque guardian
long: A stone gargoyle stands here

name: A doctor
long: A decomposing doctor is here.

name: A rotting man
long: A previous patient lies here on the cot.

sounds.near: A rotting corpse screams in pain!
sounds.far: You hear a loud scream

name: A Huge guard
long: A huge guard blocks your way.

name: An undead warden
long: The warden rots in the corner.

name: An undead guard
long: An undead guard stands here

name: A death row inmate
long: A death row inmate stands here

name: A large guard
long: A large glowing guard stands here

name: A glowing green guard
long: A glowing green guard stands here

name: A man covered in spores
long: A man covered head to toe in spores stands here

name: A dirty prisoner
long: A dirty prisoner lies here on the floor.

name: An infirmary guard
long: An infirmary guard stares at you!

name: A mercenary stands here
long: A mercenary wanders about.

name: An evil man
long: An evil man peers around.

name: A bloody nurse
long: A nurse covered in blood stands here.

name: A large glowing guard
long: A blood covered guard is here.

name: A thief dressed in green
long: A rather large thief dressed in green stands here.

name: A gaunt man
long: A gaunt man stands here staring into space.

name: A goblin
long: A goblin is here, arguing over a few coins on the floor.
desc: He looks scrawny, hungry perhaps?

name: A trader
long: You see a man lying on a bed peacefully.

name: A stirge
long: A stirge flies towards you at great speed and attacks!
desc: It does NOT look happy about you being here.

name: A large kobold
long: A large, rust-brown kobold stands here, eyeing you suspiciously.
desc: He doesn't know whether to trust you or not.

name: A giant shrew
long: A giant shrew scuttles around the room..
desc: The shrew has no eyes, and "sees" with its ears..

name: A huge white wolf
long: A huge white wolf jumps up and pounces on you!
desc: Its drooling at you.. better not let it get what it wants, would ruin your whole day.

name: The evil priestess
long: A priestess of Set kneels at the altar here.
desc:
She looks at you through blackened eyes.. you can tell she's been through
a lot in her life.

name: The fire beetle
long: A huge beetle sits on a dusty carpet here.
desc: Funny, he seems to be glowing..

name: A spitting cobra
long: A spitting cobra slithers out of a sack on the floor and attacks!

name: The bandit
long: A bandit is here, eyeing you suspiciously.
desc: He has obviously made this room a hideout, and doesn't like you intruding.

name: The bandit leader
long: The bandit leader is here, giving you an icy glare.
desc:
He has the bandits under his control and will do anything to get you out
of here.

name: A wandering goblin
long: A goblin is here, wandering through the hallways..

name: Edgar
long: Edgar the Swordpupil/Believer is standing here
desc:
You see before you the great Edgar!  Adorned in the finest adamantine 
armor, he bulges his huge muscles, and frightens you into submission.
Best step cautiously around me!

name: the young spider
long: The young spider is ballooning by you.
desc:
He looks freshly hatched and sprightly.  His young fangs are just
growing in as of late.

name: Yevaud
long: Yevaud the Usurper of Shadowdale is here, grinning evilly at you.
desc: Old, scaly, but still with a lot of bite in him left.

name: the Wolf Spider
long: The Wolf Spider is here, licking its bloody fangs.
desc: The Wolf Spider is hairy, very hairy.

loads.roomName: A Link in the Ethereal Web
A Link in the Ethereal Web
A Link in the Ethereal Web

name: the orc
long: The orc is stuck in the web and he can't get out.
desc: You notice an evil look in his eyes.

name: the Queen Wasp
long:
The Queen Wasp is here, thinking that you would make a tasty offering
to her master.
desc: You notice a glazed look in her eyes.

name: the drone spider
long: The drone spider walks around doing her master's bidding.
desc: An ordinary drone spider.

name: the ethereal spider
long: The ethereal spider strides here, traveling to different worlds.
desc: She winks in and out.

loads.roomName: A Link in the Ethereal Web

name: the slave of Arachnos
long: The slave works here relentlessly.
desc: The slave does not mind you, but will fight like a warrior if attacked.

name: the quasit
long: The quasit blinks in and out, grinning at you.
desc:
Demoniac in nature, but more mischievous.  He twiddles his thumbs
and creates a magical treasure!

name: the Bird Spider
long: The Bird Spider snaps its powerful jaws.
desc: The Bird Spider has very powerful jaws.

name: the Hermit
long: The Hermit sits here and warns, "Go back before it's too late!"
desc:
A disheveled veteran warrior in disguise is what he is, but he
means well.

name: the Donjonkeeper
long: The Donjonkeeper eyes you and wonders how pure your soul is.
desc: He delves deeper into you as you stare at him.

name: The guardian
long: The guardian is obviously not doing his job.
desc: He looks like a lazy bum who sleeps half the time.

name: Arachnos
long: Arachnos the Empress of Spiders welcomes you with an evil smile.
desc:
She is a very attractive spider with an ornate gown.  She tempts you
into being one of her many slaves.  She does not possess the venomous
fangs of normal spiders, but then, as you realize, she does not need
them.

name: the Ki-Rin
long: The Ki-Rin smiles good-naturedly to you.
desc:
She is the last bastion of good in this realm.  Her mission is to
someday free the slaves of the Empress.

name: the young dragon wormkin
long: A wormkin with no teeth plays here.
desc: Rather small, you almost feel sad in killing it.

name: the elder dragon wormkin
long: A wormkin that has grown a bit stares at you inquisitively.xxxxx
desc: A medium-sized dragon--seems it hasn't killed anything yet by itself.

name: the blue enfan
long: There is an enfan here. It is dressed in a blue suit.
desc: A small child like being who struts about rather haughtily.

name: the gray enfan
long: There is an enfan here. It is dressed in a grey suit.
desc: A small child like being who struts about rather haughtily.

name: the green enfan
long: There is an enfan here. It is dressed in a green suit.
desc: A small child like being who struts about rather haughtily.

name: the purple enfan
long: There is an enfan here. It is dressed in a purple suit.
desc: A small child like being who struts about rather haughtily.

name: the yellow enfan
long: There is an enfan here. It is dressed in a yellow suit.
desc: A small child like being who struts about rather haughtily.

name: the black enfan
long:
There is a positively evil enfan in front of you. He is dressed in black and
carries a large weapon.
desc: A small child like being who struts about rather haughtily.

name: the guard dog
long: A guard dog sits here staring hungrily.
desc: A large, ugly, evil dog.

name: the rat
long: A large mutated rat stares at you with glowing eyes.
desc: It is simply very ugly.

name: the green enfan
long: There is an enfan here. It is dressed in a green suit.
desc: A small child like being who struts about rather haughtily.

name: the purple enfan
long: There is an enfan here. It is dressed in a purple suit.
desc: A small child like being who struts about rather haughtily.

name: the yellow enfan
long: There is an enfan here. It is dressed in a yellow suit.
desc: A small child like being who struts about rather haughtily.

name: the gargoyle
long: A stone gargoyle stands before you blocking your way.
desc:
Very, very ugly. Much like a stereo-typical mother-in-law,
only a lot worse!

name: a desert coyote
long: A coyote is here, it looks at you wisely.
desc:
The coyote seems to be surprised to see you. It warily keeps its distance
when you approach.

name: a grass snake
long: There is something slithering about in the tall grass.
desc:
You notice the grass snake has a small lump in it's midsection. Scratch
one rabbit! It doesn't look particularly hungry.

name: a large stallion
long: A large stallion runs freely in the tall grass.
desc: It is a magnificent beast. It would make a fine steed, if you could only ride.

name: a mountain goat
long: There is a large mountain goat here. She thinks you look like a target.
desc: She has big curved horns. It's likely she's just being playful.

name: the dark bat
long: The bat hangs from the roof, swaying slightly.
desc: It's hard to distinguish one bat from another, there are so many.

loads.roomName: East End of the Enormous Cavern
East End of the Enormous Cavern
East End of the Enormous Cavern
East End of the Enormous Cavern
East End of the Enormous Cavern
East End of the Enormous Cavern
East End of the Enormous Cavern

Northeast End of the Enormous Cavern
