North End of the Enormous Cavern
North End of the Enormous Cavern

name: the cave fisher
long: A large cave fisher is here, reeling you in for a welcome meal.
desc:
It's a big ugly squat beast, on four legs, with a hard exoskeleton and a long
sticky tongue-like appendage with which it lifts its prey into its formidable
looking jaws. Flee if you can!

name: the yellow mold
long: There is a spotted yellow-colored mold flourishing here.
desc: What did you expect? It's spores galore!

name: the red mold
long: There is bit of red mold growing near the water.
desc: It is a rusty reddish color. Sort of like rusted Metal

name: the cave wight
long: A shadowy cave wight eyes you hungrily.
desc:
It is difficult to make out precisely, as it blends in with the
shadows, but from what you can see, you realize this is a fearsome
creature, and its undead claws twitch in anticipation as it closes in
on you.

name: the large troglodyte
long: A large troglodyte stands pounces on you from behind a stone!
desc:
An ugly troglodyte with large yellow teeth stands here, preparing to make you
into a meal for the whole family. He eyes your weapons and armor greedily.

name: the troglodyte lieutenant
long: A troglodyte lieutenant stands here, ordering others about.
desc: He is in complete control here.

name: the cave spider
long: The cave spider hangs nimbly from the webby roof.
desc:
The spider's hard exoskeleton is covered with an oily substance that keeps its
sticky webs from clinging to it. It is large and quite dangerous looking.

name: the gigantic trapper
long: A gigantic trapper engulfs you from the floor below!
desc: It looks exactly like the floor it mimics.

name: the evil troglodyte
long: The troglodyte attacks you with a yell!
desc:
He is dirty, and covered in grime and dried blood, some of which is apparently
his own. He doesn't look particularly well fed, but would like to take this
opportunity to improve that situation.

name: the troglodyte guard
long: The troglodyte guardsman defends his post from all invaders.
desc:
They guard their post diligently, fighting off all who would attack their
homeland and pose a threat to the survival of their people. Each is armored
and carries a sharp weapon.

name: the adolescent troglodyte
long: The young troglodyte rests here between training sessions.
desc:
He looks at you with alarm. He isn't sure whether he should stay and fight, or
run. He scrambles for his weapons, just in case...

name: the adolescent troglodyte
long: The young troglodyte is bashing his fellows with abandon.
desc: He looks at his battlemaster, who urges him to slay you.

name: the troglodyte battlemaster
long: The battlemaster screams at his pupils to attack, then assaults you himself.
desc:
He is extremely large, and is covered with battle scars. His armor is nice, and
is finely polished, as is his sword, which is sharp and wicked looking.

name: the troglodyte clansman
long: The troglodyte clansman cries for aid as he defends his homeland.
desc:
He looks like an ordinary troglodyte, about six feet tall, weighing slightly
less than two hundred pounds. He is well armored, and carries a sharp weapon.

name: the troglodyte clansman
long: The troglodyte clansman is here, foraging for food.
desc:
He looks like an ordinary troglodyte, about six feet tall, weighing slightly
less than two hundred pounds. He is well armored, and carries a sharp weapon.

name: the tunnel rat
long: There is a tunnel rat here, running for its life.
desc:
It is trying desperately to avoid becoming a troglodyte meal, like others of
its kind. It edges away as you approach.

name: the troglodyte cook
long: A troglodyte cook is here, slaving over an pot of tunnel rat stew.
desc:
She looks at you as if you would make an excellent addition to the stew. Given
the large knife she brandishes at you, you think she just might do it, too.

name: the troglodyte shaman
long: A troglodyte shaman is here, mumbling incantations.
desc:
She curses you, lifting aloft the small humanoid skull around her neck. The
incantations spewing from her mouth send shivers down your spine.

name: the troglodyte chief
long: The great chief of the troglodytes is here, regarding you dispassionately.
desc:
He is the largest troglodyte you've ever seen. He is covered with battle scars.
He looks at you with resignation, and slowly pulls out his great sword for
battle.

name: Golgar, god of the troglodytes
long: Golgar, the mighty god of the troglodytes, prepares to smite you.
desc:
This lordly figure is like a troglodyte, only on a larger scale. He must be
twenty feet tall, and as such barely fits inside the caves of his believers.
Golgar wears no armor and holds no weapon - his skin looks like it is carved
from solid granite, and his heavy fists area easily larger than the head of
any humanoid. You feel a tremendous urge to grovel in supplication before him,
but this is slightly weaker than your urge to run in terror.

name: the troglodyte clanswoman
long: The troglodyte clanswoman is here, crushing bone to paste.
desc: She doesn't appear to think much or your company.

name: the troglodyte matron
long: The troglodyte matron is here, watching over the young.
desc: She would kill you just for *thinking* about touching one of the little ones.

name: the troglodyte clanswoman
long: The troglodyte clanswoman is here, getting some needed rest.
desc: She looks annoyed and frightened at your intrusion.

name: the young troglodyte
long: The young troglodyte is annoying the adults here.
desc: It ceases all such activity when you enter, and attacks you dutifully.

name: the infant troglodyte
long: The infant troglodyte is here, waddling around and acting cute.
desc: It's too young to understand the concept of killing.

name: Valik
long: A wizened mage paces quietly here, waiting for the end of time.
desc:
The robes he wears are old and worn, and his pointy hat droops a bit as he
walks to and fro, intently staring with unfocused eyes at a point somewhere
on the infinite horizon. When his attention flicks by you, a strong feeling
of guilt washes over you and fades, like everything must in the passage of
time. You suddenly recall a phrase you've heard somewhere:

    "Do not meddle in the affairs of wizards, for they are subtle,
     and quick to anger."

sounds.near: Reality flows and shifts, then refocuses about the wizened mage.
sounds.far: You hear the whispering of the wind, and think of times gone by.

name: a blind fish
long: A blind fish swims about in the dark water, searching for food.
desc: It isn't very big, and it doesn't look very appetizing.

loads.roomName: At the Bottom of a Dark Lake
At the Bottom of a Dark Lake
At the Bottom of a Dark Lake
At the Bottom of a Dark Lake

name: the mud eel
long: There is an a dark eel swimming along the lake bottom.
desc:
It's hard to get a good look at it with all the mud, but you'd estimate it as
being a good four inches in diameter. As it turns, you get a brief glimpse of
some sharp and nasty looking teeth.

loads.roomName: At the Bottom of a Dark Lake

name: a lake crayfish
long: A small crayfish scuttles along the lake floor.
desc: It is barely visible, what with all the mud and darkness.

loads.roomName: At the Bottom of a Dark Lake
At the Bottom of a Dark Lake

name: a humongous lake gar
long: A really big fish with lots of sharp teeth has lucked into its next meal.
desc:
This fresh water whopper must weigh half a ton. It is shaped like a cigar
tube, and has the same silver coloring. It's fins are small, but its teeth
more than make up for its lack of maneuverability.

name: the cave troll
long: A gangly cave troll grins at you hungrily, showing lots of bug teeth.
desc:
He grins when you look at him. Good thing you came along, as he was just
starting to get hungry.

name: a cobra
long: A cobra is staying cool in the shade here.
desc:
It erects itself and flattens out it's neck as you approach, warning you to
keep a safe distance. It looks quite deadly.

name: the yeti
long: A huge ape-like beast covered in white fur leaps to the attack!
desc:
The yeti is a big, white, furry animal with very sharp claws and very long
fangs. The yeti seems impervious to the icy cold.

name: the ghostly Soldier
long: A ghostly soldier makes you cower in dread as he floats nearby.
desc:
He is covered in ghostly armor, and holds a ghostly sword. There is little
doubt in your mind that this fearsome undead creature will do real damage,
however.

sounds.near: You are overcome with a feeling of dread and fear.
sounds.far: You suddenly feel VERY uneasy.

name: the ghostly Lieutenant
long: You cover your eyes in horror as you see the ghostly lieutenant.
desc:
He radiates with a red glow, through which you can see he is covered in
armor, which also seems to be spiritual in nature. He has such a fearsome
visage that just looking at him makes you shiver in dread.

sounds.near: You are overcome with a feeling of dread and fear.
sounds.far: You suddenly feel EXTREMELY uneasy.

name: the Ghost Captain
long: The visage of the ghostly captain makes you cringe in terror!
desc: You cannot keep your eyes on him, his countenance is so ghastly!

sounds.near: You cover your eyes in fear as the ghostly captain floats by.
sounds.far: You have an overwhelming urge to flee.

name: an orc
long: A small orc is trying to break into a locker.  He looks rather purposeful.
desc:
The orc is small and pitiful looking.  He is dressed in filthy clothes,
and looks rather repulsive.

name: the Gate Guardian
long: The guardian of the gate is astonished to see a visitor from the north!
desc:
He is a huge man, covered with strange black armor. He wields a large sword.
There is a kindness in his eyes, but a hardness too. This man is not to be
trifled with.

loads.roomName: The Northern Gate to the Kingdom of Rhyodin

name: the invisible watcher
long: The invisible watcher looks at you with disdain.

loads.roomName: The Northern Gate to the Kingdom of Rhyodin
The Northern Gate to the Kingdom of Rhyodin

name: the troglodyte lieutenant
long: The chief's lieutenants snarl and attack.
desc: They hope to impress their leader with your swift destruction.

name: the troglodyte clansman
long: The troglodyte clansman jumps up from his nap with a yell!
desc: He doesn't seem to like having been interrupted.

name: the frost daemon
long: An evil frost demon is spewing ice and snow into the air.
desc:
It's hard to believe this creature could be the cause of all this snow, but
at the rate it's generating ice and snow, it may well be a possibility.

name: the acid blob
long: A menacing acid blob quivers with anticipation as it oozes towards you.

name: The Ranger
long: A hardy looking ranger stands here.
desc:
He is a large looking man, dressed mostly in forest green.  Although this is a 
peaceful town, he is here to protect it of any dangers that may come up.

name: A Noble Warrior
long: A Noble Warrior is standing here, guarding his guild
desc:
A large Warrior clad in metal armor.  He stands here guarding his guildmaster
from annoying travelers who wander bye.

name: The Library Guard
long: The guard to the ancient library stands here.
desc:
Although he is dressed in large flowing robes, you can tell he would be one
tough warrior.  He seems to pay no attention to you as he continues to read his
book

name: The Healer Guard
long: The Guardian of the Healers stands here
desc:
An old warrior wearing full set of armor.  He is a mighty paladin dedicated to 
guarding the members of his guild, especially the guildmaster.

name: The Rogue
long: A rogue is standing here guarding the room
desc:
A thief dressed entirely in black.  He wears a mask over his face to conceal
his identity.

name: A teacher
long: A teacher is standing here.
desc:
This poor guy looks like he is  ready to retire.  He has lost all his hair, and
probably most of his sanity thanks to his student.

name: the adventurer
long: an adventurer is wandering around here
desc:
He looks like a tough wanderer.  He seems to have been around the world quite 
a bit as you notice his foreign outfit.

name: the farmer
long: a farmer swinging a large scythe is here.
desc:
He is a large muscular man, who spends most of his time working out on the
farm.  You are sure this guy could pick you up with one arm as you watch him
swing a large scythe with ease.

name: the townsman
long: the townsman is standing here
desc:
You see before you a citizen of the town.  He seems to be very happy as he
wanders about the town.

name: the farmer
long: a farmer is here working on his fields
desc:
The farmer appears to be very tired, He must have put a full days work in to
his fields.

name: the castle guard
long: an off duty castle guard is sitting here drinking beer
desc:
A large guard from the castle.  He is clad in all metal armor bearing the
crests of the castle.

name: a stray cat
long: a stray cat is searching around for food
desc: it is a small scrawny cat, it looks really hungry

sounds.near: The stray cat brushes up against you.

name: the rabbit
long: the rascally rabbit is eating the farmers carrots
desc:
This obnoxious little rabbit has been eating away at all the farmers carrots.
He seems to have a good time taunting the farmer though.

sounds.near: The Rabbit says, 'Eh... What's up doc!'

name: the paladin guildmaster
long: the paladin guildmaster is standing here
desc: A strong, powerful man, yet kindly looking.

name: the master librarian
long: the master librarian is here reading an ancient tome
desc:
He is the keeper of all the tomes and the arcane knowledge within.  From these
books, he has learned many ancient secrets that he is willing to share to those
who are worthy.

name: a wanderer
long: a wanderer is here exploring the city

name: the psionist guildmaster
long: the psionist guildmaster is standing here.
desc:
Bald and beautiful! You sense a powerful mind behind those dark blue
eyes of his.

name: the ranger guildmaster
long: the ranger guildmaster is standing here.
desc:
Catlike in movement and silent as a mouse, you would never hear this
man move up behind you!

name: the Shopkeeper
long: the the Healer Shopkeeper is standing here.
desc:
He looks very helpful.  You are sure he would help you with any request you
might have.

name: the Baker
long: A man behind the counter is here mixing dough.
desc: He is covered in white powder.  He is a really messy baker.`

name: Tromar the Cook
long: The cook stands here, filling orders for the customers.
desc:
You notice that he is quite adept with a knife, as he fillets some fish.  He
is a rather old man, and probably has a lot of experience cooking.

name: the Shopkeeper
long: The Shopkeeper is waiting here, ready to assist you.
desc:
The shopkeeper looks old and tired.  You do not think he is too happy with his
job.  He seems to be daydreaming about something else.

name: The Grocer
long: The Grocer is here, selling his vegetables.
desc:
He is always checking on the vegetables to make sure only the fresh ones are
sold to his customers.

name: The Shopkeeper
long: The Shopkeeper is here, dusting his shelves.
desc:
He runs a clean store.  The floors are spotless, and the shelves are all dusted
If his items are as good as the store is clean, you know you are in for a good
deal.

name: Ambid the Shopkeeper
long: The Shopkeeper puts down an artifact, and smiles as you enter.
desc:
He is a collector of artifacts from around the world.  Although he seems
clueless to what they do, he seems to have a knack for knowing the value of an
item.

name: Claybin the Bartender
long: The Bartender is pouring beer for his customers, and will serve you next.
desc: He is quick to pour the drinks, and even quicker at grabbing your gold.

sounds.near: Claybin the Bartender says, 'How about a shot of whiskey stranger.'

name: Captain Saltmere
long: Captain Saltmere stands here, watching over his ship.
desc:
The patch over his eye and the many scars lining his face tell you that you
are looking at a well experienced veteran.

sounds.near: The Captain screams at the Helmsman as he makes a wrong turn.
sounds.far: You here yelling and screaming in the distance.

name: The First Mate
long: The First Mate stands here looking for something to do.
desc:
This man is actually responsible for the smooth running of the ship. He is 
here looking for something to correct, someone to put to work, or someone to
discipline.

name: The Stowaway
long: Someone who shouldn't be on the ship is here hiding from the crew.
desc:
He is hungry, tired, and cold but he still insists on getting a free ride
and not being found.

name: The Lookout
long: A Lookout is here, watching for any signs of trouble on the ocean.
desc: He is doing his job, even though it is quite boring.

name: The Master Chef
long: The Master Chef is here preparing a meal for the crew.
desc: The man looks like he knows his way around the kitchen.

name: Gorga the Elven Priestess
long: Gorga the Elven Priestess lies on the massive bed looking very royal.
desc:
She looks very rich. Hmmm, I wouldn't try stealing any of it though. She also
looks like she can take care of herself.

name: Jedadia the Massacrer
long: Jedadia the Massacrer is doing his morning workout.
desc: This man is HUGE! Look at all those bulging muscles.

name: A Sea Hag
long: The Sea Hag of the S.S.Minnow is here, it looks as if it is moving.
desc:
This is the wooden carving of a ugly woman that every ship has, however this
one looks like it is alive. Watch out, it looks like it wants some loving and
it wants if from YOU!

name: A Very Strong Man
long: A very strong man is taking a break after operating the bulge pump.
desc:
This man looks like he could work the bulge pump for hour upon hour. Maybe
that is why he is down here.

name: The Master Torturer
long: The Master Torturer grins and says 'Ahhh, you've come to play with me!'
desc: This man REALLY like what he does.

name: A prisoner
long: A withered, tortured prisoner is shackled in here.
desc:
This man has wasted away. From the looks of things he has been given only 
water and has been unable to move for the past week. The Master Torturer is
really doing his job on this guy.

sounds.near: A Prisoner begs "Please get me out of here, PLEASE! PLEASE! PLEASE!"
sounds.far: You here begging, moaning and screaming coming from the prisoners cell.

name: A Crew Member
long: A Crew Member is lying here sleeping on his bunk.
desc: He looks well rested, imagine that.

name: A Crew Member
long: A Crew Member stands here doing his work.
desc: This man is very busy doing his work, don't bother him.

name: The Helmsman
long: A man stands here piloting the ship in the wrong direction.
desc:
This man looks confused. I'm not surprised though, the Captain is telling him
where to go, cursing and screaming at him and the charts tell him to go another

name: Zatagaster
long:
You hear some snarling and heavy breathing, but you don't know where it 
is coming from.
desc:
This thing is HUGE and it looks like it can adapt to anything. It has a tail
four legs, two wings, scales, etc etc. Oh, did I mention the fangs,
there are four large fangs dripping with some disgusting goop - must be
poison.

sounds.near: You hear it, but you don't see it. Where is it, you don't know but it scares you!
sounds.far: You hear something that really makes you nervous close by.

name: The protector of the Captains Treasure
long: A huge chest overflowing with riches and treasure lies on the ground here.
desc:
It isn't really a chest of treasure, its the Captains pet. He placed it here
to keep people like you away and the rest of his crew away from his riches.

name: The ankylosaurus
long: A dinosaur that looks somewhat like a tank is grazing here.
desc:
This large herbivore walks around on all fours.  He has bony plates that
protect his back and sides. His head is small and bony and he has a large
weight on the end of his tail that forms a nice weapon.

name: The allosaurus
long: A large and hungry lizard stands tall above you.
desc:
You see death in the eyes of this fearsome carnivore.  He is a walking eating
machine with huge jaws that could bite you in half.

name: The brontosaurus
long: A brontosaurus towers over you.
desc:
The brontosaurus is a giant herbivore that sometimes resembles a small
grassy mountain.  Better not get too close, it may step on you by accident.

name: The dinischtys
long: A huge and strange looking fish swims nearby.
desc:
This is a very large ancestor of that salmon you ate for lunch!  DAMN! His 
mouth is huge!

name: The elasmosaurus
long: A weird looking lizard with some very sharp teeth looks around for food.
desc:
This strange creature looks well adapted to both water and land.  It runs on 
all fours and has a mouth full of teeth that classify this beast as a meat-
eater.

name: The iguanadon
long: A tall lizard with horned thumbs is standing here looking at you.
desc:
You get the distinct impression that this animal is very alert to what you
are doing.  He slowly munches on a plant that he has torn from the ground.

name: The paleoscincus
long: A four-legged lizard covered with spikes and armor plating grazes here.
desc:
An odd looking creature, those spikes and plates are effective, no doubt.
It has a fairly offensive looking tail....

name: The plesiosaurus
long: A finned lizard with a mouth full of teeth considers you for lunch.
desc: Hey, this thing looks like the monster of loch-nes!  Lots of teeth too.

name: The stegosaurus
long: A rather large stegosaur stands here regarding you balefully.
desc: Hmm, looks kinda like a big dinosaur.  Go figure.

name: The triceratops
long: A huge, three-horned lizard stands here on four legs.
desc:
This large dinosaur has two long horns near a bony plate at the top of his
head and a smaller horn near his nostrils.  His body is much like that of a
rhino.

name: Tyrannosaurus Rex
long: A fearsome dinosaur stands here looking at you with blood-lust.
desc: Don't look at me! I'm trying to EAT you!

name: The Elven Guard
long: An Elven Guard stands here, protecting his kingdom.
desc:
The Elven Guard will stand at nothing to protect his forest and his king.
He will gladly give his life to defend them!

loads.roomName: In the Orchard of the Elven King
In the Orchard of the Elven King

name: The Elven Archer
long: An Elven Archer stands here, readying an arrow.
desc:
The Elven Archers are the greatest marksmen in the land.  You probably
don't want to find out how well they shoot!

loads.roomName: In the Orchard of the Elven King
In the Orchard of the Elven King
In the Orchard of the Elven King

name: The forest elf
long: A forest elf stands here, whistling a merry tune...
desc:
The forest elf is one of the many inhabitants of this forest.  He smiles
happily and whistles a tune as he walks by...

name: The mother grizzly bear
long: A mother grizzly bear sleeps here.. Ssshhh!  Don't wake her up!
desc:
Mama bear is hibernating quite peacefully and would like to keep it that
way.  She also would be very upset if someone were to harm her little cubs!

name: Timnus
long: Timnus the Protector stands here.
desc:
Timnus is the mightiest elf of all time.  He smiles at young adventurers,
wishing them well on their journeys.  He turns his gaze to you, and decides
whether or not you are worthy to pass.

sounds.near: Timnus says 'Only the truly young may pass.'
sounds.far: You hear a merrily whistled tune.

name: A brook trout
long: A brook trout is swimming here.
desc:
The brook trout looks very tasty.  You have the sudden urge to eat some 
fresh fillets.

name: The Elven Woodcutter
long: An Elf stands here, carving a piece of wood.
desc:
The Elven Woodcutters are very fine craftsmen.  They have been known to make
very nice weapons out of seemingly worthless sticks.

loads.roomName: In the Orchard of the Elven King

name: The Elven Princess
long: A very beautiful Elven woman is here, singing.
desc:
She is one of the most beautiful women you have laid eyes upon.  You had 
heard stories about the beauty of elven females, but she is in a class of her
own!

loads.roomName: In the Orchard of the Elven King

name: The young doe
long: A young deer is here, munching on something.
desc:
The young doe is quietly eating some wild berries.  She looks up at you and
begins to run.

name: A groundhog
long: A furry groundhog is here, running about.
desc:
The groundhog pops in and out of his holes.  He doesn't stand still for
very long.

name: A fuzzy caterpillar
long: A fuzzy caterpillar is crawling up a tree.
desc:
The caterpillar is brown and fuzzy.  You wonder how long it will be
until it turns into a butterfly.

name: A fisherman elf
long: An elf is here fishing.
desc:
The fisherman elf is a hardy little elf.  He has seen every type of weather
in his long days.

loads.roomName: At the edge of a pond
At the edge of a pond

name: An elven child
long: A very young elf is here, looking for it's mother.
desc:
The elven child is very young, yet at 70 years of age, it is older than
you are.  It looks around for it's mother.

name: A female elf
long: A female elf stands here.
desc:
The female elf is fair and beautiful.  She shies away from you and goes back
to her children.

loads.roomName: At the edge of a pond

name: An Elven Lumberjack
long: A tall elf stands here chopping wood.
desc:
The Elven Lumberjack is a very strong elf.  You probably don't want to see
how hard he can swing an axe.

name: An Elven Beekeeper
long: An elf is here, getting honey from a bee hive.
desc: The Elven Beekeeper collects honey for his king.

name: A bee
long: A bee is here, buzzing by your ear.
desc:
The bee is here defending it's hive from those trying to steal the honey.
It will sting you if you come any closer.

name: The Elven Archbishop
long: The Elven Archbishop is here.
desc:
The Elven Archbishop is here taking his daily walk through the orchard.  He
looks at you and says a prayer in your behalf.

name: A wandering elf
long: An elf is here, wandering about the forest.
desc:
The Wandering Elf knows every part of the forest.  He travels all around to
see what is new in the forest.

loads.roomName: At the edge of a pond

name: The Elven Noble
long: A noble looking elf is here.
desc:
The Noble Elf is a member of the royal court.  He is taking a stroll through
the gardens and orchards of the Elven King.

loads.roomName: In the Orchard of the Elven King
In the Orchard of the Elven King

name: A butterfly
long: A beautiful butterfly is here.
desc:
The butterfly's wings have nearly every color on the rainbow.  It is quite
a sight to watch this beautiful creature flutter by, showing off all of it's
colors.

name: The Elven Woodsman
long: An Elven Woodsman is here gathering firewood.
desc:
The Elven Woodsman is out gathering firewood for his cabin.  He is a strong
elf, and could easily pick you up along with the wood.

name: The Elven Orchard Worker
long: An Elven Orchard Worker is here, gathering fruit.
desc:
The Elven Orchard Worker is collecting a variety of fruit to bring back to
his king.  He only selects the finest and freshest fruits for his basket.

loads.roomName: In the Orchard of the Elven King
In the Orchard of the Elven King
In the Orchard of the Elven King
In the Orchard of the Elven King
In the Orchard of the Elven King
In the Orchard of the Elven King
In the Orchard of the Elven King
In the Orchard of the Elven King

name: A bear cub
long: A young bear cub is here.
desc:
The bear cub is cuddled next to it's mother and sleeping peacefully.  You 
wonder about the consequences of disturbing them.

name: A duck
long: A duck is here, swimming around in circles.
desc: The duck quacks happily as it swims around on the pond.

name: A pseudodragon
long: A miniature red dragon with a stinger tail is standing here.
desc:
You see what looks like a miniature red dragon.  The dragon has a
lethal looking stinger on it's tail.  It does not seem interested
in you at all.

name: A gelatinous cube
long: You can just make out a cube made of a gelatinous substance.
desc:
The gelatinous cube is about 10x10x10 feet.  It has no appendages,
no eyes, mouth or ears.  You think you can see objects floating
in it's gelatinous interior.

name: A flying cleaver
long: A magically animated meat cleaver is flying about madly!
desc:
The cleaver is about 1 foot long including handle. It is very sharp.
And is flying directly for your head!

name: A freshman mage
long: A freshman mage is here practicing his spells.
desc:
This young man has been practicing his magic missile spells on 
non living targets for some time now.  Maybe you would like to
be his first live target?

loads.roomName: Great Hall of Blackmouth's School of Magic.

name: A sophmore mage student
long: A sophmore mage stands here.
desc:
The sophmore mage thinks he knows it all.  He looks at you as if 
you should kneel in his presence.

name: A 3rd year mage student
long: A junior year mage is here, reading a book.
desc:
The junior mage is very intent on his studies and doesn't seem to
notice you.

loads.roomName: Great Hall of Blackmouth's School of Magic.

name: A senior mage student
long: A senior mage student is here looking for a freshmen to carry his books.
desc: The senior mage student looks as if he knows quite a bit about spells.

name: Dr. Smith, phd
long: Dr. Smith, phd is standing here professing magic.
desc:
Dr. Smith has tiny square glasses on the tip of his nose.
He has a long grey bread and a mass of unkempt hair.

name: Dr. Gyaxx
long: Dr. Gyaxx is here writing a thesis on conjuration.
desc:
Dr. Gyaxx is an old mage.  He has white hair with a short beard.
He has dark eyes and seems to look right through you.

sounds.near: Dr. Gyaxx is thinking out loud about proper conjuration practices.
sounds.far: You hear a low mumbling voice nearby.

name: the V.I.P. mage
long: A V.I.P. mage is here acting very important.
desc: the V.I.P. mage is very important, that's how he got this room.

name: A confused skeleton
long: A human skeleton stands here, unaware that it has died already.
desc: It looks like bones with the people scraped off.

name: The zombie
long: A zombie stands here, rotting very slowly.
desc:
This poor creature is no more than an animated corpse trying to decay
as nature intended.

name: The dead chimney sweep
long: A well burnt corpse walks about, tidying up.
desc:
It appears to have been caught cleaning a chimney that was not quite 
inactive when it entered.

name: The dead PC
long: A dead PC wonders when you will be dead like him-- probably not long.
desc:
He appears to have lost all of his equipment when he died, and just 
given up mudding as a PC.  Dead characters have less to lose, you know.

name: The barefoot corpse
long: A barefoot corpse stands here, wishing for some new shoes.
desc:
The zombie stamps its feet in an attempt to keep them warm, but its
circulation seems to be rather poor.

name: The Arm-orer
long: A dead man is here, inspecting the arms in his charge.
desc: He seems to be well armed.

name: The Dressmaker
long: An undead Dressmaker is here, putting the finishing touches on a new dress.
desc:
Like most dead people you have seen, the dressmaker before you is rather
unattractive, and is lacking in social graces.

sounds.near: The Dressmaker sews a few stitches.
sounds.far: You hear stitching.

name: A skeletal mining worker
long: A skeletal miner is here, doing a little tunneling.
desc: He never seems to break a sweat.

sounds.near: The miner manages to clear a little dirt.
sounds.far: You hear a picking and scraping sound.

name: The undead shoemaker
long: A shoemaker is here, trying to sew rotting flesh into a pair of boots.
desc: Bits of his skin are peeling off, but he quickly makes use of it.

sounds.near: The undead shoemaker examines his handiwork and smiles to himself.

name: The zombie
long: A zombie is sleeping here, presumably dying wore him out.
desc: He looks awfully tired... you better not wake the poor thing.

sounds.near: The zombie makes a low noise, not unlike a snore.
sounds.far: You hear a loud snoring sound.

name: The gaming corpse
long: A corpse is here playing cards.
desc: looks good.

sounds.near: The corpse says, 'hit me.'

name: The zombie
long: A zombie is here, slowly melting down the drain.
desc: Its flesh is peeling off at an alarming rate.

name: A well-bleached skeleton
long: A well-bleached skeleton stands here, admiring its marble complexion.
desc: About 206 bones, all of them white as ivory.

name: A zombie
long: A zombie stands here, trying to get away from the crowded Jamboree.
desc: It looks drunk.  Quite wasted.

name: A partying zombie
long: A zombie is here, enjoying the Zombie Jamboree.
desc:
Packed back to back and belly to belly, it doesn't mind cause its 
dead already.  Its at the Zombie Jamboree!

sounds.near: The zombies dance in close formation.
sounds.far: You hear bumping and grinding.

name: A cloud of smoke
long: Smoke drifts hazily about the room.
desc: It looks a little unclear on the subject.

name: The Headless Vampire
long:
A man without a head tries to lick blood off of his fingers, but he has
no mouth.  Other than the missing head, this guy looks a lot like Bela
Lugosi.
desc: He looks like he hasn't been getting enough to eat and drink recently.

name: A salty corpse
long: A well-salted corpse stands here.  He looks well preserved.
desc:
Either he has been in the undead navy or else someone got him good 
with a salt shaker.

name: A pepped up corpse
long: A corpse stands here, looking awfully pepped up for a dead person.
desc: It appears to have small black flecks all over it.

sounds.near: The corpse sneezes.  Strange.
sounds.far: You hear a sneeze.

name: A corpse
long: A corpse is here, apparently stored against future need.
desc: It is a dead person, not much of a looker.

name: The wight
long: A wight steps forward to eat you.  You hope this is not the draining kind.
desc:
It is a foul looking apparition, with long, filthy claws that are ready 
to grab hold of you for a snacking opportunity.

loads.roomName: The wight room with Black Curtiss

name: Black Curtiss
long: Black Curtiss is standing here, thinking of Cream.
desc: He appears to have quite a habit of dressing in black.

loads.roomName: The wight room with Black Curtiss

name: A pair of boots
long: A pair of boots is standing here.
desc: This pair appears to have seen a lot of use.

sounds.near: The boots stomp around the room.
sounds.far: You hear a stomping sound.

name: The Salter
long: The Salter stands here, salting some corpses.
desc: He seems happy to have his job.  He just likes to shake it.

sounds.near: The Salter shakes some salt on a corpse.
sounds.far: You hear shaking.

name: Dr. Pepper
long: Doctor Pepper is here, pepping up some down-looking corpses.
desc:
He seems awfully healthy for a corpse.  Maybe he gets a lot of prune 
juice or something.

sounds.near: Dr. Pepper shakes some pepper and sneezes loudly.
sounds.far: You hear shaking and sneezing.

loads.roomName: The wight room with Black Curtiss

name: The Dealer
long: A corpse is here, dealing cards to its friends.
desc: He has a few spare cards tucked away in his clothing.

sounds.near: The Dealer shuffles the cards and deals out a few of them.
sounds.far: You hear shuffling and riffling.

name: A dead voter
long: A dead voter is here, voting.
desc: He is wearing a pin with the letters LBJ on it.

name: Sly the bartender
long: A bartender stands here wiping down the bar.
desc:
Here stands a rough looking fellow who is rather large.  He looks
at you and decides your not worth his trouble.  As a fight breaks
out in the bar he grabs his club to go break it up.  He wields the
club as if it were a stick.  It must weigh 30 pounds.

name: A drunk
long: A man is snoring here.
desc:
This man has had way too much Red Eye.  He sits at this table with
his head down and drool coming out of his mouth in a pile.

name: A streetsweeper
long: A man stands here sweeping the street.
desc:
Here is a man with a broom and pail.  He seems to be oblivious to his
surroundings.  His only reason is everything goes in the pail.

name: A old bum
long: A old man wanders here.
desc:
This man needs some serious help.  He stands stooped over muttering
to himself.  He snarls at you and he has bad breath!!

name: A alley cat
long: A nasty old cat is here.
desc:
This cat has more grey in its coat than any other color.  It's whiskers
are pure silver.  It seems almost dead, but it has many blank patches
where fights have scarred it.

name: A miner 49er
long: A miner with bulging pockets is here.
desc:
GOLD
GOLD
WHERE'S MY GOLD!!!!

sounds.near: Where's that nugget?
sounds.far: You hear money rustle nearby

name: A vagabond
long: A wandering mystic is here.
desc:
"The end is coming"  REPENT!!  This man has a many colored bag with
him and he seems to be speaking in weird tongues.

sounds.near: Diesilla barg
sounds.far: You hear strange sounds nearby.

name: A large buffalo
long: A large buffalo roams here.
desc:
Here is a mad buffalo.  He is leader of the herd and very mean.
His two horns look very sharp.

name: A small buffalo
long: A buffalo roams here.
desc: Here is a rather young buffalo who just likes to follow the herd.

name: A Tombstone deputy
long: A deputy stands here.
desc:
Here is the reason that there is any order in Tombstone at all.  This
is the type of fellow who takes his job very seriously.  It would be
best not to provoke him.

name: The statue of Fear
long: A statue stands in the fountain.
desc:
Here is the statue of the Lowly Saint.  After spending millennia with
greater spirits, this small figment of Fear's mind was formed.  Fear
extends his deepest thanks to the defender of green kobolds and this
statue emanates great undreamed of power.

name: The pale rider
long: A man rides a white horse here.
desc:
Here stands the pale rider.  He truly reminds you of the messenger
of death.  He looks very tough.

name: The guardian of time
long: A guardian stands watch here.
desc:
Here is a figure as old as time itself.  It stands 10 feet and
must weigh over a thousand pounds.  Its cape shimmers and the mace
it has is held clutched to its breast.  Its face shows no signs of
life, but it seems very aware of who passes in front of it.

name: A giant zombie
long: A large zombie is here.
desc:
A animate corpse of a giant shambles through the graveyard looking
for some living soul to put it out of its misery.  It clutches a
rusty sword in its hand and its other arm appears missing.

name: A wraith
long: A floating spirit reaches for you.
desc:
Here seems to be nothing but blackness, but you quickly notice
a silver pentagram hanging suspended in the air.  Suddenly two
red eyes begin to converge on you.

name: The townleader
long: A townleader is here.
desc:
This man is very upset about the graveyard problems, and wants the
situation taken care of immediately.  He looks disappointed that you
have over heard the problem that no one knows about.

name: A woman
long: A woman stands here arguing with the town leader.
desc:
This is one of the leaders of the woman's guild in Tombstone.  She
believes that there are no problems with the graveyard and that the
town leader looks really funny in his armor.

name: The undertaker
long: A undertaker is here.
desc:
This is a man here who is working on a coffin that looks like
it might be just the right size for you.  He seems rather old and
feeble, but he sure seems to have an inner strength about him.

name: Ed Morse
long: A very confused man is here.
desc:
xxxx  --- xxxx  "Damn whats that mean again?"  This man sits here
tangled in wires listening to a tiny box that is making strange
tapping sounds.

name: A mean bully
long: A tough looking kid stands here.
desc:
This kid is one word.  Mean.  He is about 4 feet tall and its all
attitude.  He believes Miss Grim should leave him alone more.  By
the look of it he's really quite scared of her.

name: A young girl
long: A girl stands here jumping rope.
desc:
This girl is standing here jumping rope, and singing to herself.  As
she jumps, her pigtails bounce up and down.

name: A banker
long: A merry man stands here counting money.
desc:
Here is a man who really knows the color green.  He wears a small
hat on his head and stands behind iron bars.  As you approach, he
stops whistling and nudges the guards to wake up.

name: A bank guard
long: A tough looking stands here bleary eyed.
desc:
This is one of the bank guards.  He sits in his chair and is barely
awake.  His partner seems no better off.

name: Miss Grim
long: A teacher conducts class here.
desc:
Here is Tombstone's education center of development.  This old
lady has extremely wrinkled skin and she seems to have very angled
features to her face.  Rumor has it her name came from her pessimistic
outlook on life.

name: The class dunce
long: A stupid boy sits here in the corner.
desc:
This boy is very tired of people picking on him.  The pointed hat
on his head reads "DUNCE" and he is not happy about it.

name: A young student
long:
A student sits here reclining in his chair.
is open and you see a # on his paper with x's and o's on it.
desc:
This student is carefully listening to Miss Grim.  His notebook lies
open in front of him and you recognize a # sign on it with x's and
o's written in it.

name: The Tombstone Blacksmith
long: A man is pounding on the forge here.
desc:
This fellow is rather large.  He wears an apron around his neck
that seems to protect him from the many sparks that come off of the
anvil.  He wields his hammer as if it was a feather.

name: A blacksmith's son
long: A young boy huddles in the corner smoking with his friend.
desc:
This young boy is suddenly very embarrassed that you have caught
him smoking with his brother.  His father warned him about smoking
and he figures there's one sure way to shut you up.

name: The apprentice
long: A blacksmith's apprentice is working here.
desc:
This young dwarf sits here working on a war horse that has a bent
shoe.  He doesn't seem to notice you until the horse begins to fight
him.

name: A large war horse
long: A brown horse stands here proudly.
desc:
This horse has seen many battles.  It's barding is pure plate and
it looks like it could send you through the roof with those hooves.
A large saddle sits on its back.

name: A large stallion
long: A large horse stands here.
desc:
Here is a horse large enough to support any man.  It stands seven
feet tall and looks you over very carefully.

name: A strange speaker
long: A stranger is here speaking to a crowd of Tombstone citizens.
desc:
This man wears a robe of many colors.  He seems to have captivated
his audience, and you feel that he has senses strange powers.

name: A gambler
long: A citizen sits here gambling.
desc:
This man seems to be very unlucky.  He has virtually no money in front
of him and he has lost the shirt on his back.

name: A Tombstone citizen
long: A captivated citizens stands here and listens.
desc:
This woman is very interested in what the speaker is saying.
She looks directly and her mouth hangs open in awe.

name: The clerk
long: A secretary is here typing.
desc:
This is the Tombstone clerk.  She is in charge of writing the important
facts down.  Her obituary section just seems to go on forever.

name: The general store manager
long: A shopkeeper stands here looking upset.
desc:
This man is rather tall and a large knife sits on his hip.  He
is carefully watching a couple of young boys in the back of his
store.

name: A young thief
long: A thief is here.
desc:
This man and his partner are trying to rip off the store.  He seems
not to notice you since he is so intent on picking the metal
locker under the table.

name: A partier
long: A merry man is here.
desc: This man is very happy, and he has had quite a lot to drink.

name: A bouncer
long: A man stands here passing out beer.
desc:
This man hands a bottle to everyone that enters the room. The only
requirement is that you finish it before you leave.  Wow!!  What
a concept!!!

name: A mean drunk
long: A angry drunk is here.
desc:
A man who is just like your best friend when he is drunk is here.
He doesn't realize he is being an ass.

name: A gang member
long: A member of Smily's gang is here.
desc:
A big bully of a man sits here playing cards, and you have
interrupted his game.  He's going to show you just how sorry you
are!!

name: A door guard
long: A very confident looking fellow is standing here.
desc:
This guy has been assigned a task just simple enough for him.
"Guard the door"

name: The Demi-Lich
long:
The Demi-Lich leaps from his throne as you enter the room, his evil
eyes fixed dead upon you!
desc:
The Demi-Lich is, perhaps, the single most powerful undead creature known
to exist.  Greatly resembling a wight or mummy, and being gaunt and skeletal
in form. It is, nevertheless a being of foreboding might. Its eye sockets
are black and empty, save for the fierce pinpoints of light which serve as
eyes. An aura of cold and darkness radiates from it, which makes it an 
ominous and fearsome sight. Despite the wasted, rotten flesh it is garbed
in the rich clothes of nobility.

name: Keftab, the Ancient One
long: Keftab, the Ancient One stands here, calmly searching ceaslessly.
desc:
A writhing, quivering mass of horrific, unspeakable flesh-like material, this
ancient one stares coldly about through its many multifacted eyes.
viscous, vile smelling liquid seeps through its flesh in many places,
originating from the ghastly, crater like pores which pepper his body.
Disgustingly, large portions of its flesh seem to bubble with an alien
life of their own. The surface of its body, where not oozing, is covered
with mottled, grey, mossy protrusions, like some strange malignant
blemishes. It emits low, guttural mewlings from its fanged, quivering
orifice.

name: A Crimson Death
long: A crimson death materializes from a dense patch of red mist.
desc:
Its skeletal form is garbed in a robe of crimson, the blood of its many
victims stain the robe. Its skeletal figure resembles that of the angel of
death. Its eyes glow with a furious fire to kill.

name: A Mist Daemon
long: A mist daemon stands here, in a cloud of grey mist.
desc:
A large demon like creature hovers above you, in a cloud of grey mist.
Its winged form stares down at you in utter hatred.

name: a Black Slayer
long: A huge, shadowy figure materializes from the shadows around you.
desc:
The black slayer is a shadowy figure, about 7 feet in height. Garbed in
a heavy, black cloak, in his right hand, he wields a wicked dagger.

name: a Lost Soul
long: A ghostly apparition floats here, staring at you in utter hatred.
desc: The lost soul is a ghostly apparition, seeking revenge on the living.

name: a Storm Giant
long: A storm giant stands here, angered by your presence.
desc:
This huge creature is approximately 18 feet tall, He grasps a huge bolt
of lightning it his right hand.... He doesn't look happy to see you.

name: a White Gold Manticore
long: A statuesque manticore stands here, crafted entirely of white gold.
desc:
The statue is beautifully crafted, the whole statue is formed entirely
of white gold. Its eyes seem to watch your every move.. they almost
appear is if they were alive.

name: an Efreet
long: A huge flaming figure stands here, with a glint of evil in his eyes.
desc:
The creature is formed entirely of flames. The creature gives off an
intense heat.

name: the Hydra
long: A huge eight headed hydra is sleeping here
desc:
The huge, scaled creature  has eight heads... each capable of breathing
a dangerous stream of fire.

name: the kraken
long: A large squid-like creature erupts from the waters beneath you!
desc:
This large creature is a close relative of the squid but a much larger
size. its huge tentacles grasp something... though you can not make out
what the object is.

name: the Treant
long: A large tree-like creature reaches out for you with its many limbs.
desc:
It is a rather large creature resembling a tree. At the base of the trunk
is a large opening that looks very much like a mouth.

loads.roomName: A Small Path in the Twisted Forest

name: a Githyanki
long:
A disgusting creature of ethereal nature stands here, its body completely
wrapped in bandages..
desc:
This man sized creature has bandages wrapped all about its body. Its eyes
glow with a brilliant red fire, in its right hand he grasps a an extremely
sharp blade of magical nature.

name: Kalas
long:
Kalas, the guardian and knight of the castle stands here preparing himself for
battle.
desc:
He is a large, muscular man of undead nature. He is clad in rather magical
looking suit of armor, his sword burning fiercely.

name: the Death knight
long: The death knight stands here, preparing to do you in.
desc:
This creature is the result of a powerful mage animating the dead remains
of a once mighty warrior. Its eyes are fixed coldly upon you, unsheathing
its sword, he charges for battle.

name: the Neo-Otyugh
long: A large, disgusting, vile creature stands here, smelling putrid.
desc:
This creature is covered with slime like substance, many tentacles protrude
from its disgusting body.

name: a Shadow Daemon
long: A shadowy figure stands here, looking you over with greed.
desc:
This creature has almost no form, it looks like some sort of shadow with
wings.

name: the Gatekeeper
long: A huge warrior stands here guarding the portal beyond.
desc:
He is a huge man, his strong, muscular body stands about 8 feet tall.
He guards the portal beyond him angrily.

name: The water prince
long: The prince of water elementals flows here
desc: He looks like a giant wave about to swoop down upon you.

name: The Earth King
long: The King of earth elementals stands here.. cower fool!
desc: It looks vaguely man-shaped.

name: The lord of Air
long: A huge tornado is squeezed into this impossibly small space
desc: It looks sentient

name: The Sultan of Fire
long: The Sultan of fire Elementals stands before you, you feel crisp.
desc: It looks vaguely man-shaped

name: The goblin king
long: The goblin king is here.
desc: He looks like david bowie

name: A goblin cannon
long: A goblin cannon is here, warming up
desc: He looks like a tank

name: A gatling goblin
long: A gatling goblin is here!  Duck!
desc: He looks like a walking gatling gun

name: An acid blob
long: An acid blob is here
desc: he looks like a big blob of acid

name: A giant acid blob
long: A giant acid blob is here
desc: he looks like a huge blob of acid

name: A vrock
long: A Vrock stands here
desc: It is a vulture/human creature. Extremely ugly, and nasty

name: A hezrou
long: A demon Hezrou stands here.
desc: Not unlike A large toad/man

name: A glabrezu
long: A demon Glabrezu stands here
desc: I forget what this one looks like.

name: Nalfeshnee
long: Nalfeshnee stands here
desc: This one is big and mean looking.

name: Marilith
long: Marilith slithers here
desc: A woman with 6 arms and a snake's tail

name: Balor
long: Balor stands here, surrounded by electrical fire
desc: He is very large, and looks rather deadly

name: the Paladin Guardsman
long: A Paladin guardsman stands here, silently standing watch.
desc:
He looks very skilled in combat, and is clad heavy, metal armor.
Strapped to his right arm is a heavy, golden shield with the insignia
of the guild of paladins engraved into it.

name: the Grand Knight of Paladins
long: The Grand Knight of Paladins rests here, welcoming you to his guild.
desc:
He is huge warrior, clad in very magical armor, he rests here,
silently observing you.

name: A large Fire Giant
long: A large Fire Giant sentry eyes you suspiciously.
desc:
This creature is as large as a house, and as strong as a dragon.
he stands here guarding his post faithfully.

name: The Fire Giant lieutenant
long: A large Fire Giant is standing here
desc:
This is the largest Fire Giant you have seen yet.  Massive muscles
bulge from his gargantuan body.  A flaming helm rests atop his monstrous
head.

name: The General
long: A large Fire Giant making battle plans.
desc:
This ugly Fire Giant is the leader of the fire giant army.  His 
massive uniform is adorned with medals and other decorations, in
his hands is a very powerful looking Battle Axe.

name: The Fire Giant King
long: The Fire Giant King is here resting in a large oak chair
desc:
This is a very large obese creature, lines of many years of
frustration and pain mark his aged skin. He wears a long cloak
that covers most of his large frame, but you notice a huge great-
sword hanging from a jeweled scabbard at his side.

name: The Blue Dragon
long: An Ancient Blue Dragon stares at you wisely
desc:
She is the largest dragon you have ever seen, she has no weapons
and the only armor she possesses are the shiny blue scales that cover 
her massive body.

name: The High Priest
long: The High Priest is standing here
desc:
He is dressed in back robes and wields a very wicked mace he
would give you a very tough challenge

name: A Giant Salamander
long: A Giant Salamander slithers here quietly
desc:
This is a large snake like creature with small limbs
extending from its long body, it glares at you hungrily
as you approach.

name: A Skeletal Giant
long: A Massive Skeletal Giant charges at you mindlessly
desc:
This is the undead remains of a long dead Fire Giant, its
body's flesh has decayed many years ago leaving a pile of charred
bones and a few scraps of clothing.

name: a gritha
long: A winged goblin grins evilly at you.
desc:
This small creature scurries about on its knuckles, it's harry, bat wings 
beating all the while.  It's grin show a mouth full of sharp, yellow teeth.

name: a small gritha
long: A small, winged goblin scurries about.
desc:
This small creature is cover in hair.  It's evil, red eyes glare at you
as it scampers by, its bat wings beating feebly.

name: a large gritha
long: A large, winged goblin growls and peers about, looking for fresh blood.
desc:
This large creature's mouth drips with blood.  A low growl escapes it as
it bounds around.  Its large frame unusually nimble.

name: an orc
long: An orc stands here looking dazed, staring off to some far-off place.
desc:
The orc looks like a man with a pigs head.  It's eyes are glazed over and do
not seem to focus.  It totally ignores you.

name: the great oak
long: A huge, twisted oak blocks out the sky.
desc:
This ancient tree has grown here for hundreds of years.  It's twisted
branches reach into the dark sky.  Spiders seem to have made a home in its
branches.

name: a large black widow
long: A large blackwidow watches you carefully from the shadows.
desc:
The spider is about the size of a large dog.  It's fangs glisten with venom.
It's compound eyes never leave you.

name: a skeleton warrior
long: A skeleton warrior grins, searching for prey.
desc:
This was once a proud warrior and is now only its husk.  The creature wears
old, weathered gear that has seen much battle.

sounds.near: The skeleton warrior grins at you.
sounds.far: You can make out the chattering of bones in the distance.

name: an ogre
long: A huge ogre stands guard here.
desc:
This yellow skinned warrior stands 9 feet tall.  Although dumb as a brick
he is determined to kill any his masters dislike.  On his knee is a black
tattoo in the shape of an eye.

name: the black knight
long: A dark knight, his armor blackened by fire, blocks your path.
desc:
A pair of fierce, red, glowing eyes peer at you from deep in the helmet.  His 
armor and blade are sorely rusted and warn but he seems no less able.

sounds.near: The dark knight says,'None shall pass!'
sounds.far: Broken, rasping breathing can be heard nearby.

name: a hill giant
long: A huge man stands here scratching himself.
desc:
This 12 foot tall man has more muscles and more body hair that anyone was
ever meant to.  His wits seem dim but his teeth are sharp!  He burps, growls  
and prepares to tear you limb from limb.  On the right half of his chest is 
a large tattoo of an eye.

name: the greenhag
long: A crooked, old, green hag weaves powerful curses before your very eyes.
desc:
You shudder looking upon this wretched crone.  She is the result of the demon
called Night Hag rapeing a human male.  Magic flows through this half-demon's
blood.

sounds.near: The greenhag weaves a foul curse over you.
sounds.far: An evil chant can be heard to the north.

name: the black annis
long: The tall form of the black annis stands here trying to look useful.
desc:
Nine feet tall and covered in blue-black skin, this "lady" is half green hag
and half giant.  Although magic is weak in her blood her demon ancestry
gives her great power and great wickedness.

sounds.near: The black annis grins with a mouthful of crooked, yellow teeth.
sounds.far: A foul screach breaks is the silence of the forest.

name: a zombie
long: A zombie staggers past.
desc: This rotting corpse is only a shadow of the man it once was.

name: Hecate
long: The twisted form of Hecate stands here working forbidden magics!
desc:
She is no more than a twisted old crone.  Her long, hook nose is covered
with warts.  Her skin is dry and scaly.  Her hair: no more than black, matted
knots.  "Welcome, my child," her cracked voice beckons.

sounds.near: Hecate glares at you,'Begone fools!'
sounds.far: A cold chill passes over you.

name: a small imp
long: A fiendish imp grins at you as it disappears into the shadows.
desc:
This small demon has slick grey skin and tiny bat wings.  A long tail
bobs along behind him topped with a large stinger.

name: an imperial knight
long: A winded knight stands here looking into the gloom nervously.
desc:
He was once a proud knight of Tyr's Legion.  Now he is lost and confused.  Sweat
streaks his brow he tries to catch his breath.  "Help me!" he cries out
as he sees you.

name: Farin
long: A shaken knight sits here shivering in fetal position.
desc:
Farin is a tall and handsome knight.  His dark hair is now matted in blood
as he shivers and tries to fight off the nightmares in his mind.

name: Able
long: A wise, old smith works diligently here, pounding away at a shaft of hot iron.
desc:
Able is a tall, strong man with a mighty, white beard.  He stands soaked in
sweat from the forge's heat.  He smiles at you and says, "You may stay as long
as you like, friend."

name: a shadow hound
long: A pair of red, glowing eyes peer at you from out of the darkness.
desc:
It appears to a vicious, black hound that morphs and shifts as it moves through
the shadows.  If it were not for it's glowing, red eyes it would be next
to invisible.

name: a large shadow hound
long: A pair of red, glowing growl at you from out of the darkness.
desc:
It is a huge, black hound with red glowing eyes.  It shifts and changes shape
as it passes through the shadows.  Its glowing eyes search for hatted life.

name: the gritha chief
long: The bloated, gritha chief sits here in his grandeur grinning hungrily at you.
desc:
This creature is over nine feet tall with a huge pot belly.  Its body is
covered in thick fur.  It's vestigial bat wings beat futilely.

name: a hairy rat
long: A hungry-looking rat scurries about looking for food.
desc: A four-pound rodent!

name: a sickly man
long: A sickly man stands here.
desc:
He looks hungry and malnourished.  His ribs show and his legs are weak.
His glazed eyes open with joy when he sees you.  He says,"Thank you, oh noble
one!"

sounds.near: The sickly man hacks up a ball of flem.
sounds.far: You hear some weak moaning nearby.

name: a rot grub
long: Some rot grubs worm their way through the trash.
desc: This is a large, white grub with a keen love for fresh meet.

name: a gritha
long: A gritha dances madly about the fire, chanting in a barbaric tongue.
desc:
This creature looks like a harry, winged goblin standing almost five feet tall.
Its eyes are wild and it's teeth yellow and barred as it prances about.

sounds.near: The gritha screaches with fury and howls at the sky.
sounds.far: An evil chant echos around you.

name: a gritha
long: A winged goblin sleeps soundly here.
desc:
This beast appears to be a harry, winged goblin.  It is about four or five
feet tall and smells as if soap is one thing it needs to invent.. and soon!

name: a gritha
long: A winged goblin squats here gnawing on some bloody meat.
desc: The gritha peers about ready to kill any who dare take its food.

keywords: ghost mcgreer old mrs mrs.  ghostly
name: the ghost of old Mrs. McGreer
long: The ghostly form of old Mrs. McGreer wanders here, quietly sobbing.
desc:
She peers out into the mist between sobs murmuring something.  Her transparent
hand wipes a tear away as she wrings her hands.

sounds.near: The ghost of old Mrs. McGreer bursts into tears.
sounds.far: A faint sobbing can be heard.

name: Rex
long: Rex, the old, faithful, hunting dog rests here.
desc:
This is an old, mangy dog that in it's prime was quite a hunter.  Now it
spends it's days resting by the forge and being cared for by it's loving
master.

name: an ogre
long: A large ogre wanders about looking for someone to eat.
desc:
This huge warrior stands about 9 feet tall.  His hide is thick and yellow.
His beady, little eyes show little sign of intelligence.  On his chest is a
tattoo of an eye.

name: a scrag
long: There is some movement just below the surface of the water.
desc:
This green terror stands at 8 feet tall with long, knobby arms flailing at its
sides.  Its mouth contains dozens of large, sharp teeth and its claws are 
long and filthy.  A knotted mane of wiry black hair droops from its twisted 
brow.

name: the ghoul
long: A slime covered ghoul savagely tears into the ground looking for food.
desc:
This agile creature was once a man.  Now it is a hideous servant of darkness.
A red glow radiates from its eyes and its longs hooked teeth drip with a yellow
slime.  Its only sustenance is the flesh of the living and dead.

name: the twisted tree
long: A tortured, dead tree still stands here.
desc:
This poor tree must have once been beautiful but now is long dead.  Its
branches are twisted, almost screaming out in pain.

name: a slime covered oak
long: An sturdy young oak grows here.  Yellow slime drips from its branches.
desc:
A slick yellow ichor covers this tree.  The bark shines black with wetness.  It
looks as if some small critters have gotten caught in the goo.

name: a small spider
long: A fist-sized spider scurries across your foot.
desc: It is small but looks poisonous.

loads.roomName: South End of the Oak Grove

keywords: spiders spider swarm black widows mass
name: a swarm of small black widows
long: A carpet-thick mass of black widows swarms the area.
desc: Each spider is harmless but the swarm is deadly!

name: the huge black widow
long: A huge black widow rears up at your approach, its fangs dripping with venom.
desc:
This massive spider is over eight feet long.  It's eyes burn with hatred and
it's jaws snap with anticipation waiting for another morsel.

name: an apparition
long: A fat halfling is kicking back here and strumming on a banjo.
desc:
This jolly fat man is totally oblivious to your presence.  He just keeps
strumming away at his banjo singing a jolly song about death.

name: the boatman
long:
As mist parts the shadowy form of a boatman comes into view, holding his
lantern aloft.
desc:
Riding on the skiff is a dark robed man.  He pushes the boat with a long pole
and holds his lantern above him.  For a moment the light passes before his hood
and the skull visage comes into view.

sounds.near: The boatman holds out his hand as if expecting payment.
sounds.far: A cold sweat trickles down your back.

name: the hound
long: A large black hound snaps at you tugging at it's chain.
desc:
The hound is out of control.  It is frothing at the mouth and snarling at you.
A long chain extends to the wall pulling it back.

name: the phantom
long: The ghostly form of a old man is desperately pulling the rope ringing the bell.
desc:
The ghost is of an old man in wizardly clothes.  His hair is a mess and his
face is beading with sweat.  Wild eyes stare out over the valley as he
continues ringing the huge ball in complete desperation.

sounds.near: The old ghost scream out to the forest below,'Flee! Flee from your homes!'
sounds.far: You hear a man desperately shouting not too far away.

name: the wisp
long: A flicker of light dances about the mist.
desc:
The light is about a foot across and seems to jump in and out of existence
as is dances about you.

name: the large water snake
long: There is movement just below the surface of the water.
desc: The water ripples as a snake passes below you.

name: a cow
long: A brown cow stands here chewing it's cud.
desc: The cow looks at you indifferently and then snorts, going back to it meal.

name: a black wolf
long: A small black wolf scavenges for food.
desc:
The wolf looks skinny but it's pelt is shiny. It must have trouble competeing
for meat thrown in for the predators.

name: a large, grey wolf
long: A large grey wolf eyes you suspiciously.
desc:
This animal looks like a formidable opponent.  It is a lean and fast yet looks
intelligent.

sounds.near: The wolf growls deeply.
sounds.far: You hear a growling not too far away.

name: a mountain lion
long: A mountain lion paces back and forth.
desc:
The lion is a regal animal, angry to be imprisoned.  It looks at you, smacks
it's lips and looks away.

sounds.near: The mountain lion purrs.
sounds.far: A fierce roar shakes you.

name: an ogre
long: A hungry ogre sits here stuffing it's face.
desc:
This huge, yellow skinned man is dangerous and would probably tear your face off 
if it weren't so busy wolfing down some raw meat.  On his left cheek is the
tattoo of an eye.

name: a hill giant
long: An ugly giant is lifting a bowl to its face and slurping noisily.
desc:
This huge man stands at 11' tall.  He is covered with hair and dressed in
animal skins.  He has a thick beard grows wild and is dripping with stew.
On his back is the tattoo of an eye.

name: the cook
long: A fat giant wipes his grubby hands on his apron as he moves from pot to pot.
desc:
This 10' giant is bald and very fat.  A greasy leather apron hangs about his
girth.  He doesn't seem to bright but could tear a man in half without a second
thought.  On his right shoulder is the tattoo of an eye.

name: an ogre
long: A large ogre hangs half out of his cot, snoring up a storm.
desc:
This ogre appears to be stone drunk.  A bottle swings from his finger and the
small of some fowl spirits is on his breath.  As you watch him, he rolls over
he happily tucks his fat, yellow hand into his shorts.  There is a black tattoo
of an eye on his belly.

name: the ogre
long: An ogre stands by the anvil trying to figure out which end of the hammer to use
desc:
This ogre got the thankless job of "master smith."  His swords are as dull as
his mind.  By the looks of his hands he has yet to figure out that the tongs
are used to pull the hot iron from the furnace.  On the top of his head is the
tattoo of an eye.

name: the hill giant sub-chief
long: A well armored hill giant snores loudly here, sprawled across the pile of pelts
desc:
The giant looks strong and seasoned for battle.  He is the first well shaven 
giant you have seen here.  He bears the scars of many battles.  His right
palm has the tattoo of an eye.

name: Valdakas
long: Valdakas, the half-giant shaman glares evilly at you.
desc:
He is nine feet tall dressed in feathers and war paint.  He screams a chant of
death at you before attacking.  Blazon on his chest is the black tattoo of an
eye.

name: Cur
long: Cur, the hill giant chief, screams in rage at your approach.
desc:
Cur looks young and inexperienced.  He is hardly out of adolescence yet what is
left of the tribe depends on him to rule them.  His left cheek bears the tattoo
of an eye.

sounds.near: Cur mutters,'Hecate demands your sacrifice!'
sounds.far: A barbaric scream fills the air.

name: hill giant soldier
long: A giant soldier looks ready to do battle as he raises his huge spear.
desc:
This soldier is dressed in crudely made armor but seems to be well seasoned for
battle.  He eyes seem to glint with intelligence and his beard is trimmed.
One his forehead is a tattoo of an eye.

name: Shilandra
long: Shilandra, faerie queen, hovers before you.
desc:
She is beautiful beyond compare.  Luminescence locks of blond hair flow like honey
down her shoulder.  A smile passes across her face as she sees you.  She says,
"If you can rescue one of my daughters from the giants, I will help you find
the hag's grove."

name: a small faerie
long: A small faerie darts playfully about in the air.
desc:
She is only about 4" long.  She is a small beautiful woman with dragonfly
wings.  Here tiny body is naked and glowing with a soft light.

name: a skeleton warrior
long: A grim skeleton stands here glaring warning at you not to pass.
desc:
This creature seem aware of its condition as hatred burns in it eyes, jealousy
for freedom and senses of the living. It has no fear and will kill you without
hesitation.

name: an imp
long: A small imp stands behind its master's robe, waving goodbye to you.
desc:
This little creature has pale white skin and a fat nose.  Swinging behind it 
is a large stinger on the end of its tail.  It cant help but laughing knowing
you are about to die.

name: a gnome
long: A stocky gnome sitting on the stump, stops his whittling to wave at you.
desc:
This small man looks like the happy type.  He sits on the old tree stump 
happily whittling on a small piece of wood.  He nods at you and motions
to the cabin.

name: a korred
long: What looks like a goat-legged dwarf with four foot dread locks, grins at you.
desc:
This short, bearded thing has shaggy goat legs and a wild unkept beard.
He grins evilly at you and plays out a haunting score on his pan pipes.  
His arms look very strong and he could easily over power even a strong man.

name: a korred
long: A korred prances wildly about, dancing in the circle and playing its pan pipes.
desc:
This short creature looks like a goat-legged dwarf with a hairy well muscled 
body.  He has wild hair that hangs in dread locks down to his hooves.  He is
so entranced with his wild dance that he hardly notices you.

name: a small faerie
long: A small faerie sobs uncontrollably here, here face buried in her hands.
desc:
She is about 4" long and boasts a pair of dragonfly wings.  Here naked little 
body glows with a soft light.  Here face is streaked with tears.  The small
sprite looks up at you in joy when she sees you.

loads.roomName: Sleeping Chambers of the Giant Chief

name: a black widow
long: A black widow the size of large dog snaps it mandibles at you.
desc:
This abomination of nature must weigh over 100 lbs.  It's compound eyes burn
with a fury like few you have ever seen.

name: an egg sack
long: A white egg sack is buried in a mass of webbing.
desc:
Soon it will burst forth with a swarm of spiderspawn let it be burnt by a
wizened one as yourself.

name: A dark dryad
long: A dark dryad lurks in the shadows watching you.
desc:
She is made of branches and leaves.  Her eyes glow with a fierce
red light.

name: A warrior of Chaos
long: A huge, grim warrior strides toward you, weapon drawn.
desc:
He is about 12 feet tall and armored in some alien for of armor.
His shield depitcs a twisted demonic face.

name: A huge bronze statue
long: A huge bronze statue fills the western side of the hall.
desc:
It is sitting with a flaming brasier on its lap.  It stands about 100
feet tall even in this position.  It's hands looks like they could
crush a castle with a single blow.

name: a shadowstalker
long: A shadow flickers across the wall.
desc: It has the shape of a man but is the stuff of shadows

name: Ixzuul the Evil Godling
long: Ixzuul laughs at you approach, preparing to maul you.
desc:
He is no longer human.  His features are twised and deformed.
His body is large and bloated from his toying with it's workings.

name: a minion of chaos
long: A robed man hovers before you.
desc: He is a human aprentice of Ixzuul.

name: Captain Kanga-Roo
long: Captain Kanga-Roo is here going over troop orders.
desc:
A seasoned veteran who knows how to take care of himself. He is
covered with old scars and carries a worn sword in a scabbard.
He also seems to have a fat pouch since he is the one who pays
the soldiers.

name: Prince Roo-Preckt
long: Prince Roo-Preckt runs around the room banging pots and pans.
desc:
His mind is obviously gone! He wears an eye-patch over one eye, has
a fork with a cork covering the tines in his belt, and carries a
pot in one hand and a pan in the other which he constantly bangs as
he runs around the room.

sounds.near: Roo-Preckt yells out, "Oklahoma! Oklahoma! Oklahoma!..."
sounds.far: You hear some muffled shouting and banging nearby. (combat?)

name: Prince Roo-Pert
long: Prince Roo-Pert sees you and demands you kneel before him! Now!
desc:
This joker is used to getting his own way and has a REAL bad attitude
towards anyone who is below him in station.

name: The Roo Queen
long: The Roo Queen stands here waiting for you to bow to her.
desc:
She is dressed in flowing robes of scarlet and gold and carries a
strange, elaborately carved stick.

name: The Roo Elder
long: A Roo Elder stands here lost in thought.
desc:
He is quite old for a Roo, but he seems to have some inner strength that
makes you reconsider him as not being as easy as you thought.

name: The Roo Sentry
long: The Roo Sentry notices you, and draws its sword to attack!
desc:
Unusually alert, he quickly notices you and prepares himself to kill you
as an intruder to the Fortress.

sounds.near: The Roo Sentry tells You, "My orders are that all intruders must die."

name: The Roo soldier
long:
A Roo Soldier wanders around looking for an Aborigine or one of their
allies.
desc:
Somewhat formidable, the soldiers can probably be taken out singly, but you
would have some difficulty with several of them.

name: The Roo Soldier
long: An off-duty Roo Soldier relaxes here in some of his off time.
desc:
He looks just like the other soldiers though he must have recently gotten
off duty because he looks a bit more tired than the rest.

name: The Roo Soldier
long: A Roo Soldier stands here watching over the cage.
desc:
He looks just like the other soldiers except that he seems a bit nervous
about watching the cage.

sounds.near: The Roo Soldier warns you, "Stay away from the bars...it is rather nasty."

name: The Roo Prisoner
long: A beaten up Roo Prisoner looks at you with a blank stare.
desc:
You can tell this Roo must have put up a fight from all of the small cuts
and bruises on him. Unfortunately, his will is broken and it doesn't
look like he could put up a fight like he used to....

sounds.near: The Roo Prisoner pleads you to spare his life.
sounds.far: You hear moaning from nearby.

name: The Roo Hunter
long: You see a Roo Hunter.... My God! That Roo's got a Gun!
desc:
A true combat veteran if you ever saw one. It is his job to sneak in behind
enemy lines and ambush the Aborigines and their allies single-handedly.

sounds.near: The Roo Hunter says 'You will roo the day you crossed my path!'
sounds.far: You hear an evil laugh nearby

name: A Roo Youth
long: A Roo Youth wanders around without purpose.
desc:
Roo Youths don't really have any responsibilities as their period of
mandatory military service doesn't occur for a while.

loads.roomName: Along the Eucalyptus River Outside of a Fortress
Along the Eucalyptus River Outside of a Fortress
Along the Eucalyptus River Outside of a Fortress

name: The Aborigine Shaman
long: The Aborigine Shaman doesn't look pleased that you have disturbed him.
desc:
A very religious man, he truly believes that his omnipotent god--Father--
frowns on the Roos. Because of this, the war with them is a Holy War that
can only end with the destruction of the Roos.

name: A Aborigine Holy Man
long: A Aborigine Holy Man is here studying his prayer books.
desc:
The Aborigines believe strongly in their god --Father-- and it is his hope
that he can get closer to his god through diligent study and prayer.

sounds.near: The Holy Man says, "I wouldn't disturb the Shaman while he is meditating."

name: The Aborigine Stalker
long: You notice an Aborigine trying to sneak up on you with a drawn knife!
desc:
A true combat veteran if you ever saw one. It is the Stalker's job to sneak
behind enemy lines and kill as many Roos as possible.

name: The Aborigine Chief
long: The Aborigine Chief is here thinking about how to attack the Roos next.
desc:
A wise, competent man who feels justified in the war with the Roos. After
all, he DOES have the Church on his side.

name: The Aborigine Warrior
long: A Aborigine Warrior is here looking for a Roo to kill.
desc:
With the exception that his skin is a bit darker than most because of
spending so much time outdoors, he looks very close to many of the
experienced warriors back in town (interesting thing though, he sort of
looks like an Enfan without the bright suit).

name: The Aborigine Warrior
long: A Aborigine Warrior is relaxing here after a long day.
desc:
He looks just like the other warriors (kind of like an Enfan without the
bright suit) though perhaps a bit more tired but just as competent.

name: The Aborigine Warrior
long: A Aborigine Warrior stands here watching the Cage.
desc: He looks like a bored warrior who would much rather be out hunting Roos.

sounds.near:
The Aborigine Warrior tells You, "If you wish to speak with the prisoner,
    you need to see the Chief first."

name: The Aborigine Trainer
long: The Aborigine Trainer is here running the advanced students through drills.
desc:
Though the years have slowed him down enough to prevent him from going
out on hunting parties, the corded muscles in his arms and precision of
his movements prove that he could show you a thing or two....

name: The Aborigine Tanner
long: The Aborigine Tanner is here tanning some Roo hides.
desc:
He appears as weathered as the Roo hides that he dips into a large vat of
boiling oil.  Apparently he enjoys his job; as he looks at you with a
malicious grin.

name: The Aborigine Elder
long: The Aborigine Elder is fiddling with some strange flasks.
desc:
This wizened aborigine is obviously more than just some backwoods
mumbo-jumbo man.

sounds.near:
The Elder curses as a flask shatters upon the floor.
A strange odor fills the room.
sounds.far: You hear the crash of breaking glass and muffled cursing.

name: An Aborigine Teen
long: An Aborigine Teenager is practicing an intricate attack sequence.
desc:
Once a Slovene and carefree youth, this poor guy is drenched in sweat
from endless hours of practice.

name: An Aborigine Child
long: An Aborigine Child stares off into space.
desc:
This large-bellied tyke looks like he has had enough training for the day.
A small purple spider crawling on your shirt seems to enthrall him.

name: An Aborigine Woman
long: An Aborigine Woman hums an old tune as she hacks at weeds.
desc:
Not an unpleasant-looking woman, she reaps the fields while her man is out
hunting Roos.

sounds.near: The woman yells "Get OFF my vegetables you maladjusted vagrant!!!"
sounds.far: You faintly hear a woman humming.

loads.roomName: Northern End of a Cultivated Field
Southern End of A Cultivated Field

name: A Dingo
long: A Dingo runs circles around you.
desc:
This hungry-looking dog has sharp teeth.  It makes you uneasy as it's 
tongue lolls out...  (when was he last fed?)

name: A Eucalyptus Tree
long: A Eucalyptus Tree seems to be taking root here.
desc: Without these unusual trees, the Koala would surely perish...(sniff)

name: A Koala Bear
long: A cuddly Koala Bear munches on eucalyptus leaves.
desc:
Slow-moving and fluffy, these cute critters are actually quite defensive
of their precious leaves.
