name: A Crocodile
long: A hungry Crocodile swims toward you, mouth agape.
desc:
With teeth big enough to mount on the end of a spear, this hungry croc
tries to pull you under.

name: The Tasmanian Devil
long: With a snarl, the Tasmanian Devil leaps at you in a blur of action.
desc:
You can't really see much detail on this gyrating creature.  It appears
to be all claws and mouth with an occasional patch of fur.

name: a zombie
long: a corpse rises from the ground and attacks you.
desc: An evil looking rotting corpse looks balefully back at you.

name: a bat
long: A bat flaps wildly at you!
desc: Your typical smelly, blind flying mammal

name: The vampire
long: A bat flaps wildly at you!
desc: A rather LARGE "bat". . . . .

name: the banshee
long: A horrid misshapen elven maid'n stands before you wailing horribly!
desc:
It appears to be an elven woman that has seen a hard life.  You look
more closely and you see through her, she appears to be non-corpal. She
looks at you balefully and begins to wail!

name: Guardian
long: The Guardian of Sorrow stands here groaning.
desc:
He is the guardian of sorrow, what he guards one can only guess. It is
a shimmering shape of a man that commands your attention. He does not
approve of your presence here!

name: the accountant
long: Lief Lipsiege the accountant stands here doing his accounting.
desc:
A rather small man that looks a little grumpy. He carriers a small paper pad
and a feather quill, he is writing quickly and seems to be ignoring you.

name: A evil werewolf
long: A evil werewolf stands here, sniffing at you hungrily.
desc:
A large, muscular wolf-like creature standing about seven feet tall.  It 
plans to solve its malnourishment difficulties with your corpse. He eyes you
hungrily with his glowing red eyes.

name: the witch Gritz
long: a ugly old witch named Gritz stirs a huge caldron here
desc:
A horrid old bag, she has refuse hanging from what looks like hair and
the gods only know what that smell is coming off her cloths!

sounds.near: Gritz stirs a large caldron with a long spoon and sings a horrid tune.
sounds.far: You hear a terrible sound, must be someone dieing!

name: Grezelda the Witch
long: Grezelda the Old Witch stands here.
desc:
This witch seems to be older than dirt. Wrinkles line her face like
the cracks in an empty lake. Her hair (what little there is left) is a
dirty silver color with a few streaks of black here and there that could
be something other than black hair.

sounds.near: Grezelda lets out a croak that sounds like laughter.
sounds.far: A loud croaking sound comes from somewhere near.

name: A beautiful woman
long: A beautiful woman looks at you pitifully.
desc:
Long flowing black hair cascades down her uncovered shoulders. She
wears a very low cut dress that seems to cling to her body tightly. She
looks at you with charming eyes.

name: A wraith
long: A dark shadow occupies the alcove.
desc:
A dim resemblance to what it once was this shadow of a person
barely seems to be on the same plane as you. Darkness seems to pour
from the wraiths eye sockets.

sounds.near: The wraith lets out a low moaning noise that sends shivers down your spine.
sounds.far: You hear a low moan, it sends shivers down your spine.

name: A large spider
long: A huge spider pounces on you!
desc:
This eight legged arachnid is large by any standard be they dwarf or
giant. Almost 3 feet across and standing almost 5 feet when extended on
it's eight legs. A milky liquid drips from its fangs.

name: Mad Gertruda
long: Mad Gertruda jumps about at your shadows.
desc:
You can tell this poor girl has just lost her mind. She looks about blankly
but sometimes seems to see things where there is nothing. The poor thing can
barely defend herself against the spider webs, much less against Ravenloft.

name: A cat
long: A familiar cat sits here purring.
desc:
Quiet simply put, it looks like a very black evil cat that follows some
evil mage. Familiars are what some call them, demon spawn is what others
would call them.

name: A iron statue
long: A iron statue is here.
desc:
This tall humanoid statue is made of solid iron. He must way weigh over
two tons! You look at bit closer and it seems his head turned, then his
eyes opened, ACK it is ALIVE!

name: Mad Cyrus Belview
long: Mad Cyrus Belview cackles insanely
desc:
Like some many others, this poor fellow simply was at the wrong
place at the wrong time. The horrors of this place have taken his mind and
left his body here to try and survive.

name: A zombie
long: A misshaped corpse lies here.
desc:
It looks as though someone just left their friend here to die and
die they did. a small sword juts out from the corpses chest, rust
has already begun to form on the blade.

name: A skeleton
long: A pile of bones lies here
desc:
Bleach white bones form a shaky body, with red pulsing
eyes staring back at you, hungering for your life because it has
none!

name: Heli the Witch
long: Heli the Witch sits here contemplating the contents of the caldron
desc:
She looks very tired and old. Heli seems to not be much like her
sisters, totally evil, but she does what they say without question.

name: A shadowy figure
long: A dark shadowy figure is here
desc:
This is a shadow demon, all that you can see is a shadowy
humanoid form with dim red eyes.

name: A handsome man
long: A very handsome man stands here with a charming grin
desc: You look into the mans eyes and feel a tingling along your spine.

name: a decomposing elf
long: A decomposing elf corpse lies here in this room.
desc:
It appears this fellow was not as lucky as you are. Looking at the 
remains you can see that it has been dead quiet sometime now and is
really beginning to smell. Two large holes are the only thing that
seem to be wrong with the corpse.

name: A roo ghoul
long: A corpse of a long dead roo lies here smelling badly.
desc:
It appears to be the remains of a roo soldier, and it has been
here for a VERY long time, eeewww!

name: A spectre
long: A ghostly figure floats here
desc:
You can barely make out the form of a human or demi-human figure,
you catch a feeling of deep despair.

name: A ghost
long: A ghostly apparition floats about
desc: You can't see much but the wall behind the thing!

name: A lost soul
long: A lost soul wonders about here
desc:
The stumbling remains of some poor sod that didn't make it out of
Ravenloft alive. The body is rotting and he reeks of evil.

sounds.near: The lost soul howls sending a shiver down your spine.
sounds.far: A horrid howl breaks the silence.

name: Hiro the mental giant
long: Hiro the mental giant medates here quietly
desc:
He looks like a man with great mental powers. His eyes pierce your
soul at a glance.
